features.name: Hoekse Lijn
features.opening: The Schiedam–Hoek van Holland railway (also called the Hoekse Lijn) is a former railway line and current rapid transit line of the Rotterdam Metro between…

facts.text: The line first opened as heavy rail between Schiedam and Maassluis on 17 August 1891.
facts.sourceQuote: On 17 August 1891, the first section between Schiedam Centrum and Maassluis was opened as a heavy-rail line.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On 17 August 1891, the first section between Schiedam Centrum and Maassluis was opened as a heavy-rail line.

facts.text: Passenger trains ceased operations on 31 March 2017 before the route reopened as metro in 2019.
facts.sourceQuote: On 31 March 2017, the final passenger trains of the Nederlandse Spoorwegen ran on the line. The line reopened in 2019 as part of the Rotterdam Metro.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On 31 March 2017, the final passenger trains of the Nederlandse Spoorwegen ran on the line. The line reopened in 2019 as part of the Rotterdam Metro.

facts.text: Despite serving rapid transit, this route remains a vital freight railway.
facts.sourceQuote: The line is also an important freight railway, it is 24 kilometres (15 miles) long.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The line is also an important freight railway, it is 24 kilometres (15 miles) long.

features.name: Prinses Irenebrug
features.opening: De Prinses Irenebrug is een brug in de Nederlandse stad Rotterdam, in de wijk Hillegersberg.

facts.text: A replacement project completed in 2005 established its current form.
facts.sourceQuote: De brug heeft sinds de vervanging in 2005 een hoogte in gesloten stand van KP +1,30 m, in geheven stand KP +2,90 m en de wijdte is 5,70 m.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since the replacement in 2005, the bridge has a height in closed position of KP +1.30 m, in raised position KP +2.90 m and the width is 5.70 m.

features.name: Giessenbrug
features.opening: De Giessenbrug is een complex van drie basculebruggen over de Delfshavense Schie in de deelgemeente Overschie van de Nederlandse gemeente Rotterdam.

facts.text: Shipping traffic permanently ceased at this crossing in 2017 due to persistent operational disruptions.
facts.sourceQuote: Vanwege aanhoudende storingen is de brug in 2017 permanent gesloten voor scheepvaartverkeer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Due to ongoing disruptions, the bridge was permanently closed to shipping traffic in 2017.

features.name: Van Brienenoordbrug
features.opening: The Van Brienenoord Bridge (Dutch: Van Brienenoordbrug) is a large twin tied-arch motorway bridge in the Netherlands.

facts.text: Opening the bridge for ships takes exactly 18 minutes total, with road traffic blocked by barriers during the process.
facts.sourceQuote: Approximately 500 of these ships require the bridge to be opened, a process which takes 18 minutes total. Suspending road traffic and opening the bridge takes 4 minutes, letting the ship pass takes 10 minutes, and closing the bridge requires another 4 minutes.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Approximately 500 of these ships require the bridge to be opened, a process which takes 18 minutes total. Suspending road traffic and opening the bridge takes 4 minutes, letting the ship pass takes 10 minutes, and closing the bridge requires another 4 minutes.

facts.text: A two-way cycling path is mounted on the outside of the east arch.
facts.sourceQuote: Additionally, on the outside of the east arch, a two-way segregated cycling bridge has been mounted.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Additionally, on the outside of the east arch, a two-way segregated cycling bridge has been mounted.

facts.text: Vessels up to 24 meters high can pass under the closed structure.
facts.sourceQuote: Including lead-up ramps, the Van Brienenoord Bridge is 1320 meters long and vessels with up to 24 meters air draft can pass under the closed bridge.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Including lead-up ramps, the Van Brienenoord Bridge is 1320 meters long and vessels with up to 24 meters air draft can pass under the closed bridge.

features.name: Ibisbrug
features.opening: De Ibisbrug is een ophaalbrug in het centrum van de Nederlandse stad Rotterdam.

facts.text: A hydraulic cylinder under the southern abutment tilts the deck almost perpendicular to the water.
facts.sourceQuote: De brug wordt "in gang gezet" door een hydraulische cilinder, die onder de zuidelijke aanbrug hangt. Deze cilinder kan de brug bijna haaks op het wateroppervlak zetten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The bridge is "started" by a hydraulic cylinder, which hangs under the southern abutment. This cylinder can tilt the bridge almost perpendicular to the water surface.

features.name: Mathenesserbrug
features.opening: De Mathenesserbrug is een stalen ophaalbrug over de Delfshavense Schie, in het stadsdeel Delfshaven in de Nederlandse gemeente Rotterdam.

facts.text: Architect Jos Klijnen designed the original structure for Rotterdam's municipal works department.
facts.sourceQuote: De eerste Mathenesserbrug is gebouwd vanaf 1915 en is ontworpen door Jos Klijnen, een architect van Gemeentewerken Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first Mathenesserbrug was built from 1915 and was designed by Jos Klijnen, an architect of Gemeentewerken Rotterdam.

facts.text: The first version featured brick construction with four pillars topped by towers housing a keeper's cottage.
facts.sourceQuote: Deze brug was gemetseld uit baksteen en had vier pijlers met torentjes. In een van deze torentjes was het brugwachtershuisje.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This bridge was made of brick and had four pillars with towers. In one of these towers was the bridge keeper's cottage.

features.name: Dintelhavenspoorbrug
features.opening: De Dintelhavenspoorbrug verbindt de beide oevers van de Dintelhaven in de Nederlandse stad Rotterdam.

facts.text: A separate road bridge for cars sits directly next to this railway structure.
facts.sourceQuote: Naast de spoorbrug ligt een brug voor autoverkeer, de Dintelhavenbrug.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Next to the railway bridge is a bridge for car traffic, the Dintelhaven Bridge.

facts.text: A temporary pontoon bridge stood west of the current site during 1960s Europoort construction.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens de aanleg van de Europoort in de jaren 60 lag er ten westen van de huidige brug een tijdelijke pontonbrug over wat toen de binnenhaven heette.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the construction of the Europoort in the 1960s, there was a temporary pontoon bridge west of the current bridge over what was then called the inner harbor.

features.name: Rijnhavenbrug
features.opening: De Rijnhavenbrug, regionaal bekend als de Hoerenloper is een voetgangers- en fietsersbrug over de Rijnhaven in de Nederlandse stad Rotterdam.

facts.text: Construction started in summer 2011 after the first pile was driven in February of that year.
facts.sourceQuote: De eerste paal voor de brug is geslagen op 16 februari 2011. De constructie ving aan in de zomer van 2011.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first pile for the bridge was driven on February 16, 2011. Construction began in the summer of 2011.

features.name: Boezembrug
features.opening: The Boezembrug is a bridge in Rotterdam, part of the Goudse Rijweg (Gouda roadway).

facts.text: Engineer S. J. Rutgers designed this structure in 1903.
facts.sourceQuote: The bridge is a Rijksmonument designed by S. J. Rutgers in 1903.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The bridge is a Rijksmonument designed by S. J. Rutgers in 1903.

features.name: Achterhavenbrug
features.opening: De Achterhavenbrug is een basculebrug over de Achterhaven in Delfshaven, een deelgemeente van de Nederlandse gemeente Rotterdam.

facts.text: Beneath the span lies a turn lock with a threshold depth of KP -3.60 meters.
facts.sourceQuote: Onder de brug ligt een keersluis. De drempeldiepte van de keersluis is KP - 3,60 m.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Under the bridge is a turn lock. The threshold depth of the turn lock is KP - 3.60 m.

features.name: Admiraliteitsbrug
features.opening: Rotterdam ( ROT-ər-dam, UK also ROT-ər-DAM; Dutch: [ˌrɔtərˈdɑm] ) is the second-largest city in the Netherlands by population and the largest by area (319.4…

facts.text: The International Film Festival Rotterdam has been held annually since 1972 in the city where this bridge stands.
facts.sourceQuote: Of major importance within this context has also been the International Film Festival Rotterdam (IFFR), an annual event that lasts more than ten days (end of January, beginning of February), which has been organized since 1972.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Of major importance within this context has also been the International Film Festival Rotterdam (IFFR), an annual event that lasts more than ten days (end of January, beginning of February), which has been organized since 1972.

facts.text: The British band the Beautiful South recorded a song titled Rotterdam (or Anywhere) in 1996.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1996, the British band the Beautiful South recorded a song named after this region titled "Rotterdam (or Anywhere)".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1996, the British band the Beautiful South recorded a song named after this region titled "Rotterdam (or Anywhere)".

facts.text: Battlefield V features two launch maps set in Rotterdam depicting battles between the British Army and the Wehrmacht.
facts.sourceQuote: In Battlefield V, this city appears in two launch maps, Rotterdam and Devastation, featuring battles between the British Army and the Wehrmacht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In Battlefield V, this city appears in two launch maps, Rotterdam and Devastation, featuring battles between the British Army and the Wehrmacht.

features.name: Groenewegbrug
features.opening: De Groenewegbrug is een ophaalbrug in de Nederlandse gemeente Rotterdam.

facts.text: A November 2010 renovation took about five months to complete.
facts.sourceQuote: In november 2010 is de Groenewegbrug gerenoveerd in opdracht van de Gemeentewerken Rotterdam. De tijd die hier voor nodig was kwam op ongeveer 5 maanden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In November 2010, the Groenewegbrug was renovated at the request of the Rotterdam Municipal Works. The time required for this came to about 5 months.

facts.text: In 2012, local politicians jokingly proposed a toll for crossing the Groenewegbrug.
facts.sourceQuote: Op dinsdag 27 maart 2012 maakte Omroep Zuidplas bekend dat de politiek in Zuidplas unaniem had ingestemd met een voorstel van tolheffing voor het gebruik van de Groenewegbrug. Dit was een 1 aprilgrap.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On Tuesday, March 27, 2012, Omroep Zuidplas announced that the political parties in Zuidplas had unanimously agreed to a proposal for tolling for the use of the Groenewegbrug. This was an April Fool's joke.

facts.text: The Groenewegbrug takes its name from the nearby Groeneweg road.
facts.sourceQuote: De Groenewegbrug is vernoemd naar de ernaast gelegen Groeneweg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Groenewegbrug is named after the nearby Groeneweg.

features.name: Spanjaardsbrug
features.opening: De Spanjaardsbrug is een dubbele basculebrug over de haven "het Haringvliet" in de stadsdriehoek (het centrum) van de Nederlandse stad Rotterdam, naast de Oude…

facts.text: A manual double bascule bridge replaced the original structure in 1843.
facts.sourceQuote: De brug werd in 1843 vervangen door een dubbele basculebrug met handbediening, ontworpen door W.N.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The bridge was replaced in 1843 by a double bascule bridge with manual operation, designed by W.N.

features.name: Spoorweghavenbrug
features.opening: De Spoorweghavenbrug is een ophaalbrug in het stadsdeel Feijenoord van de Nederlandse gemeente Rotterdam, onderdeel van de Stieltjesstraat.

facts.text: The Spoorweghavenbrug takes its name directly from the harbor it spans.
facts.sourceQuote: De brug overspant de Spoorweghaven en is daarnaar vernoemd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The bridge spans the Spoorweghaven and is named after it.

facts.text: A predecessor known as the Koffiemolen Bridge opened in 1880.
facts.sourceQuote: De eerste brug, een draaibrug, was in 1880 aangelegd en heette in de volksmond de Koffiemolenbrug.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first bridge, a swing bridge, was built in 1880 and was popularly known as the Koffiemolen Bridge.

facts.text: The current lift bridge replaced an older swing bridge in 1995.
facts.sourceQuote: De huidige brug stamt uit 1995, toen bij de herinrichting van het omliggende gebied (de Kop van Zuid) de draaibrug vervangen werd door een ophaalbrug.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The current bridge dates back to 1995, when the swing bridge was replaced by a lift bridge during the redevelopment of the surrounding area (the Kop van Zuid).

features.name: Goudse lijn
features.opening: The Utrecht–Rotterdam railway is a heavily used railway in the Netherlands, running from Utrecht to Rotterdam, passing through Woerden and Gouda.

facts.text: The line opened between 1855 and 1858, with its western end originally at Rotterdam Maas station.
facts.sourceQuote: The line was opened between 1855 and 1858. The western terminus was originally the Rotterdam Maas station.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The line was opened between 1855 and 1858. The western terminus was originally the Rotterdam Maas station.

facts.text: A 1899 connection linked the route to Delftse Poort, now known as Rotterdam Centraal.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1899, a connection with the Rotterdam Delftse Poort station (the present Rotterdam Centraal station) was made.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1899, a connection with the Rotterdam Delftse Poort station (the present Rotterdam Centraal station) was made.

features.name: Lodewijk Pincoffsbrug
features.opening: De Lodewijk Pincoffsbrug is een ophaalbrug in het stadsdeel Feijenoord van de Nederlandse gemeente Rotterdam.

facts.text: A previous version of this bridge stood for centuries before being demolished in the late 1950s.
facts.sourceQuote: Die brug was een vervanging van de Stokkenbrug die er eeuwen lag; zij werd eind jaren vijftig afgebroken vanwege de bouw van de Rotterdamse Metro.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: That bridge was a replacement for the Stokkenbrug that had been there for centuries; it was demolished in the late 1950s due to the construction of the Rotterdam Metro.

features.name: Sint-Jacobsbrug
features.opening: De Sint-Jacobsbrug is een vaste brug in het centrum van de Nederlandse stad Rotterdam.

facts.text: Originally built around 1960 as a temporary structure, it was later shortened and relocated in 1977.
facts.sourceQuote: De brug is omstreeks 1960 gebouwd als noodbrug op de plaats van de Stokkenbrug in de Schiedamsedijk over de Zalmhaven, die gesloopt was wegens de aanleg van de metro. Nadat in 1977 een nieuwe Stokkenbrug was gebouwd, is de brug in verkorte vorm over het Stokviswater gelegd bij de aanleg van de woningen rondom de Sint-Jacobsplaats.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The bridge was built around 1960 as a temporary bridge on the site of the Stokkenbrug in the Schiedamsedijk over the Zalmhaven, which had been demolished due to the construction of the subway. After a new Stokkenbrug was built in 1977, the bridge was laid in a shortened form over the Stokviswater during the construction of the houses around the Sint-Jacobsplaats.

features.name: Hartelbrug
features.opening: De Hartelbrug of Zoetwaterkanaalbrug is een brug in Nederland die de verbinding vormt tussen de A15 en Spijkenisse, en ligt over zowel het Hartelkanaal als het…

facts.text: A separate bicycle bridge opened in October 2011, freeing the main span for four traffic lanes.
facts.sourceQuote: In april 2010 startte de bouw van een aparte fietsbrug, die op 26 oktober 2011 geopend werd. De overgebleven fietsstrook van de hoofdbrug werd als extra rijstrook aangewend waardoor het verkeer sinds 14 mei 2012 over vier rijstroken (2 in elke richting) beschikt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In April 2010, construction began on a separate bicycle bridge, which was opened on October 26, 2011. The remaining bicycle lane of the main bridge was used as an additional lane, resulting in four lanes (2 in each direction) of traffic since May 14, 2012.

facts.text: The canal widening in the mid-1980s increased the portion of the bridge hanging over water.
facts.sourceQuote: Midden de jaren 80 werd het Hartelkanaal verbreed, echter zonder aan de brug zelf te raken. Het deel van de brug dat over het water hangt nam daardoor toe.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the mid-1980s, the Hartel Canal was widened, but without affecting the bridge itself. As a result, the part of the bridge that hangs over the water increased.

features.name: Willemsbrug
features.opening: The Willemsbrug (English: "William Bridge") is a bridge next to the Erasmusbrug in the centre of Rotterdam, Netherlands, spanning the Nieuwe Maas.

facts.text: Willemsbrug honors King Willem III of the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuote: Veerling and named after King Willem III of the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Veerling and named after King Willem III of the Netherlands.

facts.text: The red cable-stayed span measures about 318 meters long.
facts.sourceQuote: The Willemsbrug is a cable-stayed bridge with a total span of about 318 meters. It is painted in a red color which puts it in sharp contrast with the light blue painted Erasmus Bridge.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Willemsbrug is a cable-stayed bridge with a total span of about 318 meters. It is painted in a red color which puts it in sharp contrast with the light blue painted Erasmus Bridge.

features.name: Meentbrug
features.opening: De Meentbrug is een hefbrug over de Delftsevaart in het centrum van de Nederlandse stad Rotterdam.

facts.text: Minor adjustments were made to the bridge in 1946 following the war.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1946 heeft de brug kleine aanpassingen gekregen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1946, the bridge underwent minor adjustments.

facts.text: Alderman Albertus de Jong announced the construction of this drawbridge in 1927.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1927 kwam de eerste aankondiging van wethouder Albertus de Jong dat er een nieuwe hefbrug over de Delftsevaart zou komen, om zo de straat aan weerszijden te verbinden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1927, alderman Albertus de Jong made the first announcement that a new drawbridge would be built over the Delftsevaart to connect the street on both sides.

facts.text: Sliding stairs allowed pedestrians to cross unhindered when ships needed to pass underneath.
facts.sourceQuote: Deze brug zou voorzien worden van de modernste technieken, waaronder omlaag glijdende trappen die het mogelijk maakte dat de voetgangers ongehinderd hun weg konden vervolgen als de schepen onder de brug door moesten varen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This bridge would be equipped with the most modern techniques, including sliding stairs that made it possible for pedestrians to continue their journey unhindered if the ships had to pass under the bridge.

features.name: Spoorbrug Delfshavense Schie
features.opening: The railway from Amsterdam through Haarlem to Rotterdam (also: Oude Lijn, Dutch for "old line") runs from Amsterdam Centraal to Rotterdam Centraal through…

facts.text: The final section from The Hague to Rotterdam opened in June 1847.
facts.sourceQuote: Leiden and The Hague were reached in 1843, and the final section from The Hague to Rotterdam was opened in June 1847.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Leiden and The Hague were reached in 1843, and the final section from The Hague to Rotterdam was opened in June 1847.

facts.text: Track doubling was completed on 2 August 2024 after a long delay.
facts.sourceQuote: On 2 August 2024 the doubling of the tracks was completed after a long delay.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On 2 August 2024 the doubling of the tracks was completed after a long delay.

facts.text: A new tunnel and station opened in Delft in March 2015 underpassing the old viaduct.
facts.sourceQuote: In March 2015 a new tunnel and station were opened in Delft, underpassing the former railway station and viaduct.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In March 2015 a new tunnel and station were opened in Delft, underpassing the former railway station and viaduct.

facts.text: Since December 2011, the bridge carries all direct trains from Amsterdam to The Hague.
facts.sourceQuote: From December 2011 it is used by all direct trains from Amsterdam to The Hague, and all direct supplement-free trains from Amsterdam to Rotterdam except those through Woerden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From December 2011 it is used by all direct trains from Amsterdam to The Hague, and all direct supplement-free trains from Amsterdam to Rotterdam except those through Woerden.

features.name: Binnenhavenbrug
features.opening: De Binnenhavenbrug is een ophaalbrug in het stadsdeel Feijenoord in de Nederlandse gemeente Rotterdam.

facts.text: The Binnenhavenbrug takes its name directly from the waterway it crosses, the Binnenhaven.
facts.sourceQuote: De brug overspant de Binnenhaven en is daarnaar vernoemd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The bridge spans the Binnenhaven and is named after it.

features.name: Suurhoffbrug
features.opening: De Suurhoffbrug verbindt de beide oevers van het Hartelkanaal in de Nederlandse stad Rotterdam.

facts.text: A temporary arch bridge spanning 200 meters and rising 40 meters was installed alongside the original structure.
facts.sourceQuote: In mei 2021 is een tijdelijke boogbrug van 200 meter lang, 40 meter hoog en 20 meter breed naast de huidige brug geplaatst, zodat de verkeersdruk in de renovatieperiode over twee bruggen verdeeld kan worden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In May 2021, a temporary arch bridge 200 meters long, 40 meters high and 20 meters wide was placed next to the current bridge so that the traffic pressure during the renovation period can be distributed over two bridges.

facts.text: Renovation work scheduled for 2021 and 2022 aimed to extend the bridge's lifespan before a replacement arrives.
facts.sourceQuote: Rijkswaterstaat wil de Suurhoffbrug in 2021 en 2022 renoveren om de levensduur te verlengen, in afwachting van de geplande geheel nieuwe brug.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Rijkswaterstaat wants to renovate the Suurhoffbrug in 2021 and 2022 to extend its lifespan, pending the planned completely new bridge.

facts.text: Ko Suurhoff, the Minister of Transport and Water Affairs who boosted Rotterdam's ports, lends his name to this structure.
facts.sourceQuote: De brug is gebouwd in 1972 en 1973 en werd genoemd naar Ko Suurhoff, de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat die een belangrijk deel heeft bijgedragen aan de ontwikkeling van de havens van Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The bridge was built in 1972 and 1973 and was named after Ko Suurhoff, the Minister of Transport and Water Affairs who contributed significantly to the development of the ports of Rotterdam.

facts.text: Construction took place between 1972 and 1973, earning two prestigious steel awards shortly after completion.
facts.sourceQuote: De brug is gebouwd in 1972 en 1973 en werd genoemd naar Ko Suurhoff, de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat die een belangrijk deel heeft bijgedragen aan de ontwikkeling van de havens van Rotterdam. De Suurhoffbrug verwierf twee staalprijzen, de Nationale Staalprijs in 1974 en later ook de Europese Staalprijs.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The bridge was built in 1972 and 1973 and was named after Ko Suurhoff, the Minister of Transport and Water Affairs who contributed significantly to the development of the ports of Rotterdam. The Suurhoffbrug won two steel awards, the National Steel Award in 1974 and later also the European Steel Award.

features.name: Piekbrug
features.opening: De Piekbrug is een ophaalbrug in het stadsdeel Feijenoord van de Nederlandse gemeente Rotterdam, en is onderdeel van de Piekstraat.

facts.text: The name Piekbrug honors the Piek family, who once owned parts of Feijenoord.
facts.sourceQuote: De naam Piek is afkomstig van een familie Piek, die in vroeger tijden een deel van Feijenoord in haar bezit had (en in bezit was van het Koepeltje van Piek).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name Piek comes from a Piek family, which in the past owned part of Feijenoord (and owned the Koepeltje van Piek).

facts.text: A single hamei pillar stands out as a remarkable architectural feature.
facts.sourceQuote: Opvallend aan de brug is de enkelvoudige hameipijler.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Remarkable about the bridge is the single hamei pillar.

features.name: Hofbogen
features.opening: Het Hofpleinlijnviaduct (ook wel de De Hofbogen) is een 1,9 kilometer lang buiten gebruik gesteld spoorwegviaduct in Rotterdam-Noord.

facts.text: Built between 1904 and 1908, it was the first large reinforced concrete construction in the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Hofpleinlijnviaduct is de eerste grote constructie van gewapend beton in Nederland en werd gebouwd tussen 1904 en 1908.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Hofpleinlijnviaduct is the first large construction of reinforced concrete in the Netherlands and was built between 1904 and 1908.

facts.text: Rail service ended in June 2006, with RandstadRail ceasing operations on August 16, 2010.
facts.sourceQuote: In juni 2006 is de treindienst van de Nederlandse Spoorwegen over het viaduct opgeheven. Tot 16 augustus 2010 reed RandstadRail nog over het Hofpleinlijnviaduct, waarbij op station Bergweg niet meer werd gestopt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In June 2006, the train service of the Dutch Railways was discontinued over the viaduct. Until August 16, 2010, RandstadRail still ran over the Hofpleinlijnviaduct, with no more stops at Bergweg station.

facts.text: Although designed as open arches, business spaces were rented underneath them as early as 1909.
facts.sourceQuote: Het viaduct telt 189 bogen die oorspronkelijk open zouden blijven, maar al in 1909 was een goed deel van de ruimtes onder de bogen als bedrijfsruimte verhuurd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The viaduct has 189 arches that were originally intended to remain open, but as early as 1909 a large part of the spaces under the arches had already been rented out as business space.

facts.text: Parts of the viaduct lacking monument status were demolished in May 2011.
facts.sourceQuote: De meer recente delen van het viaduct over de spoorlijn naar Utrecht en de A20, die geen monumentenstatus genoten, werden in mei 2011 gesloopt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The more recent parts of the viaduct over the railway line to Utrecht and the A20, which did not enjoy monument status, were demolished in May 2011.

features.name: Dintelhavenbrug
features.opening: De Dintelhavenbrug verbindt de beide oevers van de Dintelhaven in de Nederlandse stad Rotterdam, over de autobrug loopt de A15.

facts.text: A separate railway bridge named Dintelhavenspoorbrug runs alongside the main car crossing.
facts.sourceQuote: Naast de autobrug bevindt zicht een spoorbrug, de Dintelhavenspoorbrug.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Next to the car bridge is a railway bridge, the Dintelhavenspoorbrug.

facts.text: A temporary pontoon bridge stood west of the current site during 1960s Europoort construction.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens de aanleg van de Europoort in de jaren 60 lag er ten westen van de huidige brug een tijdelijke pontonbrug over wat toen de binnenhaven heette.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the construction of the Europoort in the 1960s, there was a temporary pontoon bridge west of the current bridge over what was then called the inner harbor.

facts.text: The 1964 replacement featured four spans and a wide central pier instead of the old pontoon.
facts.sourceQuote: De pontonbrug werd in 1964 vervangen door een oostelijker gelegen vaste vakwerkbrug met vier overspanningen en een brede middenpijler.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The pontoon bridge was replaced in 1964 by a fixed truss bridge located further east with four spans and a wide central pier.

facts.text: Traffic capacity was limited to one railway track and a single lane per direction.
facts.sourceQuote: Over deze brug liep slechts één spoorbaan en een rijstrook per richting.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Only one railway track and one lane per direction ran over this bridge.

features.name: Wezenbrug
features.opening: De Wezenbrug (voor de oorlog de Weezenbrug genoemd) is een vaste brug over de Steigersgracht in de Nederlandse stad Rotterdam.

facts.text: The Wezenbrug takes its name from creatures living in the nearby Sint Anthonisgasthuis orphanage.
facts.section: De Wezenbrug voor de Tweede Wereldoorlog
facts.sourceQuote: De Wezenbrug, die voor de oorlog bekend stond als de Weezenbrug, was vernoemd naar de wezen die zich in het oudst bekende weeshuis van de stad bevonden, het oude Sint Anthonisgasthuis, dat in deze buurt ten zuiden van de Hoogstraat stond.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Wezenbrug, which was known as the Weezenbrug before the war, was named after the creatures that lived in the oldest known orphanage in the city, the old Sint Anthonisgasthuis, which was located in this neighborhood south of the Hoogstraat.

facts.text: A steamboat named Rotterdam sank under the bridge during high water in 1877.
facts.section: De Wezenbrug voor de Tweede Wereldoorlog
facts.sourceQuote: In 1877 kwam bij gevaarlijk hoog water de stoomboot Rotterdam klem te zitten onder de Weezenbrug en zonk. Het schip werd op 28 december gelicht. Door de aanvaring liep de brug aanzienlijke schade op: er waren meerdere scheuren en gaten in het metselwerk ontstaan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1877, during dangerously high water, the steamboat Rotterdam became stuck under the Weezenbrug and sank. The ship was set on fire on December 28. As a result of the collision, the bridge suffered significant damage: there were several cracks and holes in the masonry.

facts.text: A 1940 bombing damaged its railing and road, yet the council chose demolition over repair.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens het bombardement op de binnenstad op 14 mei 1940 raakte de brug licht beschadigd. Een gedeelte van de leuning aan de kant van de Weezenstraat werd geraakt, evenals een stuk van de weg richting de Keizerstraat. Ondanks dat de Weezenbrug gerepareerd had kunnen worden, besloot de gemeenteraad om het toch te slopen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the bombing of the city center on May 14, 1940, the bridge was slightly damaged. A part of the railing on the side of Weezenstraat was damaged, as well as a section of the road towards Keizerstraat. Despite the fact that the Weezenbrug could have been repaired, the municipal council decided to demolish it anyway.

facts.text: By late 1943, reports confirmed the new bridge construction was nearly finished.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1943 werd door het Rotterdamsch Nieuwsblad vermeld dat de constructie van de nieuwe Weezenbrug al bijna klaar was.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1943, the Rotterdamsch Nieuwsblad reported that the construction of the new Weezen Bridge was almost complete.

features.name: Grote Wijnbrug
features.opening: De Grote Wijnbrug is een ophaalbrug in het het centrum van de Nederlandse stad Rotterdam.

facts.text: Grote Wijnbrug owes its name partly to the missing Little Wijnbrug.
facts.sourceQuote: Haar naam dankt ze gedeeltelijk aan de verdwenen Kleine Wijnbrug.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: She owes her name partly to the missing Little Wijnbrug.

facts.text: In the seventeenth century, this structure was also called Satersbrug and Duvelsbrug.
facts.sourceQuote: In de 17de eeuw werd deze brug ook wel Satersbrug en Duvelsbrug genoemd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the 17th century, this bridge was also known as Satersbrug and Duvelsbrug.

features.name: Botlekbrug
features.opening: De Botlekbrug is een hefbrug voor weg- en spoorverkeer over de Oude Maas in het Rotterdams havengebied.

facts.text: A sea tanker collided with the old bridge just before delivery and also struck the new one.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 26 februari 2015, nog voor de oplevering van de nieuwe brug, voer een zeetanker tegen de oude lage brug aan. Daarbij zwenkte de tanker en raakte ook de nieuwe brug.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On February 26, 2015, just before the delivery of the new bridge, a sea tanker collided with the old low bridge. The tanker also swayed and hit the new bridge.

facts.text: The original structure opened in 1955 before being replaced by a completely new bridge in 2015.
facts.sourceQuote: De brug werd in 1955 geopend om de Botlek te ontsluiten en is in 2015 vervangen door een geheel nieuwe brug.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The bridge was opened in 1955 to bypass the Botlek and was replaced in 2015 by a completely new bridge.

facts.text: Current operations feature two road lanes for both directions alongside one rail track per direction.
facts.sourceQuote: Sindsdien zijn er voor wegverkeer in beide richtingen twee rijstroken, terwijl het treinverkeer voor elke richting één spoor krijgt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since then, there have been two lanes for road traffic in both directions, while train traffic receives one track for each direction.

features.name: Rolbrug bij Huis te Riviere
features.opening: De Rolbrug bij Huis te Riviere is een rolbrug over de Nederlandse waterloop Schiedamse Schie.

facts.text: The municipality of Schiedam commissioned Irado to restore the Rolbrug bij Huis te Riviere in 2022.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2022 heeft de gemeente Schiedam opdracht gegeven aan Irado om de Rolbrug te restaureren.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2022, the municipality of Schiedam commissioned Irado to restore the Rolbrug.

facts.text: A complete reconstruction was necessary because all steel beams had to be replaced due to poor condition.
facts.sourceQuote: Hier bleek dat de brug in zeer slechte staat verkeerde, er was een complete reconstructie noodzakelijk. Alle stalen balken werden vervangen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It turned out here that the bridge was in very poor condition, a complete reconstruction was necessary. All steel beams were replaced.

facts.text: Tolls were charged on this bridge until 1940.
facts.sourceQuote: Tot 1940 werd op deze brug tol geheven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Until 1940, tolls were charged on this bridge.

facts.text: The ferry house near the bridge disappeared in 1974.
facts.sourceQuote: Het veerhuis bij de brug verdween in 1974.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The ferry house near the bridge disappeared in 1974.

features.name: Hoge Brug
features.opening: De Hoge Brug is een stalen ophaalbrug over de Delfshavense Schie, in de deelgemeente Overschie in de Nederlandse gemeente Rotterdam.

facts.text: A wooden predecessor stood here in 1390 before being replaced by another wooden structure in 1579.
facts.sourceQuote: Op de plaats van de Hoge Brug ligt al sinds 1390 een brug. De eerste brug was een houten brug, die in 1579 werd vervangen door een nieuwe houten brug.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A bridge has been located on the site of the Hoge Brug since 1390. The first bridge was a wooden bridge, which was replaced in 1579 by a new wooden bridge.

facts.text: South Holland built a new waterway to bypass the sharp right-angle bends near the bridge.
facts.sourceQuote: De provincie Zuid-Holland heeft daarom een nieuwe vaargeul aangelegd, waarmee de twee haakse bochten in de Delftse Schie verdwijnen. De nieuwe vaargeul loopt vanaf de Hoge Brug via de dijk langs het bedrijventerrein Rotterdam Noord-West naar de Doenbrug.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The province of South Holland has therefore built a new waterway, with which the two right-angle bends in the Delft Schie disappear. The new waterway runs from the Hoge Brug via the dike along the Rotterdam North-West business park to the Doenbrug.

features.name: Jan Kuitenbrug
features.opening: De Jan Kuitenbrug is een basculebrug over de Oude Haven en de Wijnhaven in het centrum van de Nederlandse stad Rotterdam.

facts.text: The current structure replaced an older bridge in 1931 after construction began in 1928.
facts.sourceQuote: De huidige brug stamt uit 1931 en verving de oude brug ter plaatse, nadat bouwwerkzaamheden in 1928 waren begonnen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The current bridge dates back to 1931 and replaced the old bridge on site, after construction work began in 1928.

facts.text: Engineer L. Pieters designed this span for the Gemeentewerken Rotterdam firm.
facts.sourceQuote: De huidige brug is ontworpen door L. Pieters van het ingenieursbureau Gemeentewerken Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The current bridge was designed by L. Pieters from the engineering firm Gemeentewerken Rotterdam.

facts.text: A predecessor bridge stood at this location as early as the year 1610.
facts.sourceQuote: Het is een van de oudste bruggen in de stad: al in 1610 lag er hier een brug.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is one of the oldest bridges in the city: there was already a bridge here in 1610.

facts.text: Local authorities have officially designated this bridge as a municipal monument.
facts.sourceQuote: De brug is een gemeentelijk monument.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The bridge is a municipal monument.

features.name: Krattenbrug
features.opening: De Krattenbrug is een vaste brug over de Delftsevaart in de Nederlandse stad Rotterdam.

facts.text: Before becoming Krattenbrug, the structure was known as Bagijnenbrug.
facts.sourceQuote: De Krattenbrug heette voor de naamswijziging de Bagijnenbrug.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Before the name change, the Krattenbrug was called the Bagijnenbrug.

facts.text: Pedestrian access slowed significantly during restoration work on the bridge in 1903.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1903 was het voetgangersverkeer gestremd wegens restauratiewerkzaamheden aan de brug.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1903, pedestrian traffic was slowed down due to restoration work on the bridge.

facts.text: German occupiers officially withdrew the name Krattenbrug on June 30, 1942.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1942 werd besloten om de naam 'Krattenbrug' in te trekken, vermoedelijk op besluit van de Duitse bezetter. Dit besluit was op 30 juni ingegaan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1942, it was decided to withdraw the name 'Krattenbrug', presumably at the decision of the German occupiers. This decision had entered into force on June 30.

features.name: Philips Willembrug
features.opening: De Philips Willembrug is een brug in de Nederlandse stad Rotterdam, in de wijk Hillegersberg.

facts.text: Car traffic was banned in 2009 after research revealed its poor technical condition.
facts.sourceQuote: Omdat bij onderzoek in 2008 bleek dat de brug technisch in slechte staat was, werd de brug in 2009 voor het autoverkeer afgesloten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Because research in 2008 showed that the bridge was technically in poor condition, the bridge was closed to car traffic in 2009.

features.name: Kandelaarbrug
features.opening: De Kandelaarbrug is een ophaalbrug voor voetgangers en fietsers, over de Delftse Schie, in de Nederlandse provincie Zuid-Holland.

facts.text: Candelabra used to stand here to illuminate ships docking in the dark.
facts.sourceQuote: Ze verwijzen naar de kandelaar die hier vroeger stond ter verlichting van de schepen die in het donker afmeerden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: They refer to the candelabra that used to stand here to illuminate the ships that docked in the dark.

facts.text: Hydraulic cylinders located beneath the deck power its lifting mechanism.
facts.sourceQuote: De ophaalbrug wordt hydraulisch aangedreven door een cilinder onder het brugdek.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The lifting bridge is hydraulically driven by a cylinder under the bridge deck.

features.name: André van der Louwbrug
features.opening: De André van der Louwbrug is een kokerbrug over de Scheepmakershaven en de Wijnhaven in het centrum van de Nederlandse stad Rotterdam.

facts.text: Tram traffic first used the bridge on September 28, 1963.
facts.sourceQuote: Met de bouw van de Verlengde Willemsbrug werd in 1962 begonnen en al op 28 september 1963 ging de brug open voor het tramverkeer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Construction of the Extended Willems Bridge began in 1962 and the bridge opened to tram traffic on September 28, 1963.

facts.text: Construction was subcontracted to Hollandsche Beton Maatschappij for over a million guilders.
facts.sourceQuote: De bouw van de brug werd uitbesteed aan de Hollandsche Beton Maatschappij en kostte in totaal 1.131.000 gulden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The construction of the bridge was subcontracted to the Hollandsche Beton Maatschappij and cost a total of 1,131,000 guilders.

facts.text: The municipality renamed it in 2015 after former mayor André van der Louw.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2015 heeft de gemeente Rotterdam de brug de naam André van der Louwbrug gegeven, vernoemd naar André van der Louw, oud-burgemeester van Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2015, the municipality of Rotterdam gave the bridge the name André van der Louwbrug, named after André van der Louw, former mayor of Rotterdam.

features.name: De Hef
features.opening: De Hef (lit.

facts.text: A 1927 rebuild replaced an earlier swing bridge that blocked shipping after a 1918 collision.
facts.sourceQuote: Its configuration as a swing bridge proved an obstacle to shipping (the most notable incident occurring in 1918, when the bridge was struck by the German vessel Kandelfels), and it was replaced by a lift bridge in 1927.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Its configuration as a swing bridge proved an obstacle to shipping (the most notable incident occurring in 1918, when the bridge was struck by the German vessel Kandelfels), and it was replaced by a lift bridge in 1927.

facts.text: Filmmaker Joris Ivens captured the bridge's operation in his 1928 movie titled De brug.
facts.sourceQuote: The bridge was the subject of a 1928 film by Joris Ivens, titled De brug.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The bridge was the subject of a 1928 film by Joris Ivens, titled De brug.

features.name: Puntbrug
features.opening: De Puntbrug is een klapbrug in het het centrum van de Nederlandse stad Rotterdam.

facts.text: The Puntbrug takes its name from the specific point of land it connects.
facts.sourceQuote: De brug is vernoemd naar die punt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The bridge is named after that point.

features.name: Doenbrug
features.opening: De Doenbrug is een basculebrug over de Delftse Schie in de deelgemeente Overschie van de Nederlandse gemeente Rotterdam.

facts.text: Built in 1988, the bridge opened access to the Rotterdam North-West business park.
facts.sourceQuote: De Doenbrug stamt uit 1988 en is gebouwd ter ontsluiting van het bedrijventerrein Rotterdam Noord-West.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Doenbrug dates back to 1988 and was built to open up the Rotterdam North-West business park.

facts.text: Traffic from the Spanish Polder connects via this structure to the A13 highway near Zestienhoven airport.
facts.sourceQuote: Via de Doenbrug heeft het verkeer uit de Spaanse Polder en het bedrijvenpark Noord-west een aansluiting op de A13 nabij vliegveld Zestienhoven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Via the Doenbrug, traffic from the Spanish Polder and the North-west business park has a connection to the A13 near Zestienhoven airport.

features.name: Koninginnebrug
features.opening: De Koninginnebrug is een brug over de Koningshaven in de Nederlandse stad Rotterdam, naast De Hef.

facts.text: The original Koninginnebrug opened in 1870 as a revolving bridge.
facts.sourceQuote: De eerste Koninginnebrug was een draaibrug die werd gebouwd in 1870.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first Koninginnebrug was a revolving bridge built in 1870.

facts.text: After fifty years, the structure blocked shipping and could not handle trams.
facts.sourceQuote: Na vijftig jaar was de brug een belemmering voor zowel de scheepvaart- als wegverkeer; ze was ook niet geschikt voor trams.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After fifty years, the bridge was a hindrance to both shipping and road traffic; it was also not suitable for trams.

facts.text: Construction started in 1927 before the bridge officially opened on June 14, 1929.
facts.sourceQuote: Met de bouw werd in 1927 begonnen, De nieuwe brug werd op 14 juni 1929 door minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Landbouw Kan geopend.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Construction began in 1927, and the new bridge was officially opened on June 14, 1929, by the Minister of the Interior and Agriculture, Kan.

facts.text: Trams stopped running over it in 1968 after the north-south metro line opened.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds het gereedkomen van de Noord-zuidlijn van de Rotterdamse metro in 1968 rijden er geen trams meer over de Koninginnebrug.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since the opening of the north-south line of the Rotterdam metro in 1968, there have been no trams running over the Koninginnebrug.

features.name: Calandbrug
features.opening: The Calandbrug is a road and former railroad bridge over the Caland Canal in the port of Rotterdam in the Dutch municipality of Rotterdam.

facts.text: A wind barrier was added in 1985 because high vehicles could not pass through during strong winds.
facts.sourceQuote: As the Brittanniëhaven has to be reached by car transporters with high superstructures, which could no longer pass through the 46-metre-wide opening of the bridge in strong winds, the port authority had a 1.8-kilometre-long and 25-metre-high partially permeable wind barrier built on the west side of the bridge in 1985.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: As the Brittanniëhaven has to be reached by car transporters with high superstructures, which could no longer pass through the 46-metre-wide opening of the bridge in strong winds, the port authority had a 1.8-kilometre-long and 25-metre-high partially permeable wind barrier built on the west side of the bridge in 1985.

facts.text: Pieter Caland designed the Nieuwe Waterweg, launching Rotterdam's rise as a global seaport.
facts.section: Europoort and Caland Canal in the 1960s
facts.sourceQuote: Pieter Caland, who gave his name to the bridge and the canal it crosses, laid the foundation for the development of the port of Rotterdam into one of the largest seaports in the world with the design and construction of the Nieuwe Waterweg at the end of the 19th century.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Pieter Caland, who gave his name to the bridge and the canal it crosses, laid the foundation for the development of the port of Rotterdam into one of the largest seaports in the world with the design and construction of the Nieuwe Waterweg at the end of the 19th century.

facts.text: The parallel Caland Canal allowed ships with a 21-meter draught to reach the port regardless of tide.
facts.section: Europoort and Caland Canal in the 1960s
facts.sourceQuote: To enable the large oil tankers to access the Europoort deep-water port, the Euro-Maasgeul was built by the early 1970s and the Caland Canal was built as an extension parallel to the Nieuwe Waterweg, allowing ships with a draught of up to 21 meters to reach the port regardless of the tide.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: To enable the large oil tankers to access the Europoort deep-water port, the Euro-Maasgeul was built by the early 1970s and the Caland Canal was built as an extension parallel to the Nieuwe Waterweg, allowing ships with a draught of up to 21 meters to reach the port regardless of the tide.

features.name: Rederijbrug
features.opening: De Rederijbrug is een basculebrug in het het centrum van de Nederlandse stad Rotterdam.

facts.text: The current movable structure replaced a permanent stone bridge in 1951.
facts.sourceQuote: Rond 1900 werd een vaste stenen brug gebouwd ter vervanging van de Grote Draaibrug, die tussen 1613 en 1902 de Scheepmakershaven enkele tientallen meters oostelijker overspande. In 1951 is deze vervangen door de huidige beweegbare brug.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Around 1900, a permanent stone bridge was built to replace the Great Swing Bridge, which spanned the Scheepmakershaven a few dozen meters east of it between 1613 and 1902. In 1951, this was replaced by the current movable bridge.

facts.text: A Great Swing Bridge previously spanned the water just east of this spot from 1613 to 1902.
facts.sourceQuote: Rond 1900 werd een vaste stenen brug gebouwd ter vervanging van de Grote Draaibrug, die tussen 1613 en 1902 de Scheepmakershaven enkele tientallen meters oostelijker overspande.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Around 1900, a permanent stone bridge was built to replace the Great Swing Bridge, which spanned the Scheepmakershaven a few dozen meters east of it between 1613 and 1902.

features.name: Nassaubrug
features.opening: De Nassaubrug is een ophaalbrug in het stadsdeel Feijenoord van de Nederlandse gemeente Rotterdam.

facts.text: During World War II, German occupiers briefly changed its name to Philips Willemsbrug.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens de Duitse bezetting in de Tweede Wereldoorlog werd de naam 'gecorrigeerd' naar "Philips Willemsbrug".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the German occupation in World War II, the name was "corrected" to "Philips Willemsbrug".

facts.text: In 1990, the original wooden road surface was finally replaced with aluminum.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1990 werd het wegdek, dat nog van hout was, vervangen door aluminium.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1990, the road surface, which was still made of wood, was replaced with aluminum.

features.name: Pieter de Hoochbrug
features.opening: De Pieter de Hoochbrug is een dubbele basculebrug uit 1932 in het stadsdeel Delfshaven in de Nederlandse gemeente Rotterdam.

facts.text: The Pieter de Hoochbrug honors the Rotterdam painter Pieter de Hooch.
facts.sourceQuote: De brug is vernoemd naar de Rotterdamse kunstschilder Pieter de Hooch.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The bridge is named after the Rotterdam art painter Pieter de Hooch.

facts.text: Only the southern bascule section opens while barriers sit on the northern deck.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij de renovatie zijn de slagbomen aan de noordelijke zijde van de brug op het brugdek van de noordelijke basculebrug geplaatst. Alleen de zuidelijke basculebrug wordt nog geopend.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the renovation, the barriers were placed on the northern side of the bridge on the bridge deck of the northern bascule bridge. Only the southern bascule bridge is still being opened.

facts.text: The War Resistance Museum has occupied the space beneath the bridge since 2008.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan de kant van het metrostation bevindt zich sinds 3 april 2008 onder de brug het OorlogsVerzetsMuseum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since April 3, 2008, the War Resistance Museum has been located under the bridge on the side of the metro station.

features.name: Erasmus Bridge
features.opening: The Erasmusbrug (English: "Erasmus Bridge") is a combined cable-stayed and bascule bridge.

facts.text: Strong winds caused the structure to swing, requiring installation of shock dampers shortly after opening.
facts.sourceQuote: Shortly after the bridge opened to traffic in October 1996, it was discovered the bridge would swing under particularly strong wind conditions. To reduce the trembling, stronger shock dampers were installed.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Shortly after the bridge opened to traffic in October 1996, it was discovered the bridge would swing under particularly strong wind conditions. To reduce the trembling, stronger shock dampers were installed.

facts.text: Queen Beatrix officially opened the bridge on September 6, 1996.
facts.sourceQuote: Costing over €165 million to construct, the bridge was officially opened by Queen Beatrix on September 6, 1996.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Costing over €165 million to construct, the bridge was officially opened by Queen Beatrix on September 6, 1996.

facts.text: Back stays were added to the pylon after engineers realized trucks would cause dangerous bending forces.
facts.sourceQuote: Most importantly, live loads, like 60-ton trucks, would introduce tremendous bending forces into the backward leaning pylon; therefore back stays were added to minimize bending forces.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Most importantly, live loads, like 60-ton trucks, would introduce tremendous bending forces into the backward leaning pylon; therefore back stays were added to minimize bending forces.

facts.text: Architect Ben van Berkel proposed the design in 1990, inspired by the Alamillo Bridge in Seville.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1990, one of the review architects, Ben van Berkel, revealed his own design, which was similar to the one Santiago Calatrava used for the Alamillo Bridge in Sevilla, Spain: a single pylon positioned on one side of the river with a backward lean.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1990, one of the review architects, Ben van Berkel, revealed his own design, which was similar to the one Santiago Calatrava used for the Alamillo Bridge in Sevilla, Spain: a single pylon positioned on one side of the river with a backward lean.

features.name: Beukelsbrug
features.opening: De Beukelsbrug is een stalen basculebrug over de Delfshavense Schie in Delfshaven, een deelgemeente van de Nederlandse gemeente Rotterdam.

facts.text: A ferry served this crossing before the bridge opened in 1966.
facts.sourceQuote: Vóór de opening van deze brug was er een veerverbinding. De Beukelsbrug is in 1966 geopend en vormt de verbinding tussen de Beukelsweg en de Aelbrechtskade in het Nieuwe Westen en de Horvathweg naar Schiedam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Before the opening of this bridge, there was a ferry connection. The Beukelsbrug was opened in 1966 and forms the connection between the Beukelsweg and the Aelbrechtskade in the Nieuwe Westen and the Horvathweg to Schiedam.

facts.text: A wide central median was once planned for a tram that never arrived.
facts.sourceQuote: De brug heeft een brede middenberm die ooit voor een tramverbinding is bedacht. Deze verbinding is echter nooit aangelegd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The bridge has a wide central median that was once conceived for a tram connection. However, this connection was never established.

features.name: Spaansebrug
features.opening: De Spaanse Brug is een stalen ophaalbrug over de Delfshavense Schie, in de deelgemeente Overschie van de Nederlandse gemeente Rotterdam.

facts.text: The old bridge served as a prop in episode 8 of the Dutch series De Kroon.
facts.sourceQuote: De oude Spaanse Brug werd gebruikt als decor in aflevering 8 van De Kroon.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The old Spaanse Brug was used as a prop in episode 8 of De Kroon.

facts.text: Parts of the original bridge were reused from the Pakkenbrug in Rotterdam's center.
facts.sourceQuote: De Spaanse Brug was bij de opening niet nieuw: onderdelen van de brug waren afkomstig van de Pakkenbrug over de Nieuwe Haven in het centrum van Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Spaanse Brug was not new at the opening: parts of the bridge came from the Pakkenbrug over the Nieuwe Haven in the center of Rotterdam.

facts.text: The upper structure collapsed in 1959 after a hinge loosened due to creeping.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 22 oktober 1959 is de bovenbouw van de Spaanse Brug ingestort nadat de scharnieras door kruipen was losgekomen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On October 22, 1959, the upper structure of the Spaanse Brug collapsed after the hinge had come loose due to creeping.

features.name: Regentessebrug
features.opening: De Regentessebrug is een vaste brug in de Nederlandse stad Rotterdam.

facts.text: In March 1940, traffic was restricted to one-way flow from Posthoornsteeg only.
facts.section: De brug voor de Tweede Wereldoorlog
facts.sourceQuote: In maart 1940, twee maanden voor het bombardement, werd besloten om van het verkeer bij de Regentessebrug eenrichtingsverkeer te maken. Alleen verkeer komend vanuit de Posthoornsteeg mocht nog de brug over.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In March 1940, two months before the bombing, it was decided to make traffic at Regentessebrug one-way traffic. Only traffic coming from Posthoornsteeg was allowed to cross the bridge.

facts.text: Some captains disliked the bridge because land traffic took priority over water traffic.
facts.section: De brug voor de Tweede Wereldoorlog
facts.sourceQuote: De Regentessebrug speelde een belangrijke rol in het verbinden van de Blaak en de Boompjes, maar was minder geliefd onder sommige schippers, omdat die vonden dat bij de bediening van de nieuwe brug het verkeer boven land voorrang kreeg op het verkeer te water.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Regentessebrug played an important role in connecting the Blaak and the Boompjes, but was less popular with some captains, because they felt that when operating the new bridge, land traffic was given priority over water traffic.

facts.text: Post-war reconstruction plans explicitly protected the structure from demolition.
facts.section: De brug tijdens de Tweede Wereldoorlog
facts.sourceQuote: De Regentessebrug in zowel het Wederopbouwplan van Willem Gerrit Witteveen als het Basisplan van Cornelis van Traa opgenomen, en is op deze manier behoed voor de sloop.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Regentessebrug was included in both Willem Gerrit Witteveen's Reconstruction Plan and Cornelis van Traa's Basic Plan, and was thus protected from demolition in this way.

features.name: Beneluxlijn
features.opening: Beneluxlijn is de naam die gegeven werd aan een groot uitbreidingsproject van de Rotterdamse metro.

facts.text: Final costs ended up 60 million euros lower than the original 724 million estimate.
facts.sourceQuote: De kosten werden geraamd op 724 miljoen euro, waarvan het rijk 95% op zich nam. De reële kosten zouden uiteindelijk zo'n 60 miljoen euro lager uitvallen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The costs were estimated at 724 million euros, of which the government took over 95%. The actual costs would ultimately be about 60 million euros lower.

facts.text: The name Beneluxlijn comes from the second Benelux tunnel built alongside the metro line.
facts.sourceQuote: De naam is afgeleid van de tweede Beneluxtunnel, waarvan de lijn gebruikmaakt en die tegelijk met de aanleg van de metrolijn werd gebouwd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name is derived from the second Benelux tunnel, of which the line uses and which was built at the same time as the construction of the metro line.

facts.text: Since November 4, 2002, the route has been part of the Caland Line and the name Beneluxlijn is no longer used.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds de opening op 4 november 2002 maakt het traject deel uit van de Calandlijn en wordt de naam Beneluxlijn al niet meer gevoerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since its opening on November 4, 2002, the route has been part of the Caland Line and the name Beneluxlijn has no longer been used.

facts.text: The line operates using 750 volts of electricity supplied through a third rail.
facts.sourceQuote: De lijn wordt bereden met een elektrische spanning van 750 volt, gevoed via een derde rail.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The line is operated with an electric voltage of 750 volts, supplied via a third rail.

features.name: Oude Lijn
features.opening: The railway from Amsterdam through Haarlem to Rotterdam (also: Oude Lijn, Dutch for "old line") runs from Amsterdam Centraal to Rotterdam Centraal through…

facts.text: The final stretch from The Hague to Rotterdam opened in June 1847.
facts.sourceQuote: Leiden and The Hague were reached in 1843, and the final section from The Hague to Rotterdam was opened in June 1847.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Leiden and The Hague were reached in 1843, and the final section from The Hague to Rotterdam was opened in June 1847.

facts.text: A new tunnel and station underpassing the old viaduct opened in Delft in March 2015.
facts.sourceQuote: In March 2015 a new tunnel and station were opened in Delft, underpassing the former railway station and viaduct.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In March 2015 a new tunnel and station were opened in Delft, underpassing the former railway station and viaduct.

facts.text: Track doubling was finally completed on August 2, 2024, after a long delay.
facts.sourceQuote: On 2 August 2024 the doubling of the tracks was completed after a long delay.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On 2 August 2024 the doubling of the tracks was completed after a long delay.

facts.text: The Dutch name Oude Lijn translates directly to "old line".
facts.sourceQuote: The railway from Amsterdam through Haarlem to Rotterdam (also: Oude Lijn, Dutch for "old line") runs from Amsterdam Centraal to Rotterdam Centraal through Haarlem and The Hague.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The railway from Amsterdam through Haarlem to Rotterdam (also: Oude Lijn, Dutch for "old line") runs from Amsterdam Centraal to Rotterdam Centraal through Haarlem and The Hague.

facts.text: Since December 2011, the route carries all direct trains from Amsterdam to The Hague.
facts.sourceQuote: From December 2011 it is used by all direct trains from Amsterdam to The Hague, and all direct supplement-free trains from Amsterdam to Rotterdam except those through Woerden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From December 2011 it is used by all direct trains from Amsterdam to The Hague, and all direct supplement-free trains from Amsterdam to Rotterdam except those through Woerden.

features.name: Noorderbrug
features.opening: De Noorderbrug in de Nederlandse stad Rotterdam is een brug over de Rotte ter hoogte van het Noordplein.

facts.text: A second bridge built in 1912 used parts from this structure before being replaced in 1956.
facts.sourceQuote: De Zaagmolenbrug werd in 1912 een paar honderd meter stroomopwaarts, ter hoogte van de Crooswijksestraat, opgebouwd uit delen van de tweede Noorderbrug (maar in 1956 vervangen).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Zaagmolen Bridge was built in 1912 a few hundred meters upstream, at the Crooswijksestraat, from parts of the second Noorderbrug (but replaced in 1956).

facts.text: Engineers designed five spans to let inland vessels pass without any movable bridge parts.
facts.sourceQuote: Er zijn vijf overspanningen, waarvan vier getoogd. Het was destijds de bedoeling dat binnenvaartschepen ongehinderd konden doorvaren, zonder toepassing van beweegbare onderdelen in de brug.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There are five spans, four of which are reinforced. At that time, it was intended that inland vessels could pass through unhindered, without the application of movable parts in the bridge.

facts.text: A Heineken brewery branch stood nearby from 1874 until moving to Zoeterwoude in 1968.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan de Linkerrottekade langs de rivier staat op de hoek van de Crooswijksesingel sinds 1874 de Rotterdamse vestiging van de oorspronkelijk Amsterdamse Heinekenbrouwerij. Ruimtegebrek en de slechte bereikbaarheid midden in de snel groeiende stad noopten in 1968 Heineken zijn brouwerij te verplaatsen naar Zoeterwoude.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 1874, the Rotterdam branch of the originally Amsterdam Heineken Brewery has been located on the Linkerrottekade along the river at the corner of the Crooswijksesingel. Lack of space and poor accessibility in the middle of the rapidly growing city forced Heineken to relocate its brewery to Zoeterwoude in 1968.

features.name: Lage Erfbrug
features.opening: De Lage Erfbrug is een stalen basculebrug over de Delfshavense Schie, in de deelgemeente Delfshaven in de Nederlandse gemeente Rotterdam.

facts.text: The original bridge was constructed in 1926 during the excavation of the Coolhaven.
facts.sourceQuote: De Lage Erfbrug is gebouwd in 1926 toen de Coolhaven werd gegraven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Lage Erfbrug was built in 1926 when the Coolhaven was dug.

features.name: Spijkenisserbrug
features.opening: De Spijkenisserbrug is een verkeersbrug over de Oude Maas tussen de Nederlandse plaatsen Hoogvliet en Spijkenisse.

facts.text: Plans for the bridge emerged around 1880, but complex decisions delayed construction for two decades.
facts.sourceQuote: De eerste plannen voor een brug kwamen er rond 1880. De besluitvorming was echter complex en er waren vele kwesties op te lossen, waardoor het zo'n twintig jaar duurde voordat de brug gebouwd kon worden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first plans for a bridge came around 1880. However, the decision-making was complex and there were many issues to be solved, which took about twenty years before the bridge could be built.

features.name: RDM Campus
features.opening: De RDM Campus is een campus op het terrein van de voormalige Rotterdamsche Droogdok Maatschappij (RDM), midden in de Rotterdamse Stadshavens.

facts.text: Technical students from Rotterdam University of Applied Sciences began classes here in February 2009.
facts.sourceQuote: In februari 2009 zijn de eerste studenten van de technische opleidingen van de Hogeschool Rotterdam gestart op de campus.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In February 2009, the first students of the technical programs of the Rotterdam University of Applied Sciences started on campus.

facts.text: Students from Albeda College joined the campus just one month later in March 2009.
facts.sourceQuote: In maart 2009 volgden ook studenten van het Albeda College.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In March 2009, students from Albeda College also followed.

facts.text: Bus line 68 made RDM Campus its terminal point starting December 14, 2014.
facts.sourceQuote: Maar sinds 14 december 2014 heeft deze lijn zijn eindpunt hier.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: But since December 14, 2014, this line has its terminal point here.

facts.text: Aqualiner opened a station here in 2008 to connect the site with Rotterdam center.
facts.sourceQuote: De campus is rechtstreeks bereikbaar vanuit het centrum van Rotterdam (Willemskade) met OV te water en een in 2008 geopende halte van de Aqualiner.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The campus is directly accessible from the center of Rotterdam (Willemskade) by water transport and a station opened in 2008 by the Aqualiner.

features.name: Il grande miracolo
features.opening: Il grande miracolo is een oorlogsmonument aan de Pleinweg in de Nederlandse stad Rotterdam.

facts.text: The sculpture shows a horse throwing off its rider in fear of an approaching bomb.
facts.sourceQuote: Op de twee haaks op elkaar staande wanden is een tekst aangebracht: 'VOOR DE ONGENOEMDEN DIE VIELEN VOOR DE VRIJHEID ONSTERFELIJK DOOR HET OFFER VAN HUN LEVEN' Het beeld bestaat uit een steigerend paard, dat uit angst voor een dichtbij inslaande bom, zijn berijder afwerpt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the two walls standing at right angles to each other is a text: 'FOR THE UNNAMED WHO MANY HAVE DIED FOR FREEDOM THROUGH THE OFFER OF THEIR LIVES' The image consists of a rearing horse, which throws off its rider out of fear of a bomb approaching.

features.name: De Hoop
features.opening: Korenmolen De Hoop aan de Molenweg in Rozenburg werd in 1887 opgericht, ter vervanging van een uit 1658 stammende molen die was gelegen aan de binnenkant van…

facts.text: A predecessor mill vanished in 1887 due to hydraulic works on the Scheur.
facts.sourceQuote: Die molen moest in 1887 verdwijnen in verband met waterstaatkundige werken aan het Scheur.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: That mill had to disappear in 1887 due to hydraulic works on the Scheur.

features.name: De Boeg
features.opening: De Boeg is een oorlogsmonument in Rotterdam.

facts.text: Princess Margriet unveiled the monument on April 10, 1957.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument van Fred Carasso werd op 10 april 1957 door prinses Margriet onthuld op de hoek van de Boompjes en de Leuvehaven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument of Fred Carasso was unveiled on April 10, 1957 by Princess Margriet on the corner of the Boompjes and the Leuvehaven.

facts.text: The aluminum structure stands 46 meters high to symbolize a bow in concrete waves.
facts.sourceQuote: De 46 meter hoge aluminiumconstructie symboliseert een boeg in de betonnen golven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The 46-meter-high aluminum structure symbolizes a bow in the concrete waves.

features.name: Christus Koning
features.opening: De Christus Koningkerk is een voormalige rooms-katholieke kerk aan het Statenplein in Rotterdam.

facts.text: Lightning struck the tower in 1991, causing the spire to be demolished and never rebuilt.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1991 sloeg de bliksem in de kerktoren, die daarna dreigde in te storten. De spits werd daarom gesloopt en is daarna niet meer herbouwd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1991, lightning struck the church tower, which then threatened to collapse. The spire was therefore demolished and has not been rebuilt since then.

facts.text: The parish board originally appealed against monument status because they wanted the building demolished.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk werd al in 1997 aangewezen als gemeentelijk monument, maar het parochiebestuur tekende beroep aan omdat men het gebouw wilde laten slopen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church was already designated as a municipal monument in 1997, but the parish board appealed because they wanted the building demolished.

features.name: Sint-Hildegardis & Sint-Antonius
features.opening: St Hildegard's Church (Dutch: Sint-Hildegardiskerk) is a Roman Catholic church in the Oude Noorden (in Hillegersberg, before the boundary changes of 1904) in…

facts.text: Rotterdam architect Evert Margry designed the church before his brother Albert finished it after Evert's death in 1891.
facts.sourceQuote: The neo-Gothic cruciform church was built between 1890 and 1892 according to a design by the Rotterdam architect Evert Margry, one of the most important students of Pierre Cuyper. However, the church was completed by his brother Albert Margry and his colleague JM Snickers following his death in 1891.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The neo-Gothic cruciform church was built between 1890 and 1892 according to a design by the Rotterdam architect Evert Margry, one of the most important students of Pierre Cuyper. However, the church was completed by his brother Albert Margry and his colleague JM Snickers following his death in 1891.

facts.text: The parish used this building independently until merging with two others to form a new parish in 2008.
facts.sourceQuote: The parish of Saints Hildegardis and Antonius used the church independently until 2008, before merging with two other Rotterdam parishes into the new parish of Saints Franciscus and Clara.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The parish of Saints Hildegardis and Antonius used the church independently until 2008, before merging with two other Rotterdam parishes into the new parish of Saints Franciscus and Clara.

features.name: Norwegian church
features.opening: De Noorse Zeemanskerk (Sjømannskirken i Rotterdam) is een kerk in Rotterdam.

facts.text: In 1941, British incendiary bombs partially burned the living quarters while the church space remained usable.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 3 oktober 1941 brandde het woongedeelte deels uit door een Britse brandbom; de dominee en zijn familie moesten een paar jaar elders verblijven, maar de schade kon worden hersteld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On October 3, 1941, the living quarters were partially burned out by a British incendiary bomb; the pastor and his family had to live elsewhere for a few years, but the damage could be repaired.

facts.text: King Haakon VII of newly independent Norway provided a generous donation for its construction.
facts.sourceQuote: Het kerkje kon gebouwd worden dankzij talrijke giften, onder meer een ruime bijdrage van Koning Haakon VII van het juist onafhankelijk geworden Noorwegen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church could be built thanks to numerous donations, including a generous contribution from King Haakon VII of the newly independent Norway.

features.name: Arminiuskerk
features.opening: De Arminiuskerk of Remonstrantse Kerk aan de Westersingel te Rotterdam is als godshuis van de remonstranten gebouwd in 1895-1897.

facts.text: The Arminiuskerk honors Jacobus Arminius, a theologian who adopted this name from his birthplace.
facts.sourceQuote: De Arminiuskerk is genoemd naar de remonstrantse theoloog Jacob Hermansz. van Oudewater, die zich Jacobus Arminius liet noemen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Arminiuskerk is named after the Remonstrant theologian Jacob Hermansz. van Oudewater, who had himself named Jacobus Arminius.

facts.text: Remonstrants worshipped in a secret brewery on Vissersdijk after being banned from public services since 1610.
facts.sourceQuote: De remonstranten scheidden zich in 1610 af van de Gereformeerde Kerk. Lange tijd was het ze verboden in het openbaar godsdienstoefeningen te houden. Sinds 1632 beschikten ze daarom in Rotterdam over een schuilkerk in een vroegere brouwerij aan de Vissersdijk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Remonstrants separated from the Reformed Church in 1610. For a long time it was forbidden to them to hold public religious services. Since 1632, they therefore had a secret church in Rotterdam in a former brewery on the Vissersdijk.

facts.text: The municipality originally wanted the old church site for a fair expansion before a land swap occurred.
facts.sourceQuote: De gemeente wilde het terrein van de oude kerk gebruiken voor een uitbreiding van de Beurs. Via een grondruil verkreeg de Remonstrantse gemeente in 1895 een kavel aan de Westersingel aan de rand van het onbebouwde Land van Hoboken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The municipality wanted to use the site of the old church for an expansion of the Fair. Through a land exchange, the Remonstrant Reformed Church obtained a plot on the Westersingel on the edge of the undeveloped Land of Hoboken in 1895.

facts.text: Until 1965, the forecourt was enclosed by a wrought iron fence with donkey-backed pillars.
facts.sourceQuote: Tot 1965 was het voorplein aan de Westersingel omheind met een smeedijzeren sierhekwerk tussen bakstenen pijlers met ezelsruggen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Until 1965, the forecourt on the Westersingel was enclosed with a wrought iron ornamental fence between brick pillars with donkey backs.

features.name: Houweling Telecom Museum
features.opening: Het Houweling Telecom Museum is in 1974 gestart en herbergt de geschiedenis op het gebied van telecommunicatie in de Zuid-Hollandse stad Rotterdam en de regio.

facts.text: Enthusiastic former KPN employees actively expand the museum and present its collection.
facts.sourceQuote: Een aantal enthousiaste oud-medewerkers van KPN werken aan de uitbouw van het museum en de presentatie van de collectie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A number of enthusiastic former KPN employees are working on the expansion of the museum and the presentation of the collection.

facts.text: The display includes vintage clothing alongside telephone exchanges and measuring equipment.
facts.sourceQuote: Wat er allemaal in het museum te zien is: eindapparatuur die bij klanten gebruikt werd allerlei vormen en ontwikkelingen van telecommunicatie telefooncentrales in werking onderdelen kabelnet gereedschap en kleding meetapparatuur informatie over wijkcentrales en ISRA-punten beeldmateriaal documentatie enz.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: What is all on display in the museum: end equipment that was used by customers various forms and developments of telecommunications telephone exchanges in operation components cable network tools and clothing measuring equipment information about district exchanges and ISRA points video material documentation etc.

features.name: Forgotten Bombardment
features.opening: During the German occupation of the Netherlands between 1940 and 1945, during the Second World War, Allied air forces carried out a number of operations over…

facts.text: Strong winds and overcast skies caused bombs intended for industry to devastate nearby residential areas instead.
facts.sourceQuote: The industrial area between Keilehaven and Merwehaven was hit. "A combination of strong wind and overcast conditions also caused great damage to the nearby residential areas, especially in the Bospolder-Tussendijken District".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The industrial area between Keilehaven and Merwehaven was hit. "A combination of strong wind and overcast conditions also caused great damage to the nearby residential areas, especially in the Bospolder-Tussendijken District".

facts.text: A memorial by Mathieu Ficheroux was unveiled in Gijzing Park by Prime Minister Ruud Lubbers in 1993.
facts.sourceQuote: Gijzing Park contains a memorial in remembrance of those killed and maimed by the attack (the monument was created by Mathieu Ficheroux and was unveiled by Dutch Prime Minister Ruud Lubbers on 31 March 1993).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Gijzing Park contains a memorial in remembrance of those killed and maimed by the attack (the monument was created by Mathieu Ficheroux and was unveiled by Dutch Prime Minister Ruud Lubbers on 31 March 1993).

facts.text: A television documentary by Mr. van der Wel helped break the silence surrounding the incident.
facts.sourceQuote: In the runup to the 50th anniversary of the raid, newspaper articles and a television documentary by Mr. van der Wel broke the taboo, and the raid is now acknowledged with a memorial in a local park to the "Forgotten Bombardment".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the runup to the 50th anniversary of the raid, newspaper articles and a television documentary by Mr. van der Wel broke the taboo, and the raid is now acknowledged with a memorial in a local park to the "Forgotten Bombardment".

features.name: Theater Zuidplein
features.opening: Het Theater Zuidplein is een theater aan het Zuidplein in Rotterdam, nabij het Winkelcentrum Zuidplein.

facts.text: A major renovation in 1978 led to its current name, Theater Zuidplein.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1978 kreeg het theater een grote verbouwing en kreeg het zijn huidige naam "Theater Zuidplein".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1978 the theater underwent a major renovation and was renamed "Theater Zuidplein".

facts.text: Architect Sybold van Ravesteyn designed the first building between 1946 and 1954.
facts.sourceQuote: Het eerste gebouw van Theater Zuidplein is gebouwd in de periode 1946-1954 naar een ontwerp van architect Sybold van Ravesteyn.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first building of Theater Zuidplein was built in the period 1946-1954 according to a design by architect Sybold van Ravesteyn.

facts.text: The original structure was demolished in 2020 to make way for a new design.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2020 Is dit gebouw gesloopt om plaats te maken voor een nieuw ontwerp.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2020, this building was demolished to make way for a new design.

features.name: Heilige Familie
features.opening: De Heilige Familiekerk is een voormalige rooms-katholieke kerk aan de Nootdorpstraat in Rotterdam.

facts.text: Jos Cuypers and his son Pierre designed the structure.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk is een ontwerp van Jos Cuypers en zijn zoon Pierre.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church is a design by Jos Cuypers and his son Pierre.

facts.text: A three-key organ from the upper gallery was moved downstairs during renovation.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij deze verbouwing werd het fraaie drie-klaviersorgel van de bovengalerij naar beneden verplaatst.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During this renovation, the beautiful three-key organ from the upper gallery was moved downstairs.

facts.text: A 2016 plan to turn the site into a children's health center was never realized.
facts.sourceQuote: In november 2016 werd bekendgemaakt dat het gebouw een nieuwe bestemming zou krijgen: er is toen aangekondigd dat er een gezondheidscentrum voor kinderen zou komen. Dit plan is niet gerealiseerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In November 2016, it was announced that the building would be given a new purpose: it was then announced that a children's health center would be built there. This plan has not been realized.

features.name: Monument 1940 - 1945
features.opening: Monument 1940 - 1945 is een oorlogsmonument in Oud-IJsselmonde, Rotterdam ter gedachtenis aan de Tweede Wereldoorlog.
