facts.text: The sculptor Piet van den Eijnde lived from 1896 to 1978.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument van Piet van den Eijnde (1896-1978) werd op 4 mei 1949 onthuld en bestaat uit een zuil waarop een vrouw is uitgebeeld, met een vogel bovenop haar linkerhand, als symbool van de vrijheid, en een knielende figuur aan haar rechterhand als symbool van het verslagen kwaad.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument of Piet van den Eijnde (1896-1978) was unveiled on May 4, 1949 and consists of a column on which a woman is depicted, with a bird on top of her left hand, as a symbol of freedom, and a kneeling figure on her right hand as a symbol of the defeated evil.

facts.text: A bird perched on the woman's left hand symbolizes freedom.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument van Piet van den Eijnde (1896-1978) werd op 4 mei 1949 onthuld en bestaat uit een zuil waarop een vrouw is uitgebeeld, met een vogel bovenop haar linkerhand, als symbool van de vrijheid, en een knielende figuur aan haar rechterhand als symbool van het verslagen kwaad.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument of Piet van den Eijnde (1896-1978) was unveiled on May 4, 1949 and consists of a column on which a woman is depicted, with a bird on top of her left hand, as a symbol of freedom, and a kneeling figure on her right hand as a symbol of the defeated evil.

facts.text: Inscriptions ask visitors to dedicate their deepest thoughts to those who gave everything for freedom.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan weerszijden van de zuil staat de tekst: "Wijdt dan het diepst van uw gedachtenis aan hen die voor uw vrijheid alles gaven".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On either side of the pillar is the text: "Then dedicate the deepest of your thoughts to those who gave everything for your freedom".

features.name: Floating FARM
features.opening: Floating Farm is a floating dairy farm, described by its founders as the world's first, located in the harbour of Rotterdam.

facts.text: Founders Peter and Minke van Wingerden established the facility.
facts.sourceQuote: Founded by Peter and Minke van Wingerden, the Floating Farm opened on May 13, 2019 with 32 cows, with the plan to grow to 40 cows in the future.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Founded by Peter and Minke van Wingerden, the Floating Farm opened on May 13, 2019 with 32 cows, with the plan to grow to 40 cows in the future.

facts.text: The farm officially opened its doors on May 13, 2019.
facts.sourceQuote: Founded by Peter and Minke van Wingerden, the Floating Farm opened on May 13, 2019 with 32 cows, with the plan to grow to 40 cows in the future.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Founded by Peter and Minke van Wingerden, the Floating Farm opened on May 13, 2019 with 32 cows, with the plan to grow to 40 cows in the future.

facts.text: The farm feeds cows using grass from public parks and city food waste.
facts.sourceQuote: To support growing cities, Floating Farm is designed to use residual products, such as grass from public parks and food waste, produced by the city, to feed the animals and give fresh milk back to the city.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: To support growing cities, Floating Farm is designed to use residual products, such as grass from public parks and food waste, produced by the city, to feed the animals and give fresh milk back to the city.

facts.text: Solar panels power the entire facility while rainwater is collected on its roof.
facts.sourceQuote: All of its power is sourced from solar energy panels, and rainwater is collected on the structure's roof.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: All of its power is sourced from solar energy panels, and rainwater is collected on the structure's roof.

features.name: Leendert Benjamin Valk
features.opening: De Lijst van Stolpersteine in Hillegersberg-Schiebroek geeft een overzicht van de gedenkstenen die in stadskwartier Hillegersberg-Schiebroek in de Nederlandse…

facts.text: Memorial stones for Valk appeared at multiple Rotterdam addresses between 2011 and 2019.
facts.sourceQuote: 2011: Berglustlaan 7 en 64 en 214a, Burgemeester Le Fèvre de Montignylaan 26, Jan van Ghestellaan 28, Juliana van Stolberglaan 71 2012: Nieuwe Kerkstraat 22b 2014: Jan van Ghestellaan 29, Straatweg 68a 4 mei 2017: Merellaan 21 8 maart 2019: C.N.A.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: 2011: Berglustlaan 7 and 64 and 214a, Burgemeester Le Fèvre de Montignylaan 26, Jan van Ghestellaan 28, Juliana van Stolberglaan 71 2012: Nieuwe Kerkstraat 22b 2014: Jan van Ghestellaan 29, Straatweg 68a May 4, 2017: Merellaan 21 March 8, 2019: C.N.A.

features.name: Wereldmuseum Rotterdam
features.opening: The Wereldmuseum Rotterdam (formerly known as the Museum voor Land- en Volkenkunde) is an ethnographic museum, situated at Willemskade in Rotterdam, the…

facts.text: Wereldmuseum Rotterdam was formerly called Museum voor Land- en Volkenkunde.
facts.sourceQuote: The Wereldmuseum Rotterdam (formerly known as the Museum voor Land- en Volkenkunde) is an ethnographic museum, situated at Willemskade in Rotterdam, the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Wereldmuseum Rotterdam (formerly known as the Museum voor Land- en Volkenkunde) is an ethnographic museum, situated at Willemskade in Rotterdam, the Netherlands.

features.name: Natuurhistorisch Museum Rotterdam
features.opening: The Natuurhistorisch Museum Rotterdam (Dutch pronunciation: [naːˈtyːrɦɪsˌtoːris myˈzeːjʏm ˌrɔtərˈdɑm]; English: Natural History Museum Rotterdam) is a natural…

facts.text: The institution first opened its doors to the public in 1927.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum opened in 1927.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum opened in 1927.

features.name: Hoflaankerk
features.opening: De Hoflaankerk op de hoek van de Hoflaan en de Oudedijk is het oudste kerkgebouw in de Rotterdamse wijk Kralingen.

facts.text: The new church opened on December 26, 1842, just one day after the old Veenweg church held its final service.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 25 december 1842, 1e kerstdag, werd de laatste dienst gehouden in het oude kerkje aan de Veenweg en de volgende dag werd de nieuwe Hoflaankerk in gebruik genomen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On December 25, 1842, on the 1st day of Christmas, the last service was held in the old church on the Veenweg and the next day the new Hoflaankerk was put into use.

facts.text: Arend Roodenburg, a civil engineering head teacher in The Hague, designed this structure.
facts.sourceQuote: De architect was Arend Roodenburg, hoofdonderwijzer Bouwkunde aan de koninklijke academie in Den Haag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The architect was Arend Roodenburg, head teacher of Civil Engineering at the Royal Academy in The Hague.

facts.text: After the 1940 bombing, the building served as the long-term home for the Rotte's Mannenkoor singing association.
facts.sourceQuote: Na het bombardement in 1940 diende het kerkgebouw lange tijd als het onderkomen voor Zangvereeniging Rotte's Mannenkoor.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After the bombing in 1940, the church building served for a long time as the home of the Singing Association Rotte's Mannenkoor.

features.name: Sonneveld House
features.opening: Huis Sonneveld in de Zuid-Hollandse stad Rotterdam is tussen 1932 en 1933 gebouwd door architect Leendert van der Vlugt van Bureau Brinkman & van der Vlugt in…

facts.text: In 1938, the kitchen was updated with a new industrial module design by Piet Zwart.
facts.sourceQuote: Met één uitzondering: al in 1938 werd het keukeninterieur uitgewisseld, omdat Bruynzeel dat jaar de baanbrekende, door Piet Zwart ontworpen keuken op de markt bracht, en deze onmiddellijk aan het state of the art interieur van Huis Sonneveld werd toegevoegd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: With one exception: already in 1938, the kitchen interior was replaced, because Bruynzeel introduced the groundbreaking kitchen designed by Piet Zwart on the market that year, and this was immediately added to Huis Sonneveld's state-of-the-art interior.

facts.text: The living room sofa adapts a 1928 Le Corbusier concept manufactured locally in the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuote: De grote bank in de huiskamer was gebaseerd op een ontwerp uit 1928 van Le Corbusier (uit de ontwerpreeks LC2 "fauteuil Grand Comfort"), maar aangepast door Van der Vlugt en vervaardigd door Allan & Co´s Koninklijke Nederlandsche Fabrieken van Meubelen en Spoorwegmaterieel N.V., die ook al het interieurtimmerwerk voor hun rekening namen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The large sofa in the living room was based on a design from 1928 by Le Corbusier (from the LC2 design series "fauteuil Grand Comfort"), but adapted by Van der Vlugt and manufactured by Allan & Co's Koninklijke Nederlandsche Fabrieken van Meubelen en Spoorwegmaterieel N.V., which also took care of all the interior carpentry for them.

facts.text: A color scheme by De Stijl founder Bart van der Leck was applied extensively inside the house.
facts.sourceQuote: Zij werken samen met vele internationaal bekende ontwerpers, waaronder Bart van der Leck, een van de grondleggers van De Stijl. Zijn voor Metz ontworpen kleurenschema werd op grote schaal toegepast in Huis Sonneveld, naast de meer aardse kleuren van de Franse Art deco in de woonkamer en de ouderslaapkamer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: They work together with many internationally renowned designers, including Bart van der Leck, one of the founders of De Stijl. His color scheme designed for Metz was applied on a large scale in Huis Sonneveld, in addition to the more earthy colors of French Art Deco in the living room and the parents' bedroom.

facts.text: Since 2001, the building has operated as a museum managed by Het Nieuwe Instituut.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 2001 is het een door bezoekers van over de hele wereld bezocht museum, waarvan het beheer door de nieuwe eigenaren, Stichting Volkskracht Historische Monumenten, is gemandateerd aan het tegenover Huis Sonneveld gelegen Het Nieuwe Instituut.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2001, it has been a museum visited by visitors from all over the world, whose management has been entrusted to the opposite of Huis Sonneveld, Het Nieuwe Instituut, by the new owners, Stichting Volkskracht Historische Monumenten.

features.name: Stoomdepot SSN
features.opening: The Stoom Stichting Nederland (SSN) is a railway museum in Rotterdam, Netherlands, founded in 1976.

facts.text: Visitors can view a large collection of steam locomotives originating from both Germany and the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuote: In the museum's engine shed, a large collection of steam locomotives from Germany and the Netherlands may be viewed.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the museum's engine shed, a large collection of steam locomotives from Germany and the Netherlands may be viewed.

facts.text: Special train services run throughout the Netherlands several times a year and occasionally reach Germany.
facts.sourceQuote: Several times a year special train services run throughout the Netherlands and may sometimes be seen in Germany too.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Several times a year special train services run throughout the Netherlands and may sometimes be seen in Germany too.

features.name: Hervormde Adriaen Janszkerk
features.opening: De Adriaen Janszkerk is een Nederlandse kerk in IJsselmonde, een stadsdeel van Rotterdam.

facts.text: A lightning strike in 1678 caused a fire that destroyed almost all the church's archives.
facts.sourceQuote: De bliksem trof de kerk in 1678, er was grote schade door de brand, ook gingen vrijwel alle archieven verloren.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church was struck by lightning in 1678, there was great damage due to the fire, almost all the archives were also lost.

facts.text: A monumental organ built in 1868 by Van den Haspel, Schölgens & Van der Weyde stands within the interior.
facts.sourceQuote: In de kerk staat een monumentaal orgel van de Rotterdamse orgelmakers Van den Haspel, Schölgens & Van der Weyde, gebouwd in 1868.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the church stands a monumental organ by the Rotterdam organ makers Van den Haspel, Schölgens & Van der Weyde, built in 1868.

features.name: Stadsgraanzuiger 19
features.opening: Stadsgraanzuiger No.19 is een Antwerpse graanelevator die eigendom is van het Maritiem Museum te Rotterdam.

facts.text: The vessel was purchased in Antwerp and towed to Rotterdam in May 1985.
facts.sourceQuote: Maar ook die stichting kon niet alle onderdelen restaureren en men vond in de zoektocht naar vervanging in Antwerpen de 'Stadsgraanzuiger No.19'. Men vond ook de middelen om het schip te kopen en in mei 1985 kon het naar Rotterdam worden versleept.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: But even that foundation could not restore all the parts and in the search for a replacement in Antwerp they found the 'Stadsgraanzuiger No.19'. The means to buy the ship were also found and in May 1985 it could be towed to Rotterdam.

facts.text: Restorers reused parts from Elevator 4 because the other ship was in irreversible disrepair.
facts.sourceQuote: Uitgebreid technisch onderzoek door een onafhankelijke partij leerde dat 'Elevator 4' in onomkeerbaar slechte staat verkeerde, 'Stadsgraanzuiger No.19' was er aanzienlijk beter aan toe. Besloten werd dit schip te behouden en onderdelen van Elevator 4 te hergebruiken bij de restauratie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Extensive technical research by an independent party showed that 'Elevator 4' was in an irreversible bad state, 'Stadsgraanzuiger No.19' was in significantly better condition. It was decided to preserve this ship and reuse parts of Elevator 4 during the restoration.

facts.text: Two steam-powered vacuum pumps sit atop a steel construction on its pontoon.
facts.sourceQuote: Het schip bestaat uit een ponton met een stalen constructie, waarin bovenin twee stoomaangedreven vacuümpompen staan, een groot rond vat (de recipiënt), waarin door de pompen een onderdruk wordt opgewekt, en daaronder een weegschaal.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The ship consists of a pontoon with a steel construction, in which two steam-powered vacuum pumps are located at the top, a large round tank (the receptacle), in which a vacuum is created by the pumps, and below it a weighing scale.

features.name: Cinerama
features.opening: Cinerama is a cinema in central Rotterdam, the Netherlands.

facts.text: The venue opened in July 1960 on the site of a bankrupt cinema that had closed after only three years.
facts.sourceQuote: Cinerama was opened in July 1960, occupying the site of the former Scala cinema, which had gone bankrupt after just three years.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Cinerama was opened in July 1960, occupying the site of the former Scala cinema, which had gone bankrupt after just three years.

facts.text: The venue opened in 1960 before undergoing a major reconstruction during the 1980s.
facts.sourceQuote: It started in 1960 and was rebuilt in the 1980s.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It started in 1960 and was rebuilt in the 1980s.

facts.text: Beyond standard releases, it hosts specialized events like the Arab Cinema and Wildlife Film Festival.
facts.sourceQuote: It also hosts a variety of festival screenings such as Arab Cinema, IFFR and the Wildlife Film Festival.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It also hosts a variety of festival screenings such as Arab Cinema, IFFR and the Wildlife Film Festival.

features.name: RiF010
features.opening: RiF010 is een kunstmatig watersportgebied met waterbassin in en om de Steigersgracht, in hartje Rotterdam.

facts.text: The official opening occurred on July 6, 2024, featuring a surfing festival and competition.
facts.sourceQuote: De officiële opening was op 6 juli 2024, met een surffestival en een surfwedstrijd.Deze surfwedstrijd, de Rotterdam Surf Open, keert na een succesvolle eerste editie jaarlijks terug.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The official opening was on July 6, 2024, with a surfing festival and a surfing competition. This surfing competition, the Rotterdam Surf Open, will return annually after a successful first edition.

facts.text: The annual Rotterdam Surf Open returns yearly alongside the 2025 Red Bull Pool Clash one-on-one event.
facts.sourceQuote: De officiële opening was op 6 juli 2024, met een surffestival en een surfwedstrijd.Deze surfwedstrijd, de Rotterdam Surf Open, keert na een succesvolle eerste editie jaarlijks terug. In 2025 vindt daarnaast ook nog de "Red Bull Pool Clash" plaats, een surfwedstrijd waarbij 1 op 1 wordt gesurfd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The official opening was on July 6, 2024, with a surfing festival and a surfing competition. This surfing competition, the Rotterdam Surf Open, will return annually after a successful first edition. In 2025, the "Red Bull Pool Clash" will also take place, a surfing competition where 1 on 1 surfing takes place.

facts.text: Former filmmaker Edwin van Viegen initiated the project and received three million euros to realize his vision.
facts.sourceQuote: Initiatiefnemer Edwin van Viegen, een voormalig filmmaker, kreeg een bedrag van 3 miljoen euro toebedeeld om zijn droom werkelijkheid te maken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Initiator Edwin van Viegen, a former filmmaker, was awarded an amount of 3 million euros to make his dream come true.

facts.text: Water finally began flowing into the basin on May 6, 2024, when Van Viegen's daughter activated the tap.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 6 mei 2024 draaide de dochter van Van Viegen de waterkraan open, en sinds dat moment stroomt er water in het bassin.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On May 6, 2024, Van Viegen's daughter turned on the water tap, and since then water has been flowing into the basin.

features.name: Kids Marina
features.opening: Kids Marina is een kinderhaven waar elektrische bootjes varen in het hart van Rotterdam.

facts.text: Children as young as three can independently pilot police, fire, or rainbow boats.
facts.sourceQuote: Het bijzondere is, dat zo'n politieboot, brandweerboot, containerboot, havendienstvaartuig of zelfs een regenboogboot zelfstandig gevaren mag worden door kinderen vanaf drie jaar.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The special thing is that such a police boat, fire brigade boat, container boat, harbor service vessel or even a rainbow boat may be operated independently by children from three years of age.

facts.text: The harbor has been operating since the summer season of 2012.
facts.sourceQuote: Kids Marina bestaat sinds het zomerseizoen 2012.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Kids Marina has been around since the summer season 2012.

features.name: Pauluskerk
features.opening: Pauluskerk is een kerkgebouw aan de Mauritsweg in het centrum van Rotterdam.

facts.text: The original church opened in 1960 but was demolished in 2007.
facts.sourceQuote: De eerste Pauluskerk daar werd in 1960 in gebruik genomen door de hervormde gemeente Rotterdam (thans onderdeel van de Protestantse Kerk in Nederland) en werd in 2007 gesloopt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first Pauluskerk there was put into use in 1960 by the Reformed Municipality of Rotterdam (now part of the Protestant Church in the Netherlands) and was demolished in 2007.

facts.text: A new futuristic structure by architect Will Alsop replaced it in 2013.
facts.sourceQuote: Op dezelfde plaats hervatte men in 2013 de kerkelijke activiteiten in een nieuw futuristisch ogend bouwwerk, een ontwerp van de Engelse architect Will Alsop.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2013, church activities resumed in the same place in a new futuristic-looking building, a design by the English architect Will Alsop.

facts.text: Reverend Hans Visser led the church starting in 1980 to help drug addicts and the homeless.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk werd vooral bekend vanwege de opvang van mensen van de onderkant van de samenleving, waaronder drugsverslaafden, dak-en thuislozen en vluchtelingen, waar vanaf 1980 - onder leiding van dominee Hans Visser en zijn opvolger Dick Couvée - de kerk meer en meer een centrum voor werd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church became especially well-known for its reception of people from the bottom of society, including drug addicts, homeless and refugees, where from 1980 onwards - under the leadership of Reverend Hans Visser and his successor Dick Couvée - the church increasingly became a center for.

features.name: Market Hall
features.opening: The Markthal (English: Market Hall) is a residential and office building with a market hall underneath, located in Rotterdam.

facts.text: The archwise building resembles a horseshoe and features grey nature stone.
facts.sourceQuote: The grey nature stone building has an archwise structure like a horseshoe.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The grey nature stone building has an archwise structure like a horseshoe.

facts.text: Architectural firm MVRDV designed this distinctive market hall.
facts.sourceQuote: The Markthal was designed by architectural firm MVRDV.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Markthal was designed by architectural firm MVRDV.

facts.text: Queen Máxima officially opened the structure on October 1, 2014.
facts.sourceQuote: The building was opened on October 1, 2014, by Queen Máxima of the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building was opened on October 1, 2014, by Queen Máxima of the Netherlands.

facts.text: The complex contains 228 apartments alongside retail and dining spaces.
facts.sourceQuote: Besides the large market hall, the complex houses 228 apartments, 4,600 m2 retail space, 1,600 m2 horeca and an underground 4-story parking garage with a capacity of over 1200 cars.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Besides the large market hall, the complex houses 228 apartments, 4,600 m2 retail space, 1,600 m2 horeca and an underground 4-story parking garage with a capacity of over 1200 cars.

features.name: Euromast
features.opening: Euromast is an observation tower in Rotterdam, Netherlands, designed by Hugh Maaskant constructed between 1958 and 1960.

facts.text: Built for the 1960 Floriade, it became a listed monument in 2010.
facts.sourceQuote: It was specially built for the 1960 Floriade, and is a listed monument since 2010.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was specially built for the 1960 Floriade, and is a listed monument since 2010.

facts.text: The tower's center of gravity sits below ground level to ensure balance.
facts.sourceQuote: For stability it is built on a concrete block of 1,900,000 kg (4,200,000 lb) so that the centre of gravity is below ground.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: For stability it is built on a concrete block of 1,900,000 kg (4,200,000 lb) so that the centre of gravity is below ground.

facts.text: A medieval Protestant church also dedicated to Saint Laurentius existed in Rotterdam since 1572.
facts.sourceQuote: Ook de naam van de middeleeuwse Sint-Laurenskerk in Rotterdam, sinds 1572 protestants, verwijst naar deze heilige.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name of the medieval Sint-Laurenskerk in Rotterdam, Protestant since 1572, also refers to this saint.

facts.text: British bombing in October 1941 severely damaged its entrance, roof, and dome.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij het Britse bombardement van 3 oktober 1941 liep de kerk ernstige oorlogsschade op, toen de ingang en het dak en de koepel werden beschadigd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the British bombing of October 3, 1941, the church suffered serious war damage when the entrance, roof and dome were damaged.

features.name: Egbertus
features.opening: De Heilige Egbertuskerk is een rooms-katholieke kerk aan De Cordesstraat 27- 29 in Hoek van Holland.

facts.text: A wooden predecessor moved in 1905 was destroyed by wartime actions in 1944.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1905 werd dit gebouw verplaatst naar de Rietdijkstraat, waar het bij oorlogshandelingen in 1944 werd verwoest.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1905, this building was moved to Rietdijkstraat, where it was destroyed in wartime actions in 1944.

facts.text: The rectangular nave features a semi-circular apse on its western side.
facts.sourceQuote: Het is een rechthoekige zaalkerk, met een halfronde apsis aan de westelijke zijde.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is a rectangular nave church, with a semi-circular apse on the western side.

facts.text: Albert Termote created the sculpture of Egbertus that adorns the facade.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeldhouwwerk van De Heilige Egbertus op de voorgevel werd gemaakt door Albert Termote.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The sculpture of De Heilige Egbertus on the facade was made by Albert Termote.

features.name: Boezemsingelkerk
features.opening: De Boezemsingelkerk is een kerkgebouw van de Gereformeerde Gemeenten aan de Boezemsingel in het centrum van Rotterdam.

facts.text: The original church opened on March 31, 1901 before being demolished in 2018.
facts.sourceQuote: De eerdere kerk werd geopend op 31 maart 1901. In verband met teruglopend kerkbezoek en de slechte bouwkundige staat werd deze oude kerk gesloopt in 2018.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The previous church was opened on March 31, 1901. Due to declining church attendance and the poor state of disrepair, this old church was demolished in 2018.

facts.text: A smaller replacement building was put into use in 2019 after the old one fell into disrepair.
facts.sourceQuote: In verband met teruglopend kerkbezoek en de slechte bouwkundige staat werd deze oude kerk gesloopt in 2018. In 2019 is een nieuw, kleiner kerkgebouw in gebruik genomen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Due to declining church attendance and the poor state of disrepair, this old church was demolished in 2018. In 2019, a new, smaller church building was put into use.

facts.text: A theological school with library has operated within the church since January 13, 1927.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 13 januari 1927 is er naast de kerk de Theologische School van de Gereformeerde Gemeenten met bibliotheek gevestigd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since January 13, 1927, in addition to the church, the Theological School of the Reformed Churches with library has been located.

facts.text: Gerrit Hendrik Kersten served as predecessor here during two separate periods between 1906 and 1948.
facts.sourceQuote: Van 1906-1912 en opnieuw van 1926 tot 1948 was Gerrit Hendrik Kersten hier voorganger.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 1906-1912 and again from 1926 to 1948, Gerrit Hendrik Kersten was the predecessor here.

features.name: Sint-Bavo
features.opening: De Sint-Bavokerk is een rooms-katholieke parochiekerk in de Rotterdamse wijk Pendrecht.

facts.text: An emergency church on Rollostraat served the community starting in 1955.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1955 werd een noodkerk in gebruik genomen aan de Rollostraat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1955, an emergency church was put into use on Rollostraat.

facts.text: The current building on the Slinge opened for use in 1960.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1960 kon het huidige kerkgebouw aan de Slinge in gebruik worden genomen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1960, the current church building on the Slinge could be put into use.

features.name: Stadswerf Koningspoort
features.opening: De scheepshelling Koningspoort is een museale scheepshelling die in 1983 is gebouwd op de plaats waar vroeger de doorgang was van de Maas naar de Oude Haven…

facts.text: The ship slope originated from a demolished Groningen yard before being rebuilt here in 1983.
facts.sourceQuote: De scheepshelling Koningspoort is een museale scheepshelling die in 1983 is gebouwd op de plaats waar vroeger de doorgang was van de Maas naar de Oude Haven van Rotterdam. De scheepshelling is afkomstig van de opgeheven scheepswerf "De Koningspoort" in Hoogkerk (Groningen) van Barkmeijer Shipyards.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Koningspoort ship slip is a museum ship slip built in 1983 on the site where the passageway from the Maas to the Old Port of Rotterdam used to be. The ship slope comes from the demolished shipyard "De Koningspoort" in Hoogkerk (Groningen) of Barkmeijer Shipyards.

features.name: Maritime Museum
features.opening: The Maritime Museum Rotterdam is a maritime museum in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

facts.text: Prince Henry of the Netherlands founded this institution in 1874.
facts.sourceQuote: Dedicated to naval history, it was founded in 1874 by Prince Henry of the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Dedicated to naval history, it was founded in 1874 by Prince Henry of the Netherlands.

facts.text: The open-air Maritime Museum Harbour merged with the main museum in 2014.
facts.sourceQuote: Next to the Maritime Museum lies the open-air Maritime Museum Harbour, which merged with the Maritime Museum in 2014.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Next to the Maritime Museum lies the open-air Maritime Museum Harbour, which merged with the Maritime Museum in 2014.

facts.text: Exhibitions are designed for three generations: children, parents, and grandparents.
facts.sourceQuote: The Maritime Museum includes both permanent and changing exhibitions designed for three generations: children, their parents and grandparents.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Maritime Museum includes both permanent and changing exhibitions designed for three generations: children, their parents and grandparents.

features.name: Vierkant eiland in de plas
features.opening: Vierkant eiland in de plas is een groot monumentaal kunstwerk gemaakt door kunstenaar Frans de Wit (Leiden, 1942-2004).

facts.text: Frans de Wit, an artist from Leiden who lived from 1942 to 2004, created this large monumental work.
facts.sourceQuote: Vierkant eiland in de plas is een groot monumentaal kunstwerk gemaakt door kunstenaar Frans de Wit (Leiden, 1942-2004).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Vierkant eiland in de plas is a large monumental work of art made by artist Frans de Wit (Leiden, 1942-2004).

facts.text: The artwork was officially unveiled on October 2, 1996.
facts.sourceQuote: Het kunstwerk is onthuld op 2 oktober 1996.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The artwork was unveiled on October 2, 1996.

facts.text: Rising beams around the concrete shell protrude 7.15 meters above sea level.
facts.sourceQuote: Het is een kunstmatig eiland van 52 × 52 meter, bestaande uit een diepe betonnen schaal met een diameter van 28,5 meter op een vierkante basis, met rondom oplopende balken die 7,15 meter boven de waterspiegel uitsteken en op ongeveer gelijke hoogte uitkomen van het NAP.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is an artificial island of 52 × 52 meters, consisting of a deep concrete shell with a diameter of 28.5 meters on a square base, with rising beams around it that protrude 7.15 meters above sea level and meet at approximately the same height as sea level.

features.name: Oude Kerk Charlois
features.opening: De Oude Kerk is een kerk in het Rotterdamse stadsdeel Charlois.

facts.text: The tower was completed in 1660, predating the main hall built in 1868.
facts.sourceQuote: De huidige kerkzaal dateert van 1868. De toren kwam al in 1660 gereed.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The current church hall dates from 1868. The tower was ready as early as 1660.

features.name: Havendienst 20
features.opening: De Havendienst 20 is in 1939 als sleepboot voor een particulier op stapel gezet aan de Roode Vaart bij de werf Gebroeders Paans in Moerdijk.

facts.text: Oral tradition claims the shipyard saved it from dismantling during World War II.
facts.sourceQuote: De mondelinge overlevering leert dat men op de werf kans heeft gezien de boot gedurende de Tweede Wereldoorlog nooit af te bouwen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The oral tradition teaches that on the shipyard there was a chance to never dismantle the ship during World War II.

facts.text: A lack of funds prevented its original owner from taking the boat after the war.
facts.sourceQuote: Na de oorlog had de beoogde eigenaar onvoldoende middelen om de boot van de werf te kunnen afnemen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After the war, the intended owner had insufficient funds to take the boat off the shipyard.

facts.text: The boat's power was reduced to 240hp due to its light construction.
facts.sourceQuote: In verband met de relatief lichte constructie van de boot en de koppeling werd deze afgesteld op 240 pk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Due to the relatively light construction of the boat and the coupling, it was adjusted to 240 hp.

features.name: Calandmonument
features.opening: Het Calandmonument in het Scheepvaartkwartier, in de Nederlandse stad Rotterdam, gedenkt ingenieur Pieter Caland, die de Nieuwe Waterweg, de directe verbinding…

facts.text: Engineer Pieter Caland designed the Nieuwe Waterweg, the direct sea connection the monument honors.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Calandmonument in het Scheepvaartkwartier, in de Nederlandse stad Rotterdam, gedenkt ingenieur Pieter Caland, die de Nieuwe Waterweg, de directe verbinding met zee, ontwierp.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Calandmonument in the Shipping Quarter, in the Dutch city of Rotterdam, commemorates engineer Pieter Caland, who designed the Nieuwe Waterweg, the direct connection to the sea.

facts.text: The statue survived Rotterdam's 1940 bombing after being relocated to Veerkade in 1939.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument stond van 1907 tot 1939, dus net voor de Tweede Wereldoorlog, aan het Van Hogendorpsplein, ongeveer waar nu het Churchillplein is. In 1939 werd het monument om verkeerstechnische redenen verplaatst naar de Veerkade bij de Veerhaven, en heeft daardoor het bombardement van mei 1940 overleefd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument stood from 1907 to 1939, so just before World War II, on Van Hogendorpsplein, about where Churchillplein is now. In 1939, the monument was moved for traffic reasons to the Veerkade near the Veerhaven, and therefore survived the bombing of May 1940.

features.name: Wilhelmina
features.opening: Het standbeeld van Koningin Wilhelmina, nabij de Euromast in de Nederlandse stad Rotterdam, is een kunstwerk van de hand van Charlotte van Pallandt.

facts.text: A stone monument honoring her was unveiled on May 4, 1968.
facts.sourceQuote: Het hardstenen monument werd op 4 mei 1968 door koningin Juliana onthuld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The stone monument was unveiled on May 4, 1968 by Queen Juliana.

features.name: R.K. Kerk van St. Petrus'Banden
features.opening: De H. Petrus' Bandenkerk is een voormalige katholieke kerk in de deelgemeente Overschie in Rotterdam.

facts.text: The entrance features a Greek temple façade with two Doric columns flanking the doorway.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk heeft een typerende entree in de vorm van de façade van een Griekse tempel, met aan beide zijden van de ingang twee zuilen in de dorische orde.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church has a typical entrance in the form of the façade of a Greek temple, with two columns in the Doric order on either side of the entrance.

features.name: Islamic University of Applied Sciences Rotterdam
features.opening: The Islamic University of Applied Sciences Rotterdam (IUASR) (formerly: Islamic University of Rotterdam-IUR) was founded on 21 November 1997 by the…

facts.text: The institution was founded on November 21, 1997.
facts.sourceQuote: The Islamic University of Applied Sciences Rotterdam (IUASR) (formerly: Islamic University of Rotterdam-IUR) was founded on 21 November 1997 by the Turkish-Dutch scholar Dr.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Islamic University of Applied Sciences Rotterdam (IUASR) (formerly: Islamic University of Rotterdam-IUR) was founded on 21 November 1997 by the Turkish-Dutch scholar Dr.

facts.text: Educator Hamdi Mert became the first chairman of the board.
facts.sourceQuote: The first chairman of the board was educator and author Hamdi Mert.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first chairman of the board was educator and author Hamdi Mert.

facts.text: Founding rector Dr Damra led the university from its start until his departure in August 2001.
facts.sourceQuote: Under the leadership of founding rector Dr Damra, the institution took shape and officially commenced with the establishment of the university on 21 November 1997. It lasted until Damra's departure in August 2001.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Under the leadership of founding rector Dr Damra, the institution took shape and officially commenced with the establishment of the university on 21 November 1997. It lasted until Damra's departure in August 2001.

facts.text: Early work included formulating the mission, designing programs, and assembling academic staff.
facts.sourceQuote: During this time, the university's mission was formulated, the programme structure designed, the academic staff assembled, and the institutional identity developed.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During this time, the university's mission was formulated, the programme structure designed, the academic staff assembled, and the institutional identity developed.

features.name: Andreaskerk
features.opening: De Andreaskerk is de eerste wederopbouwkerk van Rotterdam, gebouwd naar ontwerp van Bastiaan van der Lecq.

facts.text: Bastiaan van der Lecq designed this structure as Rotterdam's first reconstruction church.
facts.sourceQuote: De Andreaskerk is de eerste wederopbouwkerk van Rotterdam, gebouwd naar ontwerp van Bastiaan van der Lecq.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Andreaskerk is the first reconstruction church of Rotterdam, built according to the design of Bastiaan van der Lecq.

facts.text: The altar, banks, and pulpit are crafted from mahogany wood.
facts.sourceQuote: Banken, altaar en preekstoel zijn door de architect ontworpen en in mahoniehout uitgevoerd; het doopvont in steen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The banks, altar and pulpit were designed by the architect and made of mahogany wood; the baptismal font in stone.

facts.text: Two narrow abstract windows in blue and red flank a large wooden cross.
facts.sourceQuote: De altaarruimte heeft twee smalle, abstracte, blauw-rode glas-in-loodramen en in het midden een groot houten kruis.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The altar room has two narrow, abstract, blue-red stained glass windows and in the center a large wooden cross.

facts.text: An annex connected by a corridor features halls and a refectory with a monastic look.
facts.sourceQuote: Het bijgebouw, dat via een gang met de kerkzaal verbonden is, heeft mede door zijn zalen, kosterij en binnentuin een kloosterachtige uitstraling.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The annex, which is connected to the church hall via a corridor, has a monastic appearance partly due to its halls, refectory and courtyard.

features.name: Joods Kindermonument
features.opening: Het Joods Kindermonument in Rotterdam is een monument op de Kop van Zuid ter nagedachtenis aan de Rotterdamse Joodse kinderen die in de Tweede Wereldoorlog…

facts.text: Architect Wim Quist designed the Joods Kindermonument, which was unveiled on April 10, 2013.
facts.sourceQuote: Het is ontworpen door Wim Quist en op 10 april 2013 onthuld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was designed by Wim Quist and unveiled on April 10, 2013.

facts.text: Six hundred eighty-six children aged one month to twelve years were deported from Loods 24.
facts.sourceQuote: In de Tweede Wereldoorlog werden Rotterdamse Joden vanuit Loods 24 gedeporteerd. Hieronder waren 686 kinderen van één maand tot en met twaalf jaar waarvan de namen - dankzij een zorgvuldige administratie - nog bekend zijn.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During World War II, Rotterdam Jews were deported from Loods 24. Below were 686 children from one month to twelve years of age whose names - thanks to careful administration - are still known.

facts.text: The Guido de Brès school from nearby IJsselmonde has adopted the Joods Kindermonument.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Kindermonument is geadopteerd door de Guido de Brès-school uit het nabije IJsselmonde.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Kindermonument has been adopted by the Guido de Brès school from the nearby IJsselmonde.

features.name: Centrale Bibliotheek
features.opening: De Centrale Bibliotheek Rotterdam is de hoofdvestiging van Bibliotheek Rotterdam en bevindt zich aan de Binnenrotte in het centrum van de stad.

facts.text: Eero Aarnio's iconic Bubble Chair was displayed here in 2006.
facts.sourceQuote: De Bubble Chair (1968) van Eero Aarnio was in 2006 te zien in de Centrale Bibliotheek Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Eero Aarnio's Bubble Chair (1968) was shown in the Centrale Bibliotheek Rotterdam in 2006.

facts.text: Architects Jaap Bakema and Hans Boot won the design competition for this library.
facts.sourceQuote: Het winnend ontwerp kwam van Jaap Bakema en Hans Boot van het architectenbureau Van den Broek & Bakema.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The winning design came from Jaap Bakema and Hans Boot of the architectural firm Van den Broek & Bakema.

facts.text: Queen Beatrix officially opened the building on October 7, 1983.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 7 oktober 1983 werd het gebouw officieel geopend door Koningin Beatrix.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On October 7, 1983, the building was officially opened by Queen Beatrix.

features.name: St. Mary's
features.opening: St Mary's Church or the English Church (Dutch: Engelse Kerk) is an Anglican church in Rotterdam in the Netherlands.

facts.text: Donors included Queen Anne, the Duke of Marlborough, and diarist Samuel Pepys.
facts.sourceQuote: The many donors included Queen Anne, the Archbishop of Canterbury, the Duke of Marlborough and the diarist Samuel Pepys; the chaplain's stipend was paid by the British government.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The many donors included Queen Anne, the Archbishop of Canterbury, the Duke of Marlborough and the diarist Samuel Pepys; the chaplain's stipend was paid by the British government.

features.name: Radio Museum
features.opening: De Stichting Rotterdams Radio Museum is in 1988 opgezet door Harry de Jong sr., een vroegere directeur van de firma Correct.

facts.text: Harry de Jong sr., a former director of Correct, established the museum in 1988.
facts.sourceQuote: De Stichting Rotterdams Radio Museum is in 1988 opgezet door Harry de Jong sr., een vroegere directeur van de firma Correct.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Rotterdams Radio Museum Foundation was founded in 1988 by Harry de Jong sr., a former director of the Correct company.

facts.text: Visitors can explore the collection without paying an entrance fee on open afternoons.
facts.sourceQuote: Het museum is op donder-, vrij-, zater- en zondagen 's middags geopend en gratis toegankelijk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum is open on Thursdays, Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays in the afternoon and is free to enter.

facts.text: The venue hosts regular themed exhibitions featuring consumer electronics like video recorders.
facts.sourceQuote: De collectie omvat vrijwel alle vormen van consumentenelektronica zoals radio, televisie, videorecorders, cd- en dvd-spelers, etc. Er zijn regelmatig tentoonstellingen met een bepaald thema.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The collection includes virtually all forms of consumer electronics such as radio, television, video recorders, CD and DVD players, etc. There are regular exhibitions with a certain theme.

facts.text: Hans Cats, a former Bergen-Belsen prisoner, learned English via this radio's American Forces Network broadcasts.
facts.sourceQuote: Hans, die gevangen had gezeten in concentratiekamp Bergen-Belsen, leerde Engels door via deze radio te luisteren naar de Amerikaanse radiozender American Forces Network.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Hans, who had been imprisoned in the Bergen-Belsen concentration camp, learned English by listening to the American radio station American Forces Network through this radio.

facts.text: Jewish schoolboy Hans Cats received the 'Bing Crosby' radio from emigrant John Pais in 1945.
facts.sourceQuote: Een van de radio's in het Radio Museum is de Philco 46-1201 ‘Bing Crosby’ Radio-Phono die de Joods-Rotterdamse scholier Hans Cats in 1945 kreeg van de Engelandvaarder John Pais.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: One of the radios in the Radio Museum is the Philco 46-1201 'Bing Crosby' Radio-Phono that the Jewish Rotterdam schoolboy Hans Cats received in 1945 from the emigrant John Pais.

features.name: Sint-Lambertuskerk
features.opening: De Sint-Lambertuskerk is een rooms-katholieke kerk in Rotterdam-Kralingen.

facts.text: The interior received polychrome paintings in 1903 and a new organ in 1900.
facts.sourceQuote: Oorspronkelijk was het interieur van de kerk eenvoudig gehouden, maar in 1900 kreeg de kerk een nieuw orgel van de bekende orgelbouwer Michaël Maarschalkerweerd. In 1903 werd het interieur van de kerk voorzien van polychrome schilderingen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Originally, the interior of the church was kept simple, but in 1900 the church received a new organ from the well-known organ builder Michaël Maarschalkerweerd. In 1903, the interior of the church was provided with polychrome paintings.

facts.text: Lambertweg was named after a family that produced several mayors of Kralingen.
facts.sourceQuote: Ook niet ver is de Lambertweg, in 1927 vernoemd naar de familie Lambert die in de 18e en 19e eeuw verschillende burgemeesters van Kralingen had voortgebracht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Not far away is Lambertweg, named in 1927 after the Lambert family who had produced several mayors of Kralingen in the 18th and 19th centuries.

features.name: KINO
features.opening: KINO Rotterdam, kortweg Kino, is een bioscoop in Rotterdam, gevestigd in het pand van het voormalige LantarenVenster aan de Gouvernestraat.

facts.text: Room 5 features a Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas theme while Room 6 mimics The Big Lebowski.
facts.sourceQuote: Zaal 5 werd gedecoreerd in het thema van de film Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas en zaal 6 in het thema van The Big Lebowski.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Room 5 was decorated in the theme of the film Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas and room 6 in the theme of The Big Lebowski.

facts.text: The venue houses six separate screening rooms with a combined seating capacity of 568.
facts.sourceQuote: De bioscoop telt zes zalen met een totale capaciteit van 568 stoelen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The cinema has six rooms with a total capacity of 568 seats.

facts.text: Beyond movies, the site includes a burger restaurant and a workspace for audiovisual entrepreneurs.
facts.sourceQuote: Naast de filmzalen bevat het een cocktailbar, een burgerrestaurant (NIKO's Resto) en een werkplek voor creatieve ondernemers in de audiovisuele industrie (BURO).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In addition to the movie theaters, it contains a cocktail bar, a burger restaurant (NIKO's Resto) and a workplace for creative entrepreneurs in the audiovisual industry (BURO).

features.name: Nieuwe Instituut
features.opening: Nieuwe Instituut (NI, English: New Institute) is a cultural centre in Rotterdam, the Netherlands.

facts.text: Inside stands the Sonneveld House, a prime example of Nieuwe Zakelijkheid architecture.
facts.sourceQuote: The building contains a shop, exhibition space, study centre, and archive, as well as the Sonneveld House (a prime example of Nieuwe Zakelijkheid architecture), a pond, and a small park.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building contains a shop, exhibition space, study centre, and archive, as well as the Sonneveld House (a prime example of Nieuwe Zakelijkheid architecture), a pond, and a small park.

facts.text: The complex includes a small pond and park alongside its exhibition spaces.
facts.sourceQuote: The building contains a shop, exhibition space, study centre, and archive, as well as the Sonneveld House (a prime example of Nieuwe Zakelijkheid architecture), a pond, and a small park.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building contains a shop, exhibition space, study centre, and archive, as well as the Sonneveld House (a prime example of Nieuwe Zakelijkheid architecture), a pond, and a small park.

facts.text: Three separate cultural institutes merged in 2013 to form this single organization.
facts.sourceQuote: Nieuwe Instituut (NI) formerly known as Het Nieuwe Instituut was formed in 2013, when then-secretary of state for Education, Culture, and Science Halbe Zijlstra ordered the merger of the Dutch institutes for architecture, design, and digital-culture.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Nieuwe Instituut (NI) formerly known as Het Nieuwe Instituut was formed in 2013, when then-secretary of state for Education, Culture, and Science Halbe Zijlstra ordered the merger of the Dutch institutes for architecture, design, and digital-culture.

features.name: Hillegondakerk
features.opening: De Hillegondakerk is een Nederlands-hervormde kerk in Rotterdam-Hillegersberg en is de oudste kerk van Rotterdam.

facts.text: Legend says the name Hillegondakerk honors a giantess who filled a bog with sand from her apron.
facts.sourceQuote: De naam Hillegondakerk gaat volgens de legende terug op de reuzin Hillegond, die haar schort met zand leegstortte in het veengebied om daar een huis te bouwen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: According to legend, the name Hillegondakerk dates back to the giantess Hillegond, who poured her apron full of sand into the bog area to build a house there.

features.name: Depot Boijmans Van Beuningen
features.opening: Depot Boijmans Van Beuningen (initially called 'het Collectiegebouw' (Collection Building), popularly called 'The Pot') is an art depot of Museum Boijmans Van…

facts.text: The collection is stored in fourteen compartments maintaining five distinct climate conditions.
facts.sourceQuote: More than 151,000 objects are housed together, arranged in fourteen storage compartments with five different climates. Each climate is for material that requires different kind of environmental conditions - a lower temperature, for example, is needed for colour photographs.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: More than 151,000 objects are housed together, arranged in fourteen storage compartments with five different climates. Each climate is for material that requires different kind of environmental conditions - a lower temperature, for example, is needed for colour photographs.

facts.text: King Willem-Alexander officially opened the facility to the public on November 5, 2021.
facts.sourceQuote: It was officially opened to the public in a ceremony with King Willem-Alexander on November 5, 2021.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was officially opened to the public in a ceremony with King Willem-Alexander on November 5, 2021.

features.name: Wilhelminafontein
features.opening: De Wilhelminafontein in Rotterdam is een monumentale fontein op het Noordereiland op het Burgemeester Hoffmanplein.

facts.text: The fountain was removed in the 1990s after tree roots cracked its structure.
facts.sourceQuote: De fontein werd aan het begin van de jaren negentig verwijderd, nadat de wortels van de - waarschijnlijk eveneens in 1898 geplante - kastanjeboom scheuren in het monument hadden veroorzaakt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The fountain was removed at the beginning of the 1990s, after the roots of the - probably also planted in 1898 - chestnut tree had caused cracks in the monument.

facts.text: Architect Henri Evers designed the column while Simon Miedema created its images.
facts.sourceQuote: Het is een ontwerp van prof. dr Henri Evers, de architect van het Rotterdamse stadhuis. De beelden op het monument zijn van de hand van Simon Miedema, die ook de beelden ontwierp voor het Witte Huis in Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is a design by Prof. Dr. Henri Evers, the architect of the Rotterdam town hall. The images on the monument are by the hand of Simon Miedema, who also designed the images for the White House in Rotterdam.

facts.text: Vandalism frequently damaged the monument before it was restored by locals.
facts.sourceQuote: Ook was het monument geregeld ten prooi gevallen aan vandalisme. Door inzet van de bewonersorganisatie Noordereiland en met steun van de deelgemeente Feijenoord en de vereniging Historisch Rotterdam, kon het beeld worden gerestaureerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument had also been regularly victimized by vandalism. Through the efforts of the residents' organization Noordereiland and with the support of the Feijenoord district and the Historical Rotterdam association, the image could be restored.

features.name: Coolsingel Gate
features.opening: De Coolsingelpoort aan de Lijnbaan in de Nederlandse stad Rotterdam was de achterpoort van het voormalige Coolsingelziekenhuis aan de Coolsingel.

facts.text: The gate survived the May 1940 bombing that destroyed the rest of the hospital.
facts.sourceQuote: Het ziekenhuis werd tijdens het bombardement op Rotterdam in mei 1940 verwoest waarbij enkele buitenmuren en de poort overeind bleven staan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The hospital was destroyed during the bombing of Rotterdam in May 1940, leaving some outer walls and the gate standing.

facts.text: Ambulances used this gate to enter and exit on what was then called Crispijnlaan.
facts.sourceQuote: Door de poort aan de toenmalige Crispijnlaan reden de ambulances in en uit.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Through the gate on the then Crispijnlaan, the ambulances came in and out.

features.name: Bevrijdingsmonument Vreewijk
features.opening: Bevrijdingsmonument Vreewijk is een oorlogsmonument in Vreewijk, een wijk in de Nederlandse stad Rotterdam.

facts.text: Bevrijdingsmonument Vreewijk means "Liberation Monument Vreewijk" and honors gratitude for the end of WWII.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument getuigt van de dankbaarheid van de wijkbewoners voor de bevrijding aan het einde van de Tweede Wereldoorlog.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument testifies to the gratitude of the neighborhood residents for the liberation at the end of World War II.

facts.text: Artists Joan Bakker and J. Poot created the column featuring dancing figures and a lion.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument van Joan Bakker en J.Poot werd op 5 mei 1950 door burgemeester Oud onthuld en bestaat uit een zuil waarop onderaan dansende figuren zijn uitgebeeld en waarbovenop een leeuw is aangebracht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument of Joan Bakker and J.Poot was unveiled on May 5, 1950 by Mayor Oud and consists of a column on which dancing figures are depicted at the bottom and a lion is attached above it.

facts.text: The pillar bears the inscription: 5 MAY 1945 WE REMEMBER OUR CASUALTIES.
facts.sourceQuote: De tekst op de zuil luidt: 5 MEI 1945 WIJ HERDENKEN ONZE GEVALLENEN
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The text on the pillar reads: 5 MAY 1945 WE REMEMBER OUR CASUALTIES

features.name: Mevlana moskee
features.opening: The Mevlana Mosque (Dutch: Mevlanamoskee; Turkish: Mevlana Camii) is a mosque in northwestern Rotterdam, Netherlands which serves mainly Turkish-Dutch Muslims.

facts.text: The Mevlana moskee honors Rumi, the famous poet and mystic.
facts.sourceQuote: The mosque, named after Rumi, was built in 2001 and has two minarets.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The mosque, named after Rumi, was built in 2001 and has two minarets.

facts.text: Construction of the Mevlana moskee was completed in 2001.
facts.sourceQuote: The mosque, named after Rumi, was built in 2001 and has two minarets.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The mosque, named after Rumi, was built in 2001 and has two minarets.

facts.text: Voters named the Mevlana moskee Rotterdam's most attractive building in 2006.
facts.sourceQuote: The mosque was voted as Rotterdam's most attractive building in 2006.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The mosque was voted as Rotterdam's most attractive building in 2006.

features.name: Salomon Vilbach
features.opening: De Lijst van Stolpersteine in Hillegersberg-Schiebroek geeft een overzicht van de gedenkstenen die in stadskwartier Hillegersberg-Schiebroek in de Nederlandse…

facts.text: Two additional stones were installed on Adrianalaan at the end of November 2024.
facts.sourceQuote: Looslaan 18 19 december 2023: een Stolperstein op Larikslaan 157 30 november 2024: twee Stolpersteine op Adrianalaan 254
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Looslaan 18 December 19, 2023: a Stolperstein on Larikslaan 157 November 30, 2024: two Stolpersteine on Adrianalaan 254

features.name: Belasting & Douane Museum
features.opening: Het Belasting & Douane Museum is een museum in Rotterdam.

facts.text: Founder Johannes van der Poel served as director of Import Duties & Excises before establishing the collection.
facts.sourceQuote: Naamgever Johannes van der Poel was directeur Invoerrechten & Accijnzen. Hij legde een fiscaal-historische verzameling aan om zijn studenten aan de Belastingacademie aanschouwelijk onderwijs te kunnen geven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Founder Johannes van der Poel was director of Import Duties & Excises. He established a tax-historical collection in order to provide his students at the Tax Academy with visible education.

facts.text: The collection includes various items that were historically seized by customs officials.
facts.sourceQuote: Ook liggen er verschillende voorwerpen tentoongesteld die in het verleden door de douane zijn ingenomen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There are also various objects on display that were seized by customs in the past.

features.name: Nederlands Fotomuseum
features.opening: The Netherlands Photo Museum (Dutch: Nederlands Fotomuseum) (NFM) is a photography museum in Rotterdam, the Netherlands, that was founded in 2003.

facts.text: Although initially recommended for Amsterdam, the center was established in Rotterdam within three years.
facts.sourceQuote: The first recommendation was to host this in Amsterdam. However, within three years a proposal had been submitted to the government to host it in Rotterdam (with the additional participation of the Nederlands Fotorestauratie-atelier (the Dutch workshop for photography conservation)) By 2003, the new museum had opened.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first recommendation was to host this in Amsterdam. However, within three years a proposal had been submitted to the government to host it in Rotterdam (with the additional participation of the Nederlands Fotorestauratie-atelier (the Dutch workshop for photography conservation)) By 2003, the new museum had opened.

features.name: Bethlehemkerk
features.opening: De Bethlehemkerk is een voormalige gereformeerde kerk aan de Delftweg in Rotterdam-Overschie, die tegenwoordig dient als Koninkrijkszaal voor de Jehova's…

facts.text: The Reformed Church of Overschie began using the building in 1896.
facts.sourceQuote: De Bethlehemkerk werd in 1896 in gebruik genomen door de Gereformeerde Kerk van Overschie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Bethlehemkerk was put into use in 1896 by the Reformed Church of Overschie.

facts.text: Architect Tjeerd Kuipers designed a simple hall church with a small pointed tower.
facts.sourceQuote: Architect Tjeerd Kuipers ontwierp een eenvoudige zaalkerk, met boven op de voorgevel een kleine spitse toren.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Architect Tjeerd Kuipers designed a simple hall church, with a small pointed tower on top of the front facade.

facts.text: The original tower was later replaced by a new one featuring a saddle roof.
facts.sourceQuote: Het oorspronkelijke torentje is vervangen door een klein nieuw exemplaar met een zadeldak.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The original tower has been replaced by a small new one with a saddle roof.

features.name: Anna van Dantzig-De Kadt
features.opening: De Lijst van Stolpersteine in Hillegersberg-Schiebroek geeft een overzicht van de gedenkstenen die in stadskwartier Hillegersberg-Schiebroek in de Nederlandse…

facts.text: Anna van Dantzig-De Kadt was a victim of the Nazi regime who is commemorated by a Stolperstein.
facts.sourceQuote: Stolpersteine zijn opgedragen aan slachtoffers van het nationaalsocialisme, al diegenen die zijn vervolgd, gedeporteerd, vermoord, gedwongen te emigreren of tot zelfmoord gedreven door het nazi-regime.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Stolpersteine are dedicated to victims of Nazism, all those who were persecuted, deported, murdered, forced to emigrate or driven to suicide by the Nazi regime.

features.name: Betje van Gelderen-Cats
features.opening: De Lijst van Stolpersteine in Hillegersberg-Schiebroek geeft een overzicht van de gedenkstenen die in stadskwartier Hillegersberg-Schiebroek in de Nederlandse…

facts.text: A Stolperstein was placed on Larikslaan 157 in December 2023.
facts.sourceQuote: Looslaan 18 19 december 2023: een Stolperstein op Larikslaan 157 30 november 2024: twee Stolpersteine op Adrianalaan 254
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Looslaan 18 December 19, 2023: a Stolperstein on Larikslaan 157 November 30, 2024: two Stolpersteine on Adrianalaan 254

features.name: Marine Corps Museum
features.opening: Netherlands Marine Corps Museum (Dutch - Mariniersmuseum) is a museum on the history of the Netherlands Marine Corps.

facts.text: Since 2014, it has been managed by the Koninklijke Stichting Defensiemusea.
facts.sourceQuote: Since 2014 it has been one of the four museums managed by the Koninklijke Stichting Defensiemusea (KSD).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2014 it has been one of the four museums managed by the Koninklijke Stichting Defensiemusea (KSD).

features.name: Waalse Kerk
features.opening: De Waalse Kerk met aangrenzende kosterswoning in Rotterdam is gelegen in het Centrum aan de Schiedamse Vest en is een rijksmonument, de kerk en de…

facts.text: The original church stood on a remnant of the western city wall before that wall was demolished in World War II.
facts.sourceQuote: De nieuwe Waalse kerk was oorspronkelijk gesitueerd aan een restant van de oorspronkelijke westelijke stadsvest, die tijdens de Tweede Wereldoorlog werd gedempt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The new Waalse church was originally located on a remnant of the original western city wall, which was demolished during World War II.

facts.text: An almost original organ from the previous seventeenth-century Waalse church was moved here around 1865.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk vervangt de oude zeventiende-eeuwse Waalse kerk aan het noordwest-einde van de Hoogstraat, waaruit het vrijwel originele Bätz-Witte orgel uit omstreeks 1865 is overgenomen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church replaces the old seventeenth-century Waalse church at the northwest end of the Hoogstraat, from which the almost original Bätz-Witte organ was taken over around 1865.

facts.text: A natural stone relief above the main door displays the phrase PAIX VOUS SOIT beneath a dove's wings.
facts.sourceQuote: Boven in de punt van het entreeportaal is een natuurstenen reliëf met onder de vleugels van een duif de woorden "PAIX VOUS SOIT".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the top of the tip of the entrance portal is a natural stone relief with the words "PAIX VOUS SOIT" under the wings of a dove.

features.name: Bergsingelkerk
features.opening: De Bergsingelkerk is een in 1913 door architect Tjeerd Kuipers ontworpen kerk.

facts.text: The largest clock weighs 420 kg and measures 86 cm in diameter while hanging in a combined speaker.
facts.sourceQuote: De grootste klok weegt 420 kg en heeft een diameter van 86 cm; de tweede klok weegt 250 kg en heeft een diameter van 72 cm; de derde klok weegt 175 kg en heeft een diameter van 64 cm; de vierde klok weegt 110 kg en heeft een diameter van 54 cm. De klokken zijn opgehangen in een gecombineerde luidstoel, voorzien van elektrische luidinrichtingen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The largest clock weighs 420 kg and has a diameter of 86 cm; the second clock weighs 250 kg and has a diameter of 72 cm; the third clock weighs 175 kg and has a diameter of 64 cm; the fourth clock weighs 110 kg and has a diameter of 54 cm. The clocks are hung in a combined speaker, equipped with electric sound directions.

features.name: Rotterdam Zoo
features.opening: Diergaarde Blijdorp (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈdiːrˌɣaːrdə ˈblɛidɔr(ə)p]; lit.

facts.text: The first director was animal trainer Henri Martin.
facts.sourceQuote: The first director was the animal trainer Henri Martin.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first director was the animal trainer Henri Martin.

facts.text: A silverback gorilla named Bokito escaped and injured a regular visitor in 2007.
facts.sourceQuote: In May 2007, the zoo appeared in the news when Bokito, Blijdorp's silverback gorilla, escaped from his enclosure and seriously injured a female visitor. Before the attack, the woman was a regular visitor of the zoo (on average 4 times per week) and claimed to have a special bond with Bokito, regularly touching the glass between her and the gorilla, making eye contact with him and smiling at him.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In May 2007, the zoo appeared in the news when Bokito, Blijdorp's silverback gorilla, escaped from his enclosure and seriously injured a female visitor. Before the attack, the woman was a regular visitor of the zoo (on average 4 times per week) and claimed to have a special bond with Bokito, regularly touching the glass between her and the gorilla, making eye contact with him and smiling at him.

facts.text: The institution marked its 150th anniversary in the year 2007.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2007, it celebrated its 150th anniversary.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2007, it celebrated its 150th anniversary.

features.name: Kunstinstituut Melly
features.opening: Kunstinstituut Melly is a contemporary art house located in a former school building on Witte de Withstraat, in Rotterdam, the Netherlands.

facts.text: Activists vandalized the center in June 2020 by leaving red handprints on its facade during protests.
facts.sourceQuote: In June 2020, as part of the George Floyd protests in the Netherlands, activists vandalized symbols of colonialism in Rotterdam. These included the Piet Hein statue in Delfshaven, the Pim Fortuyn memorial and the Witte de With Center, where they left handprints in red paint.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In June 2020, as part of the George Floyd protests in the Netherlands, activists vandalized symbols of colonialism in Rotterdam. These included the Piet Hein statue in Delfshaven, the Pim Fortuyn memorial and the Witte de With Center, where they left handprints in red paint.

facts.text: Chris Dercon served as the institution's first director from 1990 until 1996.
facts.sourceQuote: Chris Dercon was the first director from 1990 to 1996.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Chris Dercon was the first director from 1990 to 1996.

features.name: Atlantikwall-Museum
features.opening: Het Atlantikwall-museum is een bezoekers- en kenniscentrum in het Zuid-Hollandse Hoek van Holland met betrekking tot de Atlantikwall.

facts.text: One original bunker on site is now nicknamed Bunker 2 despite being part of the defense system.
facts.sourceQuote: De bunker staat nu bekend als ‘Bunker 2’.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The bunker is now known as 'Bunker 2'.

facts.text: The facility occupies a German Type 611 bunker constructed along the pier.
facts.sourceQuote: Het museum bevindt zich in een Duitse bunker van het type 611, die gebouwd is langs de pier in Hoek van Holland, bij de monding van de Nieuwe Waterweg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum is located in a German Type 611 bunker, which was built along the pier in Hoek van Holland, near the mouth of the Nieuwe Waterweg.

features.name: Pathé de Kuip
features.opening: Pathé de Kuip werd in 2002 geopend en is een megabioscoop geëxploiteerd door Pathé Nederland.

facts.text: The megaplex spans three floors with fourteen rooms and 2746 seats.
facts.sourceQuote: De bioscoop telt 14 zalen verdeeld over 3 verdiepingen met in totaal 2746 stoelen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The cinema has 14 rooms spread over 3 floors with a total of 2746 seats.

facts.text: Pathé de Kuip takes its name from the adjacent Feyenoord stadium De Kuip.
facts.sourceQuote: De naam van deze bioscoop is afgeleid van het naast gelegen voetbalstadion De Kuip waarin Feyenoord zijn voetbalwedstrijden speelt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name of this cinema is derived from the adjacent football stadium De Kuip where Feyenoord plays its football matches.

facts.text: A Pathé Boulevard offering expanded food choices opened there in early 2018.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds begin 2018 is Pathé De Kuip uitgerust met een zogenoemde Pathé Boulevard, waarbij bezoekers keuze hebben uit een groter assortiment eten en drinken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since the beginning of 2018, Pathé De Kuip has been equipped with a so-called Pathé Boulevard, where visitors have the choice from a larger selection of food and drinks.

features.name: KunstHAL
features.opening: The Kunsthal (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈkʏnstɦɑl] ; English: Art Hall) is an art space in Rotterdam, the Netherlands.

facts.text: Dutch architect Rem Koolhaas designed the building with OMA project architect Fuminori Hoshino.
facts.sourceQuote: The building was designed by the Dutch architect Rem Koolhaas together with project architect Fuminori Hoshino of the architectural firm OMA (Office for Metropolitan Architecture).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building was designed by the Dutch architect Rem Koolhaas together with project architect Fuminori Hoshino of the architectural firm OMA (Office for Metropolitan Architecture).

facts.text: The venue features seven exhibition spaces, an auditorium, and a café within its unique structure.
facts.sourceQuote: It houses seven exhibition spaces, a characteristic auditorium, and a café.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It houses seven exhibition spaces, a characteristic auditorium, and a café.

facts.text: The alleged thieves reportedly met on the dating app Tinder before the heist.
facts.sourceQuote: The alleged thieves were arrested in Romania in July 2013. They reportedly met on Tinder.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The alleged thieves were arrested in Romania in July 2013. They reportedly met on Tinder.

facts.text: Investigators found pigments and nails matching the stolen art in a suspect's fireplace.
facts.sourceQuote: However, investigators found pigments and nails of the correct age for the stolen paintings in her fireplace.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: However, investigators found pigments and nails of the correct age for the stolen paintings in her fireplace.

features.name: Sint-Liduina
features.opening: De Sint-Liduinakerk is een katholieke kerk aan de Burgemeester Le Fèvre de Montignylaan in Hillegersberg (gemeente Rotterdam).

facts.text: The final Holy Mass was celebrated here on April 12, 2026.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 1 januari 2014 maakt de kerk deel uit van de Bernadetteparochie en sinds 2015 staat het op de nominatie gesloten te gaan worden en te fuseren samen met kerken in Overschie tot een nieuw te bouwen kerk in Schiebroek die de Bernadettekerk is gaan heten. op 12 april 2026 met Beloken Pasen vond in de Liduinakerk de allerlaatste Heilige Mis plaats en werd aan de eredienst onttrokken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since January 1, 2014, the church has been part of the Bernadette parish and since 2015 it has been nominated to be closed and merged together with churches in Overschie into a new church to be built in Schiebroek that has come to be called the Bernadette church. On April 12, 2026 with Beloken Easter, the very last Holy Mass took place in the Liduinakerk and was deprived of the service.

features.name: Essalam
features.opening: De Essalammoskee is een grote moskee in de Rotterdamse wijk Feijenoord, nabij voetbalstadion de Kuip.

facts.text: Construction faced repeated delays, finally opening the mosque in 2010 after a seven-year build.
facts.sourceQuote: De bouw van een nieuw gebedshuis duurde van 2003 tot 2010 en is met veel problemen gepaard gegaan waarbij de bouw regelmatig stil viel. De Essalammoskee is ten slotte op 2010 in gebruik genomen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The construction of a new mosque lasted from 2003 to 2010 and was accompanied by many problems, with construction regularly coming to a standstill. Finally, the Essalammoskee was put into use in 2010.

facts.text: Architect Wilfried van Winden based the design on Mamluk architecture from fifteenth-century Cairo.
facts.sourceQuote: De Essalammoskee is ontworpen door de Nederlandse architect Wilfried van Winden. Het ontwerp is gebaseerd op het zogeheten medinaconcept (naar de architectuur van de grote moskee in Medina) en bouwt in stijl voort op de traditie van onder andere de vijftiende-eeuwse mammelukse architectuur te Caïro.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Essalammoskee was designed by the Dutch architect Wilfried van Winden. The design is based on the so-called medina concept (after the architecture of the great mosque in Medina) and builds on the tradition of the fifteenth-century Mamluk architecture in Cairo, among others, in a stylish way.

features.name: Erasmus Universiteit Rotterdam
features.opening: Erasmus University Rotterdam (Dutch: Erasmus Universiteit Rotterdam [eːˈrɑsmʏs ynivɛrsiˈtɛit rɔtərˈdɑm]; abbreviated as EUR) is a public research university…

facts.text: The institution began as the private Netherlands School of Commerce in 1913 before gaining university status in 1937.
facts.sourceQuote: Erasmus University Rotterdam was founded on 8 November 1913 as the Netherlands School of Commerce (Nederlandsche Handels-Hoogeschool, or NHH) through private initiative with broad support from the business community of Rotterdam. In 1937, the school was recognized as a higher educational institute with university status, providing education in commerce and economics as an academic discipline.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Erasmus University Rotterdam was founded on 8 November 1913 as the Netherlands School of Commerce (Nederlandsche Handels-Hoogeschool, or NHH) through private initiative with broad support from the business community of Rotterdam.
