features.name: Darwin's rhea
features.opening: Darwin's rhea or the lesser rhea (Rhea pennata) is a large flightless bird, the smaller of the two extant species of rheas.

facts.text: Gauchos in Northern Patagonia called the smaller rhea "Avestruz Petise" before Darwin found it.
facts.section: History of the discovery of the genus Rhea
facts.sourceQuote: During the second voyage of HMS Beagle, the young naturalist Charles Darwin made many trips on land, and around August 1833 heard from gauchos in the Río Negro area of Northern Patagonia about the existence of a smaller rhea, "a very rare bird which they called the Avestruz Petise".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the second voyage of HMS Beagle, the young naturalist Charles Darwin made many trips on land, and around August 1833 heard from gauchos in the Río Negro area of Northern Patagonia about the existence of a smaller rhea, "a very rare bird which they called the Avestruz Petise".

features.name: Geloof en Vrijheid
features.opening: Geloof en Vrijheid is een gedenkteken aan het gebouw in de 1e Pijnackerstraat in Rotterdam, waar op 18 oktober 1942 een groep ondergrondse werkers door de…

facts.text: On October 18, 1942, a German attack on underground workers at this location killed three resistance members.
facts.sourceQuote: Geloof en Vrijheid is een gedenkteken aan het gebouw in de 1e Pijnackerstraat in Rotterdam, waar op 18 oktober 1942 een groep ondergrondse werkers door de Duitsers werd overvallen. Drie verzetsmensen kwamen om het leven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Geloof en Vrijheid is a monument to the building in the 1st Pijnackerstraat in Rotterdam, where on October 18, 1942, a group of underground workers was attacked by the Germans. Three resistance people died.

facts.text: The sculptor Loekie Metz created the artwork depicting the relief figures.
facts.sourceQuote: Het kunstwerk werd gemaakt door Loekie Metz.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The artwork was created by Loekie Metz.

facts.text: A torch topped by a resistance figure shelters men, women, and children beneath outstretched arms.
facts.sourceQuote: Het reliëf bestaat uit een fakkel, waarin bovenaan een figuur het verzet uitbeeldt. Onder zijn gespreide armen zoeken mannen, vrouwen en kinderen bescherming.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The relief consists of a torch, in which at the top a figure depicts the resistance. Under his outstretched arms, men, women and children seek protection.

features.name: Volharding 1
features.opening: De Volharding 1 is een door stoom aangedreven Nederlandse sleepboot.

facts.text: In August 2008, Volharding 1 escorted the SS Rotterdam from Hoek van Holland to Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuote: Op maandag 4 augustus 2008 escorteerde de Volharding 1 het SS Rotterdam van Hoek van Holland naar Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On Monday, August 4, 2008, the Volharding 1 escorted the SS Rotterdam from Hoek van Holland to Rotterdam.

facts.text: In 1967, the maritime museum Prins Hendrik purchased the ship for just one Dutch florin.
facts.sourceQuote: Toch werd in 1967 een koper gevonden in de vorm van het scheepvaartmuseum "Prins Hendrik" te Rotterdam, dat het schip voor dat bedrag van f 1,-- kocht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: However, in 1967, a buyer was found in the form of the maritime museum "Prins Hendrik" in Rotterdam, which bought the ship for that amount of f 1,--.

features.name: Witte Huis
features.opening: The Witte Huis (Dutch pronunciation: [ˌʋɪtə ˈɦœys]) or White House is a building and National Heritage Site in Rotterdam, Netherlands, built in 1898 in the Art…

facts.text: Skeptics doubted the soft soil could support it, so builders drove 1000 piles into the ground first.
facts.sourceQuote: The site at Wijnhaven 3 is just 1 m above sea-level and skeptics claimed that the soft soil of Rotterdam would be unable to adequately support the building, so before construction could properly begin, 1000 piles were driven into the ground to support the building's weight.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The site at Wijnhaven 3 is just 1 m above sea-level and skeptics claimed that the soft soil of Rotterdam would be unable to adequately support the building, so before construction could properly begin, 1000 piles were driven into the ground to support the building's weight.

facts.text: Fear of fire meant wood was not a significant material in its construction.
facts.sourceQuote: Unlike many other contemporary buildings of the time, wood was not a significant construction material due to the fear of fire.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Unlike many other contemporary buildings of the time, wood was not a significant construction material due to the fear of fire.

features.name: O.L.V. Altijddurende Bijstand
features.opening: De Onze-Lieve-Vrouw van Altijddurende Bijstandkerk is een voormalige katholieke kerk in de deelgemeente Overschie in Rotterdam.

facts.text: Architects Hendriks, Van der Sluys & Van den Bosch designed this reconstruction church.
facts.sourceQuote: Het architectenbureau Hendriks, Van der Sluys & Van den Bosch werd aangetrokken voor het ontwerp.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The architectural firm Hendriks, Van der Sluys & Van den Bosch was hired for the design.

facts.text: Construction plans began in 1950 to replace a smaller church that could not serve the growing community.
facts.sourceQuote: Door de uitbreiding van het dorp Overschie met nieuwbouwwijken werd de Petrus' Bandenkerk te klein om de hele katholieke gemeenschap te bedienen. In 1950 werden plannen gemaakt voor de bouw van een nieuwe kerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Due to the expansion of the village of Overschie with new residential areas, the Petrus' Bandenkerk became too small to serve the entire Catholic community. In 1950 plans were made for the construction of a new church.

facts.text: After closing in 2019, the former church was converted into an apartment complex.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk werd in 2019 gesloten en is verbouwd tot appartementencomplex.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church was closed in 2019 and has been converted into an apartment complex.

features.name: Stieltjesmonument
features.opening: Het Stieltjesmonument is een gedenkteken op het Noordereiland in de Nederlandse gemeente Rotterdam ter nagedachtenis aan Th.J. Stieltjes.

facts.text: Sculptor Eugène Lacomblé created the original white marble relief portrait now held by Museum Boijmans Van Beuningen.
facts.sourceQuote: De beeldhouwer Eugène Lacomblé maakte een reliëfportret in wit marmer. Dit medaillonportret bevindt zich in de collectie van het Museum Boijmans Van Beuningen, aan het monument werd een galvanoplastiek gehangen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The sculptor Eugène Lacomblé made a relief portrait in white marble. This medallion portrait is in the collection of the Museum Boijmans Van Beuningen, a galvanoplast was hung on the monument.

facts.text: The column rises roughly ten meters high and is topped by a pinecone.
facts.sourceQuote: Het gedenkteken bestaat uit een ongeveer tien meter hoge, gecanneleerde zuil op een vierkante sokkel. Het kapiteel van de zuil, waarin aan vier zijden een kop met een gevleugelde helm is te zien, wordt bekroond door een pijnappel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument consists of a roughly ten meter high, crenellated column on a square base. The capital of the column, in which a head with a winged helmet can be seen on four sides, is crowned by a pinecone.

facts.text: Thomas Johannes Stieltjes lived from 1819 to 1878 before this monument was erected.
facts.sourceQuote: Op twee zijden is een gedenkplaat geplaatst met binnen cartouches de opschriften "Thomas Johannes Stieltjes 1819-1878" en "Hulde van vrienden en vereerders 1883".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On two sides, a plaque has been placed with inside cartouches the inscriptions "Thomas Johannes Stieltjes 1819-1878" and "Humble of friends and admirers 1883".

features.name: de Doelen
features.opening: De Doelen is a concert venue and convention centre in Rotterdam, Netherlands.

facts.text: The original structure was destroyed during the German bombardment of Rotterdam in May 1940.
facts.sourceQuote: It was originally built in 1934 but then destroyed in 1940 during the German bombardment of Rotterdam in May 1940 at the outset of World War II.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was originally built in 1934 but then destroyed in 1940 during the German bombardment of Rotterdam in May 1940 at the outset of World War II.

facts.text: A rebuilt version opened in 1966 before two additional halls were added in the 1990s.
facts.sourceQuote: It was rebuilt in 1966, originally with one hall to which two more were added in the 1990s.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was rebuilt in 1966, originally with one hall to which two more were added in the 1990s.

features.name: Het Steiger
features.opening: Het Steiger is een voormalige rooms-katholieke parochiekerk en aangrenzend dominicanerklooster in de binnenstad van Rotterdam.

facts.text: The current church and monastery were inaugurated on May 14, 1960, exactly twenty years after the bombing.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 14 mei 1960, exact twintig jaar na het bombardement werden kerk en klooster ingewijd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On May 14, 1960, exactly twenty years after the bombing, the church and monastery were inaugurated.

facts.text: Mosaics at the entrance were created by Theo Mols while reliefs on the tower were made by Pim van Moorsel.
facts.sourceQuote: De mozaïeken aan weerszijden van de entree zijn van de hand van Theo Mols, de reliëfs aan de toren en in de daklijst werden gemaakt door Pim van Moorsel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The mosaics on either side of the entrance are by Theo Mols, the reliefs on the tower and in the cornice were made by Pim van Moorsel.

facts.text: Locals call it Steigerkerk, Citykerk Het Steiger, or simply Het Steiger due to its canal location.
facts.sourceQuote: Vanwege de ligging van kerk en klooster aan de Steigersgracht is het beter bekend als de Steigerkerk, de Steigersekerk, Citykerk Het Steiger of kortweg Het Steiger.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Due to the location of the church and monastery on the Steigersgracht, it is better known as the Steigerkerk, the Steigersekerk, Citykerk Het Steiger or simply Het Steiger.

features.opening: The Gymnasium Erasmianum is a school in Rotterdam (also known under its Dutch name "Erasmiaans Gymnasium").

facts.text: German troops converted the surviving building into a headquarters immediately after the Dutch surrender in May 1940.
facts.sourceQuote: In May 1940, the center of Rotterdam was bombed during the German invasion of the Netherlands, but the school building survived as it was outside the focus of the bombing and subsequent fires. After Dutch surrender, the occupying German troops used the building as one of their headquarters.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In May 1940, the center of Rotterdam was bombed during the German invasion of the Netherlands, but the school building survived as it was outside the focus of the bombing and subsequent fires. After Dutch surrender, the occupying German troops used the building as one of their headquarters.

features.name: Rotterdam Cruise Terminal
features.opening: The Rotterdam Cruise Terminal is a building on the Wilhelmina Pier, Rotterdam.

facts.text: The venue hosted the Turquoise Carpet event for Eurovision Song Contest 2021 on May 16.

features.name: Kubuswoningen
features.opening: De kubuswoningen in Rotterdam zijn 38 kubusvormige paalwoningen en 13 bedrijfskubussen bij de Blaak nabij de Oude Haven.

facts.text: Construction occurred between 1982 and 1984 following a 1978 plan presentation.
facts.sourceQuote: Ze zijn gebouwd tussen 1982 en 1984, na een eerste presentatie van de plannen in 1978.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: They were built between 1982 and 1984, after a first presentation of the plans in 1978.

facts.text: Architect Piet Blom designed these structures as a larger variant of the Helmond cube house.
facts.sourceQuote: Het ontwerp van Piet Blom is een variant op de Helmondse kubuswoning in een iets groter maatraster.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The design by Piet Blom is a variant of the Helmond cube house in a slightly larger grid size.

facts.text: Each cube rests on a hexagonal column containing the entrance and staircase.
facts.sourceQuote: In de zeshoekige kolom waarop de woning rust, bevinden zich de entree en het trappenhuis.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the hexagonal column on which the house rests, there are the entrance and the staircase.

features.name: Havenspoorlijn Rotterdam West
features.opening: De Havenspoorlijn Rotterdam West was een goederenspoorlijn met vier emplacementen in Rotterdam-West op de rechter Maasoever.

facts.text: A four-lane bridge replaced an insufficient double-track span in 1911 to handle more freight trains.
facts.sourceQuote: De capaciteit van de dubbelsporige brug over de Delfshavense Schie was onvoldoende om ook de extra goederentreinen op te vangen. Deze brug werd daarom vervangen door een viersporige brug die in 1911 geopend werd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The capacity of the double-track bridge over the Delfshavense Schie was insufficient to handle the additional freight trains as well. This bridge was therefore replaced by a four-lane bridge that was opened in 1911.

facts.text: Tracks east of Schiemond vanished between 2000 and 2002, erasing Hudsonstraat station completely.
facts.sourceQuote: De sporen ten oosten van Schiemond zijn tussen 2000 en 2002 opgebroken en het emplacement aan de Hudsonstraat is geheel verdwenen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The tracks east of Schiemond were dismantled between 2000 and 2002 and the Hudsonstraat station site has completely disappeared.

facts.text: The final harbor railway activity involved construction trains for a subway tunnel before the line closed in autumn 2008.
facts.sourceQuote: De laatste activiteit op het havenspoor betrof werktreinen voor de aanleg van een metrotunnel. In de herfst van 2008 is het wissel in de aansluiting van het hoofdspoor (richting de spoorbrug Delfshavense Schie) afgesloten en sindsdien wordt het havenspoor, voor zover het nog aanwezig was, ontmanteld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The last activity on the harbor railway concerned working trains for the construction of a subway tunnel. In the autumn of 2008, the switch in the connection of the main line (in the direction of the Delfshavense Schie railway bridge) was closed and since then the harbor track, as far as it was still present, has been dismantled.

facts.text: Today an unpaved walking path follows the old embankment from Marconiplein west of Spangen while signals remain on display.
facts.sourceQuote: Heden is de spoordijk vanaf het Marconiplein ten westen van Spangen een onverhard wandelpad. Een aantal spoorattributen zoals seinen en bebording zijn nog te bezichtigen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Today, the railway embankment from Marconiplein west of Spangen is an unpaved walking path. A number of railway attributes such as signals and signage are still on display.

features.name: Hervormde kerk
features.opening: De Nederlands Hervormde Kerk is een kerk in Pernis.

facts.text: The current structure was erected in 1926, replacing a much older thirteenth-century predecessor.
facts.sourceQuote: Het huidige kerkgebouw is uit 1926 en is in de plaats gekomen van een gebouw uit oorspronkelijk de dertiende eeuw.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The current church building dates from 1926 and replaced a building originally from the thirteenth century.

facts.text: Clockmaker P. Oostens crafted the clock in 1672.
facts.sourceQuote: De klokkenstoel met klok komt uit 1672 en is gemaakt door P. Oostens, 1672, de klok heeft een diameter van 68 cm.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The clock chair with clock dates back to 1672 and was made by P. Oostens, 1672, the clock has a diameter of 68 cm.

features.name: Havenmuseum
features.opening: Het Havenmuseum bevindt zich in en aan de Leuvehaven in de Zuid-Hollandse stad Rotterdam.

facts.text: The institution formed in 2002 by merging two older maritime foundations.
facts.sourceQuote: Het museum is in 2002 ontstaan door samenvoeging van de Stichting Openlucht Binnenvaartmuseum (SOB) en het Maritiem Buitenmuseum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum was created in 2002 by the merger of the Open Air Inland Waterway Museum Foundation (SOB) and the Maritime Outdoor Museum.

features.name: Hoornbeeck College
features.opening: Het Hoornbeeck College is een reformatorische school die onderwijs aanbiedt op mbo-niveau.

facts.text: The school honors Johannes Hoornbeeck, a Reformed professor.
facts.sourceQuote: De naam van de school is ontleend aan de reformatorische hoogleraar Johannes Hoornbeeck.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name of the school is derived from the Reformed professor Johannes Hoornbeeck.

facts.text: In 2020, it won the title of best MBO school in the Netherlands for the eleventh time.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2020 werd het Hoornbeeck College voor de elfde keer tot beste mbo-school van Nederland uitgeroepen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2020, Hoornbeeck College was crowned the best MBO school in the Netherlands for the eleventh time.

facts.text: Students can choose from over 90 distinct courses across four major sectors.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Hoornbeeck College biedt meer dan 90 opleidingen aan in de sectoren Economie & Handel, Gezondheidszorg & Welzijn, Technologie en Dienstverlening.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Hoornbeeck College offers more than 90 courses in the sectors Economy & Trade, Healthcare & Welfare, Technology and Services.

facts.text: The Bible serves as the daily basis and guideline for all school practices.
facts.sourceQuote: Voor de dagelijkse praktijk in de school geldt de Bijbel als grondslag en richtsnoer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: For daily practice in the school, the Bible is the basis and guideline.

features.name: Treurende vrouw
features.opening: Treurende vrouw is een oorlogsmonument in Rotterdam.

facts.text: A seated weeping woman holding her head with one hand sits atop the pedestal.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld op een sokkel toont uit een zittende treurende vrouw, haar hoofd ondersteunend met een hand.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The image on a pedestal depicts a seated weeping woman, holding her head with one hand.

features.name: Paradijskerk
features.opening: De Paradijskerk is een oudkatholiek kerkgebouw aan de Nieuwe Binnenweg in Rotterdam.

facts.text: The organ case was designed by Flemish sculptor Alexander Dominicus Pluskens in 1721.
facts.sourceQuote: De kas van het orgel dateert uit 1721, toen Verhofstadt een nieuw orgel voor de vorige Paradijskerk leverde en is ontworpen door de Vlaamse beeldhouwer Alexander Dominicus Pluskens.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The organ case dates back to 1721, when Verhofstadt delivered a new organ for the previous Paradijskerk and was designed by the Flemish sculptor Alexander Dominicus Pluskens.

facts.text: A major restoration in 1972 used the church's 1858 condition as its starting point.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1972/73 voert de firma Verschueren (Heythuysen) een algehele restauratie uit, waarbij de toestand van 1858 als uitgangspunt geldt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1972/73, the Verschueren (Heythuysen) company carried out a general restoration, using the condition of 1858 as the starting point.

features.name: Museum Boijmans Van Beuningen
features.opening: Municipal Museum Boijmans Van Beuningen (Dutch pronunciation: [myˈzeːjʏm ˈboːimɑns fɑm ˈbøːnɪŋə(n)]) is an art museum in Rotterdam in the Netherlands.

facts.text: A fire in 1864 destroyed much of the museum's original collection.
facts.sourceQuote: Much of the museum's original collection was destroyed in a fire in 1864.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Much of the museum's original collection was destroyed in a fire in 1864.

facts.text: Ronny Naftaniel unsuccessfully demanded removing Van Beuningen's name due to alleged Nazi-era thefts.
facts.sourceQuote: A representative of the Dutch Jewish community, Ronny Naftaniel, demanded - without success - the removal of Van Beuningen's name. It was alleged that acquisitions in Van Beuningen's collection has been illegally taken from Jewish owners during the period of Nazi occupation in the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A representative of the Dutch Jewish community, Ronny Naftaniel, demanded - without success - the removal of Van Beuningen's name. It was alleged that acquisitions in Van Beuningen's collection has been illegally taken from Jewish owners during the period of Nazi occupation in the Netherlands.

facts.text: The damaged Rothko work was stored in the Depot, a facility open to the public.
facts.sourceQuote: At the time of the incident, it was housed in the Depot, a storage facility that is open to the public and located next to the museum's main building.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the time of the incident, it was housed in the Depot, a storage facility that is open to the public and located next to the museum's main building.

features.name: Oude of Pelgrimvaderskerk
features.opening: The Old or Pilgrim Fathers' Church (Dutch: Oude of Pelgrimvaderskerk Rotterdam-Delfshaven) is a church located in Rotterdam-Delfshaven, in the Netherlands.

facts.text: American visitors later bestowed the third name Oude of Pelgrimvaderskerk upon the church.
facts.sourceQuote: Much later, American visitors gave the church its third name, Pilgrim Fathers' Church.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Much later, American visitors gave the church its third name, Pilgrim Fathers' Church.

facts.text: In 1761 the structure was raised by 3.6 metres and given its current bell-shaped gable facade.
facts.sourceQuote: The most radical rebuilding took place in 1761. At this time the church was heightened considerably (3.6 metres (12 ft)) and was given its present facade with the bell-shaped gable.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The most radical rebuilding took place in 1761. At this time the church was heightened considerably (3.6 metres (12 ft)) and was given its present facade with the bell-shaped gable.

facts.text: Pilgrims knelt in prayer on the quay near this church before sailing to America in 1620.
facts.sourceQuote: The Speedwell left Delfshaven, on 21 July 1620, bound for America. According to the chronicles the Pilgrim Fathers knelt down in prayer on the quay near the church.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Speedwell left Delfshaven, on 21 July 1620, bound for America. According to the chronicles the Pilgrim Fathers knelt down in prayer on the quay near the church.

facts.text: A richly carved eighteenth-century pulpit stands inside a rectangular enclosure where church council members sat.
facts.sourceQuote: The richly carved pulpit dates from the eighteenth century. As usual in Dutch Protestant churches, the pulpit stands within a rectangular enclosure. Here, the members of the church council sat during services and here, baptism was administered.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The richly carved pulpit dates from the eighteenth century. As usual in Dutch Protestant churches, the pulpit stands within a rectangular enclosure. Here, the members of the church council sat during services and here, baptism was administered.

facts.text: Although the church has a 44-bell carillon, its oldest bell from 1464 is cracked and now displayed indoors.
facts.sourceQuote: It has a 44-bell carillon but the oldest bell, which was cast in 1464, is cracked and is now on display in the church.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It has a 44-bell carillon but the oldest bell, which was cast in 1464, is cracked and is now on display in the church.

features.name: Prinsestheater
features.opening: Het Prinses Theater is een theater in Delfshaven, Rotterdam.

facts.text: The theater hosted wide films in the 1950s and served as a Kingdom Hall for Jehovah's Witnesses starting in 1975.
facts.sourceQuote: In de jaren vijftig was het theater een van de eerste bioscopen waar brede films gedraaid konden worden. Vanaf 1975 was in het gebouw de Koninkrijkzaal van de Jehova's getuigen ondergebracht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the 1950s, the theater was one of the first cinemas where wide films could be shown. From 1975, the Kingdom Hall of the Jehovah's Witnesses was housed in the building.

facts.text: Silent films here were accompanied by an orchestra until sound movies arrived in 1928.
facts.sourceQuote: Tot de introductie van de geluidsfilms in 1928 werden de films begeleid met een orkest.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Until the introduction of sound films in 1928, the films were accompanied by an orchestra.

features.name: Dockyard V
features.opening: De Dockyard V is een Nederlandse stoomsleepboot gebouwd onder bouwnummer 227 bij de Rotterdamsche Droogdok Maatschappij (RDM).

facts.text: Steam power ended its active service in 1978 before it joined a museum collection.
facts.sourceQuote: De Dockyard V heeft tot 1978 in actieve dienst gevaren bij de RDM, toen het haar stoomtijdperk eindigde. Het schip werd in 1980 overgenomen door het Maritiem Museum Prins Hendrik, net als de Dockyard IX.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Dockyard V was in active service with the RDM until 1978, when its steam era ended. The ship was taken over by the Maritime Museum Prins Hendrik in 1980, just like the Dockyard IX.

facts.text: The vessel measured 25.10 meters in length with a displacement of 245 tons.

facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Dimensions Length: 25.10 meters Width: 6.24 meters Depth: 2.90 meters Displacement: 245 tons Steam boiler Type: RDM Scottish boiler Main machine Type: RDM Lentz valve machine Power: 500 IPK Working pressure: 14 bar

features.name: Breepleinkerk
features.opening: De Breepleinkerk is een voormalige gereformeerde kerk in Rotterdam die in 1931 werd gebouwd.

facts.text: The original builder, Reformed Church Rotterdam Zuid, ceased to exist in 2008.
facts.sourceQuote: De 'Gereformeerde Kerk Rotterdam Zuid (Katendrecht)', die de bouwer was, hield in 2008 op te bestaan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The 'Reformed Church Rotterdam Zuid (Katendrecht)', which was the builder, ceased to exist in 2008.

facts.text: A foundation now preserves the church as a war memorial and meeting center.
facts.sourceQuote: Stichting 'Vrienden van de Breepleinkerk en van de Orgelzolder' zet zich sindsdien in voor de instandhouding van het kerkgebouw als ontmoetingscentrum, oorlogsherinneringsplaats en markant punt in het stadsbeeld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since then, the Foundation 'Friends of the Breepleinkerk and of the Organ Attic' has been working to preserve the church building as a meeting center, war memorial and prominent landmark in the cityscape.

features.name: Sint-Pauluskerk
features.opening: De Sint-Pauluskerk is een kerkgebouw aan de Larikslaan 182 te Schiebroek, een deel van Rotterdam.

facts.text: Construction finally began in 1941 after Pastor Lansbergen stabilized parish finances.
facts.sourceQuote: Pastoor Lansbergen, benoemd in 1939, wist de financiën van de parochie op orde te krijgen en van 1941-1942 kon men een kerk bouwen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Pastor Lansbergen, appointed in 1939, managed to put the finances of the parish in order and from 1941-1942 a church could be built.

facts.text: Stained glass by Pieter Wiegersma includes a window depicting the conversion of Paul.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1983 werden glas-in-loodramen aangebracht, vervaardigd door Pieter Wiegersma. Eén daarvan stelt de bekering van Paulus voor.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1983, stained glass windows were installed, manufactured by Pieter Wiegersma. One of them proposes the conversion of Paul.

features.name: TR Schouwburg
features.opening: Rotterdamse Schouwburg is a theatre in Rotterdam in The Netherlands.

facts.text: The third building was destroyed during the German bombing of Rotterdam in 1940.
facts.sourceQuote: The third Rotterdamse Schouwburg was destroyed during the German bombing of Rotterdam in 1940.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The third Rotterdamse Schouwburg was destroyed during the German bombing of Rotterdam in 1940.

facts.text: The current building opened at Schouwburgplein 25 in 1988.
facts.sourceQuote: The present building of the Rotterdamse Schouwburg was inaugurated in 1988 on address Schouwburgplein 25, 3012 CL Rotterdam
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The present building of the Rotterdamse Schouwburg was inaugurated in 1988 on address Schouwburgplein 25, 3012 CL Rotterdam

features.name: De Nieuwlandse Molen
features.opening: De Nieuwlandse Molen of de molen Van der Knijff (in de volksmond zo genoemd naar de molenaarsfamilie die al generaties lang de molen laat draaien) is in de…

facts.text: In 1988, the mill was raised by 5.60 meters to accommodate nearby glasshouse horticulture.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1988 is het windrecht afgekocht en werd de Nieuwlandse Molen met 5,60 m verhoogd in verband met de glastuinbouw, die tot op zeer korte afstand van de molen aanwezig is.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1988, the wind rights were purchased and the Nieuwlandse Molen was raised by 5.60 m in connection with the glasshouse horticulture, which is present very close to the mill.

features.name: Fort aan den Hoek van Holland
features.opening: Het Fort aan den Hoek van Holland, ook Fort 1881 genoemd, is een voormalig pantserfort in Hoek van Holland.

facts.text: A coastal battery with forty 15 cm guns was installed in the dunes near the fort.
facts.sourceQuote: Ook werd in duinen een kustbatterij geplaatst met 15 cm lang 40 geschut, dat op 12 oktober 1939 de eerste schietoefening deed.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A coastal battery with 40 guns 15 cm long was also placed in dunes, which conducted its first firing exercise on October 12, 1939.

facts.text: Soldiers returned from Rozenburg on May 11 with twelve captured German soldiers and light machine guns.
facts.sourceQuote: Duitse parachutisten landden op de zuidelijke oever van de Nieuwe Waterweg en daarop werden beschikbare manschappen, zo'n 12 onderofficieren en 50 korporaals en manschappen, van het fort naar het eiland Rozenburg gezonden. Het detachement keerde op 11 mei terug met 12 gevangengenomen Duitse militairen en buitgemaakte lichte mitrailleurs.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: German paratroopers landed on the southern bank of the Nieuwe Waterweg and from there available personnel, about 12 non-commissioned officers and 50 corporals and men, were sent from the fort to the island of Rozenburg. The detachment returned on May 11 with 12 captured German military personnel and captured light machine guns.

facts.text: The fort stood empty and decayed for nine years between 1978 and 1987.
facts.sourceQuote: Van 1978 tot 1987 stond het fort leeg en trad het verval in.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 1978 to 1987 the fort was empty and decayed.

facts.text: From 1989 until 2014, the Dutch Coastal Defense Museum operated within these walls.
facts.sourceQuote: Van 1989 tot 2014 was het Nederlands Kustverdedigingsmuseum in het fort gevestigd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 1989 to 2014, the Dutch Coastal Defense Museum was located in the fort.

features.name: Rotterdams Openbaar Vervoer Museum
features.opening: De stichting RoMeO is een organisatie die zich bezighoudt met de exploitatie van oude trams, metro's en bussen in Rotterdam en staat voor "Rotterdams Openbaar…

facts.text: The name Rotterdams Openbaar Vervoer Museum stands for "Rotterdams Openbaar Vervoer museum and Operation of Oldtimers".
facts.sourceQuote: De stichting RoMeO is een organisatie die zich bezighoudt met de exploitatie van oude trams, metro's en bussen in Rotterdam en staat voor "Rotterdams Openbaar Vervoer museum en Exploitatie van Oldtimers".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The RoMeO foundation is an organization that deals with the operation of old trams, subways and buses in Rotterdam and stands for "Rotterdams Openbaar Vervoer museum and Operation of Oldtimers".

facts.text: RoMeO was founded in 1997 by merging several groups previously involved in Rotterdam public transport history.
facts.sourceQuote: RoMeO is opgericht in 1997 en bundelt de activiteiten van verschillende organisaties die zich al voordien bezighielden met de historie van het Rotterdamse openbaar vervoer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: RoMeO was founded in 1997 and brings together the activities of several organizations that had previously been involved in the history of Rotterdamse public transport.

facts.text: In May 2016, RET announced plans to abandon the Hillegersberg depot used for tram maintenance and storage.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 17 mei 2016 maakte de RET bekend afstand te willen doen van de remise Hillegersberg waar de trams onderhouden worden, gestald staan en het trammuseum is gevestigd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On May 17, 2016, the RET announced that it wanted to give up the Hillegersberg depot where the trams are maintained, stored and the tram museum is located.

features.name: Mariniersmonument
features.opening: The Marine memorial (Dutch: Mariniersmonument) is a war memorial on Oostplein in Rotterdam, Netherlands.

facts.text: Prince Bernhard unveiled this war memorial on July 5, 1963 to honor Marines who fought in the Battle of the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuote: It commemorates and thanks the Netherlands Marine Corps who fought hard for the city in the Battle of the Netherlands. The monument, a bronze statue of a marine, was made by Titus Leeser and was unveiled by Prince Bernhard on July 5, 1963.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It commemorates and thanks the Netherlands Marine Corps who fought hard for the city in the Battle of the Netherlands. The monument, a bronze statue of a marine, was made by Titus Leeser and was unveiled by Prince Bernhard on July 5, 1963.

features.name: Scots International Church
features.opening: The Scots International Church or the Scottish Church (Dutch: Schotse Kerk) is located in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

facts.text: A new building was laid on December 13, 1695, and opened in October 1697.
facts.sourceQuote: On 13 December 1695, there was laid the foundation of a new church, which was opened in October 1697 by Robert Fleming the younger.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On 13 December 1695, there was laid the foundation of a new church, which was opened in October 1697 by Robert Fleming the younger.

facts.text: The Scots International Church is also known by its Dutch name, Schotse Kerk.
facts.sourceQuote: The Scots International Church or the Scottish Church (Dutch: Schotse Kerk) is located in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Scots International Church or the Scottish Church (Dutch: Schotse Kerk) is located in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

features.name: Heilige Kruisvindingkerk
features.opening: De Heilige Kruisvindingkerk is een rooms-katholiek kerkgebouw aan de Beukendaal 2 in Rotterdam.

facts.text: The original Odiliak bell was seized by German occupiers in 1943 and replaced in 1947.
facts.sourceQuote: De oorspronkelijke Odiliaklok uit 1927 werd in oktober 1943 door de Duitse bezetter gevorderd en in 1947 vervangen door de huidige klok.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The original Odiliak bell from 1927 was requisitioned by the German occupiers in October 1943 and replaced in 1947 by the current bell.

facts.text: Twelve granite columns support the wide central nave beneath a roof reaching seventeen meters high.
facts.sourceQuote: De nok van het middenschip is 17 meter hoog. Het brede middenschip steunt op 12 granieten zuilen en wordt verlicht door grote rondboogvensters, negen aan beide zijden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The roof of the midship is 17 meters high. The wide central nave is supported by 12 granite columns and is illuminated by large rounded arc windows, nine on each side.

facts.text: The symbolic first stone was laid on May 3, the feast of the Heilige Kruisvinding.
facts.section: Stichting parochie en bouw van de kerk
facts.sourceQuote: Terwijl de eerste muren al gebouwd waren werd de symbolische eerste steen gelegd op 3 mei 1926, de katholieke feestdag van de Heilige Kruisvinding, die volgens de overlevering exact 1600 jaar daarvoor had plaatsgevonden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: While the first walls were already built, the symbolic first stone was laid on May 3, 1926, the Catholic feast day of the Heilige Crusades, which according to tradition had taken place exactly 1600 years earlier.

features.name: SS Rotterdam
features.opening: The fifth SS Rotterdam, also known as "The Grande Dame", is a former ocean liner and cruise ship, and has been a hotel ship in Rotterdam, Netherlands, since…

facts.text: Midnight on September 13, 2000, marked when Premier Cruises shut down and ordered the captain to dock in Halifax.
facts.sourceQuote: She continued to serve as a fairly popular cruise ship out of Port Canaveral, Florida until 13 September 2000, when Premier Cruises shut down. It was midnight when this was made official and the captain of Rembrandt was ordered to dock in Halifax, Nova Scotia and offload all.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: She continued to serve as a fairly popular cruise ship out of Port Canaveral, Florida until 13 September 2000, when Premier Cruises shut down. It was midnight when this was made official and the captain of Rembrandt was ordered to dock in Halifax, Nova Scotia and offload all.

facts.text: The Halifax Sheriff's department placed the vessel under arrest until the following morning after it arrived.
facts.sourceQuote: She was subsequently placed under arrest by the Halifax Sheriff's department until the next morning, then days later she sailed to be laid up in Freeport, Bahamas.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: She was subsequently placed under arrest by the Halifax Sheriff's department until the next morning, then days later she sailed to be laid up in Freeport, Bahamas.

facts.text: WestCord Hotels purchased the vessel in June 2013.
facts.sourceQuote: On 12 June 2013, she was sold to WestCord Hotels, which also owns the Hotel New York located in the former Holland America Line headquarters building in Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On 12 June 2013, she was sold to WestCord Hotels, which also owns the Hotel New York located in the former Holland America Line headquarters building in Rotterdam.

features.name: Bibliotheektheater Rotterdam
features.opening: Het Bibliotheektheater is een theater in het centrum van Rotterdam, gehuisvest in het gebouw van de Centrale Bibliotheek Rotterdam, gevestigd aan de Hoogstraat.

facts.text: Bibliotheektheater Rotterdam opened its doors in 1983.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Bibliotheektheater is in 1983 geopend.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Bibliotheektheater opened in 1983.

features.name: World Port Center
features.opening: World Port Centre is a 33-storey, 123.1 m (404 ft) skyscraper in Rotterdam, Netherlands.

facts.text: Sir Norman Foster, the architect behind London Stansted Airport, designed this structure.
facts.sourceQuote: Sir Norman Foster designed the 32-storey building. This British architect gained international fame with his designs for the London Stansted Airport, the Hong Kong & Shanghai Bank in Hong Kong, the extension of the Reichstag building in Berlin and the 259 m (850 ft) Commerzbank Tower in Frankfurt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Sir Norman Foster designed the 32-storey building. This British architect gained international fame with his designs for the London Stansted Airport, the Hong Kong & Shanghai Bank in Hong Kong, the extension of the Reichstag building in Berlin and the 259 m (850 ft) Commerzbank Tower in Frankfurt.

facts.text: Foster created the master plan for the entire Wilhelminapier in 1992.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1992 he designed the master plan of the entire Wilhelminapier, where the World Port Centre is standing.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1992 he designed the master plan of the entire Wilhelminapier, where the World Port Centre is standing.

facts.text: ING Real Estate Development commissioned the tower's construction.
facts.sourceQuote: The tower was commissioned by ING Real Estate Development.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The tower was commissioned by ING Real Estate Development.

features.name: Maranathakerk
features.opening: De Maranathakerk is een protestants kerkgebouw aan de Hillevliet in de Zuid-Hollandse stad Rotterdam.

facts.text: Construction began after the Wilhelminakerk became too small for growing neighborhoods in the 1920s.
facts.sourceQuote: Nadat de Wilhelminakerk in de loop van de jaren 1920 te klein was geworden door de toestroom van kerkgangers uit de nieuw gebouwde wijken Bloemhof en Hillesluis, werd besloten een nieuwe Hervormde kerk tussen deze wijken te bouwen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After the Wilhelminakerk became too small over the course of the 1920s due to the influx of churchgoers from the newly built neighborhoods of Bloemhof and Hillesluis, it was decided to build a new Reformed church between these neighborhoods.

facts.text: Architects Boeijenga and Hoogeveen designed the structure in typical interwar style.
facts.sourceQuote: B.Th. Boeijenga en R.J. Hoogeveen ontwierpen een kerk in typische interbellumarchitectuur.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: B.Th. Boeijenga and R.J. Hoogeveen designed a church in typical interwar architecture.

facts.text: A massive 25-manual organ from Van den Heuvel has been installed since 1997.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk beschikt sinds 1997 over een 25-stemmig orgel van de firma Van den Heuvel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 1997, the church has had a 25-manual organ from the Van den Heuvel company.

features.name: Villa Zebra
features.opening: Villa Zebra is een kunstlaboratorium voor kinderen van 2 tot en met 12 jaar in Rotterdam.

facts.text: Jet Manrho and Wim van Krimpen founded the foundation behind Villa Zebra in 1997.
facts.sourceQuote: Samen met Wim van Krimpen, destijds directeur van Kunsthal Rotterdam, richtte Manrho in 1997 de Stichting Kinderkunsthal Rotterdam op.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Together with Wim van Krimpen, then director of Kunsthal Rotterdam, Manrho founded the Stichting Kinderkunsthal Rotterdam in 1997.

facts.text: Albert Kramer created the rooftop artwork named Gibra at its Stieltjesstraat location.
facts.sourceQuote: Op het dak van het pand aan de Stieltjesstraat bevindt zich het kunstwerk Gibra van Albert Kramer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the roof of the building on Stieltjesstraat is the artwork Gibra by Albert Kramer.

facts.text: Children aged two to six focus on sensory discovery and play rather than traditional art instruction.
facts.sourceQuote: Voor kinderen van 2 tot en met 6 jaar ontwikkelt Villa Zebra programma’s waarin spel, beleving en zintuiglijke ontdekking centraal staan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: For children from 2 to 6 years of age, Villa Zebra develops programs in which play, experience and sensory discovery are central.

facts.text: The organization hosts pop-up events in various Rotterdam neighborhoods beyond its main location.
facts.sourceQuote: Daarnaast organiseert de organisatie pop-ups in diverse Rotterdamse wijken en biedt zij kunsteducatieve trajecten op scholen aan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In addition, the organization organizes pop-ups in various Rotterdam neighborhoods and offers art educational courses at schools.

features.name: Alexander Nevskikerk
features.opening: De Kerk van de Heilige rechtgelovige grootvorst Alexander Nevski (Russisch: Церковь Святого Александра Невского, Tserkov Sviatogo Aleksandr Nevskogo) is een…

facts.text: Architect Leen Waardenburg designed the church alongside his Russian wife, Lilia Gabo.
facts.sourceQuote: Het ontwerp is van architect Leen Waardenburg te Hattem en zijn Russische echtgenote Lilia Gabo uit Sint - Petersburg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The design was by architect Leen Waardenburg from Hattem and his Russian wife Lilia Gabo from St. Petersburg.

facts.text: Construction began in September 2002 when the first post was driven into the ground.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 19 september 2002 werd de eerste paal in de grond geslagen en op 13 november werd de eerste steen van de kerk gezegend.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On September 19, 2002, the first post was driven into the ground and on November 13, the first stone of the church was blessed.

facts.text: The dome and cross were placed on the building on May 7, 2003.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 7 mei 2003 werd de koepel met kruis geplaatst.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On May 7, 2003, the dome with cross was placed.

facts.text: Services are conducted in Church Slavonic while main lectures are simultaneously repeated in Dutch.
facts.sourceQuote: De diensten worden gevierd in het Kerkslavisch en de belangrijkste lezingen worden herhaald in het Nederlands.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The services are celebrated in Church Slavonic and the main lectures are repeated in Dutch.

features.name: Lage Bergse Bos
features.opening: The Lage Bergse Bos is a recreational area in the municipality of Lansingerland, in the Dutch province of South Holland.

facts.text: Peat digging around 1500 created water puddles later drained by windmills and electric pumps.
facts.sourceQuote: Rond 1500 werd er in het gebied turf gestoken, waardoor na verloop van tijd waterplassen ontstonden. Met windmolens werd het gebied weer drooggelegd; in 1914 nam elektrische bemaling het over.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Around 1500, peat was dug in the area, which over time caused puddles of water to form. With windmills the area was drained again; in 1914 electric pumping took over.

facts.text: A section of the forest was cut down to make way for the tunnel route built into the original plan.
facts.sourceQuote: In oktober 2025 is de verlenging van de A16, met een half verdiepte tunnel, de Rottemerentunnel, door het bos in gebruik genomen; deze weg was bij de aanleg van het bos al voorzien. Voor het traject is een deel van het bos gekapt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In October 2025, the extension of the A16, with a half-buried tunnel, the Rottemerentunnel, was put into use through the forest; this road was already provided for when the forest was built. A part of the forest has been cut down for the route.

features.name: Vroesenpark
features.opening: The Vroesenpark is a city park in Rotterdam-North.

facts.text: In 1940, the southern section of Vroesenpark was absorbed into Diergaarde Blijdorp.
facts.sourceQuote: From 1940, the part of the park south of the Stadhoudersweg became part of Diergaarde Blijdorp.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 1940, the part of the park south of the Stadhoudersweg became part of Diergaarde Blijdorp.

features.name: Zuiderpark
features.opening: The Zuiderpark is a city park in the Rotterdam neighbourhood of Charlois.

facts.text: New water features were added to increase the park's storage capacity.
facts.sourceQuote: New water features were created for additional water storage capacity.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: New water features were created for additional water storage capacity.

facts.text: Several pop festivals have been hosted within the park over the years.
facts.sourceQuote: Several pop festivals have also been held there over the years.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Several pop festivals have also been held there over the years.

features.name: Museumpark
features.opening: Museumpark is an urban park in Rotterdam, Netherlands, located between the Museum Boijmans Van Beuningen, Westersingel, Westzeedijk and the complex of the…

facts.text: Museumpark takes its name from the cluster of museums located in its immediate vicinity.
facts.sourceQuote: There are a number of museums located in the vicinity of the park, hence the name: The Netherlands Architecture Institute (NAi), since 2013 Het Nieuwe Instituut Museum Boijmans Van Beuningen and its new Depot, opened on November 5, 2021 The Chabot Museum The Kunsthal Huis Sonneveld Natuurhistorisch Museum Rotterdam
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There are a number of museums located in the vicinity of the park, hence the name: The Netherlands Architecture Institute (NAi), since 2013 Het Nieuwe Instituut Museum Boijmans Van Beuningen and its new Depot, opened on November 5, 2021 The Chabot Museum The Kunsthal Huis Sonneveld Natuurhistorisch Museum Rotterdam

features.name: Buitenplaats De Tempel
features.opening: The Tempel is a country house in the Dutch municipality of Rotterdam.

facts.text: The current main building dates from 1939, though the estate originated as a medieval manor around 1485.
facts.sourceQuote: Het huidige hoofdgebouw is uit 1939, maar de buitenplaats is ontstaan uit een middeleeuwse hofstede rond 1485, die onder meer in handen is geweest van Johan van Oldenbarneveldt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The current main building dates from 1939, but the estate originated from a medieval manor around 1485, which has been in the hands of Johan van Oldenbarneveldt among others.

features.name: Arboretum Trompenburg
features.opening: Arboretum Trompenburg is a botanical garden in Rotterdam, Netherlands, which hosts a large collection of woody as well as herbaceous plants.

facts.text: The garden sits 4 meters below sea level, requiring a canal system to drain the land.
facts.sourceQuote: It occupies an area of 7 ha and is situated 4 m below sea level, so a system of canals is used to drain the land.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It occupies an area of 7 ha and is situated 4 m below sea level, so a system of canals is used to drain the land.

facts.text: Public access began in 1958 after the site's history extended back to the nineteenth century.
facts.sourceQuote: The history of the garden dates back to the 19th century. Since 1958 it has been open to the public daily for a small fee.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The history of the garden dates back to the 19th century. Since 1958 it has been open to the public daily for a small fee.

features.name: Historische Tuin Schoonoord
features.opening: Park Schoonoord is a park of about 1.2 hectares in the Shipping Quarter in Rotterdam.

facts.text: An arched bridge was constructed in 1928 to open the park onto Kievitslaan.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1928 werd ter ontsluiting van het park aan de Kievitslaan een boogbrug gebouwd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1928, a arched bridge was built to open up the park on Kievitslaan.

facts.text: A tea dome once stood at the corner of Kievitslaan and Westzeedijk until it was demolished in 1957.
facts.sourceQuote: De theekoepel op de hoek van Kievitslaan en Westzeedijk werd in 1957 afgebroken om plaats te maken voor de Parkflat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The tea dome on the corner of Kievitslaan and Westzeedijk was demolished in 1957 to make way for the Parkflat.

features.name: Staelduinse Bos
features.opening: The Staelduinse Bos is a long forest of 95 hectares in the Westland between Hoek van Holland and Maasdijk and is part of the Kapittelduinen.

facts.text: The name Staelduinse Bos derives from 'stalen', the stakes used by fishermen to catch salmon in the Maas.
facts.sourceQuote: Deze 'staelvissers' visten op zalm in de Maas met netten en fuiken, bevestigd aan staken of 'staelen', de naam "Staelduinse Bos" zou hier aan ontleend zijn.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: These 'steel fishermen' fished for salmon in the Maas using nets and hooks, attached to stakes or 'stalen', the name "Staelduinse Bos" is said to have been derived from this.

facts.text: During WWII, sixteen heavy bunkers and six ammunition bunkers were built in a circle around a central command post.
facts.sourceQuote: Vanaf 1942 werden in het bos 16 zware bunkers en 6 munitiebunkers in een cirkel gebouwd met in het midden de commandobunker.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 1942, 16 heavy bunkers and 6 ammunition bunkers were built in a circle in the forest with the command bunker in the center.

facts.text: The main entrance on Papedijk leads directly into the Oude Hooislag, a path running through the long strip.
facts.sourceQuote: De hoofdingang is aan de Papedijk (in 's-Gravenzande) die overgaat in de Oude Hooislag: een pad door de langgerekte strook bos.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The main entrance is on the Papedijk (in 's-Gravenzande) which leads into the Oude Hooislag: a path through the long strip of forest.

features.name: Botanische Tuin Afrikaanderwijk
features.opening: The Botanische Tuin Afrikaanderwijk is a botanical garden in the Rotterdam Afrikaanderwijk.

facts.text: Municipal architect Ad van der Steur designed both the 1925 garden layout and the school building.
facts.sourceQuote: Het ontwerp van de tuin (1925) en het schoolgebouw is van de gemeentearchitect Ad van der Steur.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The design of the garden (1925) and the school building is by the municipal architect Ad van der Steur.

facts.text: The former school building now houses the Kocatepe mosque instead of educational classes.
facts.sourceQuote: Tegenwoordig is de Kocatepe moskee gevestigd in het voormalige schoolgebouw.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Today, the Kocatepe mosque is located in the former school building.

facts.text: Since 2013, volunteers from the Botanische Tuin Afrikaanderwijk Foundation maintain the grounds.
facts.sourceQuote: De tuin wordt onderhouden door de daarvoor opgerichte Stichting Botanische Tuin Afrikaanderwijk (2013) met vrijwilligers.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The garden is maintained by the Botanische Tuin Afrikaanderwijk Foundation (2013), which was established for this purpose, with volunteers.

features.name: Rozenburg Park
features.opening: Rotterdam ( ROT-ər-dam, UK also ROT-ər-DAM; Dutch: [ˌrɔtərˈdɑm] ) is the second-largest city in the Netherlands by population and the largest by area (319.4…

facts.text: The legendary Kralingen Pop Festival featuring Pink Floyd took place in Rotterdam in 1970.
facts.sourceQuote: A major historical moment in the city's music history is the legendary Kralingen Pop Festival, which took place in Rotterdam in 1970 (featuring, among others, Pink Floyd, Jefferson Airplane, The Byrds, Canned Heat, It's a Beautiful Day, and Santana).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A major historical moment in the city's music history is the legendary Kralingen Pop Festival, which took place in Rotterdam in 1970 (featuring, among others, Pink Floyd, Jefferson Airplane, The Byrds, Canned Heat, It's a Beautiful Day, and Santana).

facts.text: Rotterdam became home to Gabber music in the mid-1990s with groups like Neophyte starting there.
facts.sourceQuote: Rotterdam also became the home of Gabber, a type of hardcore electronic music popular in the mid-1990s, with hard beats and samples. Groups like Neophyte and Rotterdam Terror Corps (RTC) started in Rotterdam, playing at clubs like Parkzicht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Rotterdam also became the home of Gabber, a type of hardcore electronic music popular in the mid-1990s, with hard beats and samples. Groups like Neophyte and Rotterdam Terror Corps (RTC) started in Rotterdam, playing at clubs like Parkzicht.

facts.text: The British band the Beautiful South recorded a song titled Rotterdam (or Anywhere) about this region in 1996.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1996, the British band the Beautiful South recorded a song named after this region titled "Rotterdam (or Anywhere)".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1996, the British band the Beautiful South recorded a song named after this region titled "Rotterdam (or Anywhere)".

facts.text: The video game Hitman: Contracts features two missions named Rendezvous in Rotterdam and Deadly Cargo set here.
facts.sourceQuote: In the 2004 video game Hitman: Contracts, the missions "Rendezvous in Rotterdam" and "Deadly Cargo" are both set in Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the 2004 video game Hitman: Contracts, the missions "Rendezvous in Rotterdam" and "Deadly Cargo" are both set in Rotterdam.

features.name: Het Park
features.opening: Het Park is a city park in the Rotterdam Shipping Quarter.

facts.text: Designers Jan David Zocher and his son Louis Paul Zocher created the layout between 1852 and 1863.
facts.sourceQuote: Het werd tussen 1852 en 1863 aangelegd naar een ontwerp van Jan David Zocher en zijn zoon Louis Paul Zocher.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was built between 1852 and 1863 according to a design by Jan David Zocher and his son Louis Paul Zocher.

facts.text: A wooden Norwegian Sailor's Church arrived as a building kit from newly independent Norway in 1914.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan de westkant van het Park werd in 1914 de houten Noorse Zeemanskerk gebouwd. Het kerkje was een geschenk van het zojuist onafhankelijk geworden Noorwegen aan Rotterdam en is als bouwpakket naar Nederland verscheept.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the west side of the Park, the wooden Norwegian Sailor's Church was built in 1914. The church was a gift from the newly independent Norway to Rotterdam and was shipped to the Netherlands as a building kit.

facts.text: Construction of the Maas Tunnel in 1937 forced the loss of part of the park on its west side.
facts.sourceQuote: Voor de aanleg van de Maastunnel vanaf 1937 is aan de westzijde een deel van het Park verloren gegaan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: For the construction of the Maas Tunnel from 1937, part of the Park was lost on the west side.

facts.text: Construction occurred in multiple phases spanning from 1853 to 1900.
facts.sourceQuote: De totstandkoming gebeurde in enkele fases tussen 1853 en 1900.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The construction took place in several phases between 1853 and 1900.

facts.text: The Euromast tower has stood beside the park since 1960.
facts.sourceQuote: Naast het Park, aan de Parkhavenzijde, staat sinds 1960 de Euromast.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Next to the Park, on the Parkhaven side, the Euromast has stood since 1960.

facts.text: Het Park received official cultural heritage status in 2011.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2011 werd het als cultureel erfgoed opgenomen in het Rijksmonumentenregister.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2011 it was included in the Rijksmonumentenregister as cultural heritage.

features.name: Botanische Tuin Kralingen
features.opening: The Botanische Tuin Kralingen is a botanical garden in Rotterdam located on Kralingse Plaslaan in the Kralingen district.

facts.text: Public access began in 1984, shifting the focus from education to recreation.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 1984 is de tuin open voor publiek en ligt de nadruk meer op recreatie dan op onderwijs.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 1984, the garden has been open to the public and the emphasis is more on recreation than on education.

facts.text: Seed exchanges with other botanical gardens only started gaining attention in the 1970s.
facts.sourceQuote: Pas in de jaren zeventig van de vorige eeuw begon men zich toe te leggen op het uitwisselen van zaden met andere botanische tuinen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was only in the 1970s of the previous century that people began to focus on exchanging seeds with other botanical gardens.

facts.text: The garden spans just 0.54 hectares yet features a pond, fountain, and heated greenhouse.
facts.sourceQuote: De tuin beslaat 0,54 hectare en heeft een vijver met fontein, een verwarmde kas, een zadenhuisje, een medicinale tuin, een varentuin en een rosarium.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The garden covers 0.54 hectares and has a pond with fountain, a heated greenhouse, a seed house, a medicinal garden, a fern garden and a rose garden.

facts.text: Visitors can explore distinct sections dedicated to medicinal plants, ferns, and roses.
facts.sourceQuote: De tuin beslaat 0,54 hectare en heeft een vijver met fontein, een verwarmde kas, een zadenhuisje, een medicinale tuin, een varentuin en een rosarium.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The garden covers 0.54 hectares and has a pond with fountain, a heated greenhouse, a seed house, a medicinal garden, a fern garden and a rose garden.

features.name: Ruigeplaatbosch
features.opening: The Ruigeplaatbos is a forest in the Rotterdam municipality of Hoogvliet.

facts.text: Ruigeplaatbosch takes its name from a sandbank in the Old Maas river.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Ruigeplaatbos dankt zijn naam aan een zandplaat in de Oude Maas.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Ruigeplaatbos owes its name to a sandbank in the Old Maas.

facts.text: A June 1997 storm destroyed much of the forest, leading to a decision to let nature reclaim it.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij een storm in juni 1997 werd grote schade aangericht in het Ruigeplaatbos. Na deze storm werd besloten het beschadigde bos aan de natuur over te laten en het dode hout niet op te ruimen, waarna er een verscheidenheid aan bijzondere planten en dieren ontstonden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During a storm in June 1997, great damage was caused to the Ruigeplaatbos. After this storm, it was decided to leave the damaged forest to nature and not clear up the dead wood, after which a variety of special plants and animals emerged.

features.name: Vlinderstrik
features.opening: Vlinderstrik is the name of a design for the redesign of 100 hectares of peatland area between Rotterdam and Berkel and Rodenrijs, in the Dutch province of…

facts.text: Redesign work finished in 2017, after which nature protection groups took over management.
facts.sourceQuote: De herinrichting wordt in 2017 opgeleverd. Daarna zal de Vereniging tot bescherming van natuurmonumenten het gebied gaan beheren.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The redesign will be completed in 2017. After that, the Association for the Protection of Natural Monuments will manage the area.

features.name: Afrikaanderplein
features.opening: Afrikaanderplein was a football ground in Rotterdam, the Netherlands.

facts.text: Feyenoord played its first matches here from 1908 until moving in 1917.
facts.sourceQuote: It was the first home of the professional football club Feyenoord – then known as Wilhelmina (1908–09), HFC (1909), Celeritas (1909–12) and eventually Feijenoord – from its foundation in 1908 until 1917, when the club moved to a new ground at the Kromme Zandweg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was the first home of the professional football club Feyenoord – then known as Wilhelmina (1908–09), HFC (1909), Celeritas (1909–12) and eventually Feijenoord – from its foundation in 1908 until 1917, when the club moved to a new ground at the Kromme Zandweg.

facts.text: Excelsior used this ground for the 1907–08 season before returning to Woudestein.
facts.sourceQuote: Before the foundation of Feyenoord, fellow Rotterdam club Excelsior played its matches on the Afrikaanderplein in the season 1907–08, after which the club returned to Woudestein.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Before the foundation of Feyenoord, fellow Rotterdam club Excelsior played its matches on the Afrikaanderplein in the season 1907–08, after which the club returned to Woudestein.

features.name: Stadhuisplein
features.opening: The Stadhuisplein is a traffic-free area of the center of Rotterdam.

facts.text: Thousands gather here to celebrate Feyenoord's major victories.
facts.sourceQuote: Grote successen van Feyenoord worden er door duizenden supporters gevierd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Thousands of supporters celebrate Feyenoord's great successes.

facts.text: Mari Andriessen created the Monument for all the fallen 1940 - 1945 sculpture group on this square.
facts.sourceQuote: Op het plein bevindt zich de beeldengroep Monument voor alle gevallenen 1940 - 1945 van Mari Andriessen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the square is the sculpture group Monument for all the fallen 1940 - 1945 by Mari Andriessen.

facts.text: Multiple bars and restaurants make this a popular nightlife destination.
facts.sourceQuote: Door de aanwezigheid van meerdere horecagelegenheden is het een populaire uitgaansplek.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Due to the presence of multiple restaurants and bars, it is a popular nightlife spot.

features.name: Schouwburgplein
features.opening: Theatre Square (or in Dutch : Schouwburgplein) is a plaza situated in the heart of the city of Rotterdam, and is flanked by the municipal theatre, concert…

facts.text: Before WWII, this site was a densely populated neighborhood.
facts.sourceQuote: Before World War II the area was a densely populated neighbourhood.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Before World War II the area was a densely populated neighbourhood.

facts.text: A model of its 1996 redesign by West 8 resides in New York's MoMA.
facts.sourceQuote: The square was redesigned in 1996 by Adriaan Geuze and his firm West 8. A model of the design is in the Museum of Modern Art in New York.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The square was redesigned in 1996 by Adriaan Geuze and his firm West 8. A model of the design is in the Museum of Modern Art in New York.

features.name: Batavierenstraat
features.opening: The Batavierenstraat is a street in the center of Rotterdam, located in the district of the Oude Westen.

facts.text: Artist Dalal Mitwally created the controversial works through a collaboration between the Dutch Photomuseum and the Mauritshuis.
facts.sourceQuote: Deze zogenaamde murals, vervaardigd door kunstenares Dalal Mitwally, zijn het resultaat van een opdracht van het Nederlands Fotomuseum in samenwerking met het Mauritshuis, gefinancierd door de VriendenLoterij en woningcorporatie Woonstad Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: These so-called murals, created by artist Dalal Mitwally, are the result of an assignment by the Dutch Photomuseum in collaboration with the Mauritshuis, financed by the VriendenLoterij and housing corporation Woonstad Rotterdam.

facts.text: Mayor Carola Schouten personally visited the street in December 2024 to hear directly from concerned residents.
facts.sourceQuote: De kwestie trok de aandacht van burgemeester Carola Schouten, die op 11 december 2024 een bezoek aan de straat bracht om zich door de bewoners te laten informeren.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The issue attracted the attention of Mayor Carola Schouten, who visited the street on December 11, 2024 to be informed by the residents.

features.name: Botersloot
features.opening: The Botersloot, also known as the Quiet Botersloot, is a street in the center of Rotterdam, and runs from the Meent to the Hoogstraat.

facts.text: The name Botersloot dates to 1433 and honors dairy farmers who brought goods via the Rotte river.
facts.sourceQuote: De naam komt in 1433 al voor in geschriften van het Gemeentearchief Rotterdam, en dankt zijn naam aan de zuivelboeren die hun waren via de Rotte naar de stad brachten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name already appears in 1433 in writings of the Rotterdam Municipal Archive, and owes its name to the dairy farmers who brought their goods to the city via the Rotte.

features.name: Van Oldenbarneveltstraat
features.opening: The Van Oldenbarneveltstraat with the Van Oldenbarneveltplaats in the extension is a street in the center of Rotterdam.

facts.text: Most buildings on the street were destroyed during the bombing of May 14, 1940.
facts.sourceQuote: Door het bombardement van 14 mei 1940 werd een groot deel van de bebouwing aan de Van Oldenbarneveltstraat verwoest.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The bombing of May 14, 1940 destroyed much of the buildings on Van Oldenbarneveltstraat.

facts.text: During annual Rotterdam Pride, the street hosts a party with stalls and performances.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens de jaarlijkse Rotterdam Pride is er een straatfeest met kraampjes en optredens in de straat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the annual Rotterdam Pride, there is a street party with stalls and performances in the street.

facts.text: West of Karel Doormanstraat, the street features a dense collection of pre-war buildings.
facts.sourceQuote: Het gedeelte ten westen van de Karel Doormanstraat is de Van Oldenbarneveltstraat en omvat grotendeels vooroorlogse bebouwing.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The area west of Karel Doormanstraat is the Van Oldenbarneveltstraat and largely consists of pre-war buildings.

features.name: Regentessebrug
features.opening: The Regentessebrug is a fixed bridge in the Dutch city of Rotterdam.

facts.text: In March 1940, traffic was restricted to one-way flow from Posthoornsteeg only.
facts.section: De brug voor de Tweede Wereldoorlog
facts.sourceQuote: In maart 1940, twee maanden voor het bombardement, werd besloten om van het verkeer bij de Regentessebrug eenrichtingsverkeer te maken. Alleen verkeer komend vanuit de Posthoornsteeg mocht nog de brug over.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In March 1940, two months before the bombing, it was decided to make traffic at Regentessebrug one-way traffic. Only traffic coming from Posthoornsteeg was allowed to cross the bridge.

facts.text: Some captains disliked the bridge because land traffic took priority over water traffic.
facts.section: De brug voor de Tweede Wereldoorlog
facts.sourceQuote: De Regentessebrug speelde een belangrijke rol in het verbinden van de Blaak en de Boompjes, maar was minder geliefd onder sommige schippers, omdat die vonden dat bij de bediening van de nieuwe brug het verkeer boven land voorrang kreeg op het verkeer te water.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Regentessebrug played an important role in connecting the Blaak and the Boompjes, but was less popular with some captains, because they felt that when operating the new bridge, land traffic was given priority over water traffic.

facts.text: Post-war reconstruction plans explicitly protected the structure from demolition.
facts.section: De brug tijdens de Tweede Wereldoorlog
facts.sourceQuote: De Regentessebrug in zowel het Wederopbouwplan van Willem Gerrit Witteveen als het Basisplan van Cornelis van Traa opgenomen, en is op deze manier behoed voor de sloop.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Regentessebrug was included in both Willem Gerrit Witteveen's Reconstruction Plan and Cornelis van Traa's Basic Plan, and was thus protected from demolition in this way.

features.name: Marconiplein
features.opening: The Marconiplein is a square in the west of the Dutch city of Rotterdam.

facts.text: A Dutch Ford factory once stood here before relocating to Amsterdam in the early 1930s.
facts.sourceQuote: Enige tijd was hier de eerste Nederlandse Fordfabriek gevestigd, deze verhuisde begin jaren 1930 naar Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: For a while, the first Dutch Ford factory was located here, which moved to Amsterdam in the early 1930s.

facts.text: The Caland Line metro station has operated beneath the square since April 25, 1986.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 25 april 1986 is onder het plein metrostation Marconiplein van de Calandlijn in gebruik.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since April 25, 1986, the Marconiplein metro station of the Caland Line has been in use under the square.

facts.text: Locals jokingly refer to this location as Macaron Square due to its name sounding like the pasta dish.
facts.sourceQuote: In de volksmond wordt het Marconiplein ook wel gekscherend het Macaroniplein genoemd..
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In popular parlance, the Marconiplein is also jokingly called the Macaron Square..

features.name: Haagseveer
features.opening: The Haagseveer is a street in the center of Rotterdam.

facts.text: Haagseveer means 'The Hague ferry' and refers to a historic route to The Hague via the Delftsevaart.
facts.sourceQuote: De naam Haagseveer verwijst naar een veerverbinding die vanaf deze plaats via de Delftsevaart en de Rotterdamse Schie met Den Haag werd onderhouden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name Haagseveer refers to a ferry connection that was maintained from this place via the Delftsevaart and the Rotterdamse Schie to The Hague.

features.name: Admiraliteitskade
features.opening: The Admiraliteitskade is a street in the Dutch city of Rotterdam and runs from the Bosland to the Oostmolenwerf.

facts.text: Admiraliteitskade takes its name from the former Rotterdam Admiralty.
facts.sourceQuote: De Admiraliteitskade is vernoemd naar de Admiraliteit van Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Admiraliteitskade is named after the Rotterdam Admiralty.

facts.text: The De Admiraal complex on this street bridges reconstruction and historic styles.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan de Admiraliteitskade bevindt zich het gebouwencomplex "De Admiraal", deze vormt de overgang van de wederopbouwarchitectuur en de historische bebouwing van Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Admiraliteitskade houses the "De Admiraal" building complex, which represents the transition from the reconstruction architecture and the historic buildings of Rotterdam.

facts.text: Numerous national monuments line this specific stretch of the harbor.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan de Admiraliteitskade bevinden zich een tal van rijksmonumenten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There are many national monuments on the Admiraliteitskade.

features.name: Vierhavensstraat
features.opening: The Vierhavensstraat is a street in Nieuw-Mathenesse in Rotterdam-West, which owes its name to the four harbors whose quay borders this street.

facts.text: Vierhavensstraat derives its name from the four harbors bordering its quay: Koushaven, IJselhaven, Lekhaven, and Keilehaven.
facts.sourceQuote: De Vierhavensstraat is een straat in Nieuw-Mathenesse in Rotterdam-West, die haar naam dankt aan de vier havens waarvan de dwarswal aan deze straat grenst. Deze havens zijn de Koushaven, de IJselhaven, de Lekhaven en de Keilehaven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Vierhavensstraat is a street in Nieuw-Mathenesse in Rotterdam-West, which owes its name to the four harbors whose quay borders this street. These ports are the Koushaven, the IJselhaven, the Lekhaven and the Keilehaven.

facts.text: Directly north of this street stands the Big Shops shopping center topped with a park.
facts.sourceQuote: Direct aan het noorden van de straat grenst het winkelcentrum Big Shops, met daarboven een park.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Directly north of the street is the Big Shops shopping center, with a park above it.

features.name: Witte de Withstraat
features.opening: The Witte de Withstraat is a nightlife street in Rotterdam with cafes, restaurants, art galleries, various shops and municipal monuments.

facts.text: Around 1900, this street hosted Rotterdam's first horse-drawn tram line.
facts.sourceQuote: Rond 1900 maakte de Witte de Withstraat onderdeel uit van de paardentramlijn, de eerste tramlijn in Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Around 1900, the Witte de Withstraat was part of the horse-drawn tram line, the first tram line in Rotterdam.

facts.text: During the 1970s, the area gained a notorious reputation for shady cafes and illegal gambling.
facts.sourceQuote: In de jaren zeventig had de straat een slechte reputatie in verband met de vele louche cafés en illegale gokhuizen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the 1970s, the street had a bad reputation due to the many shady cafes and illegal gambling houses.

features.name: 's-Gravendijkwal
features.opening: The 's-Gravendijkwal is an important main road west of the center of Rotterdam.

facts.text: Construction of the Maas Tunnel between 1937 and 1942 transformed the route into a deepened highway.
facts.sourceQuote: Toen de Maastunnel tussen 1937 en 1942 werd aangelegd werd ook de tunneltraverse gebouwd. De 's-Gravendijkwal veranderde in een stadsautoweg die gedeeltelijk verdiept werd aangelegd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: When the Maas Tunnel was built between 1937 and 1942, the tunnel cross section was also built. The 's-Gravendijkwal was transformed into a city highway that was partially deepened.

facts.text: Since 2015, trucks are banned from this road to improve air quality, though electric trucks remain exempt.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 2015 is de 's-Gravendijkwal afgesloten voor vrachtauto's. De Rotterdamse gemeenteraad heeft tot deze maatregel besloten met het oog op de luchtkwaliteit. Elektrische vrachtwagens en de wagens van hulpdiensten zijn van de maatregel uitgezonderd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2015, the 's-Gravendijkwal has been closed to trucks. The Rotterdam municipal council has decided on this measure with a view to air quality. Electric trucks and emergency services vehicles are exempt from the measure.

features.name: Maastunnel
features.opening: The Maastunnel is a tunnel in Rotterdam, the Netherlands, connecting the banks of the Nieuwe Maas.

facts.text: Cyclists and pedestrians reach the lower levels via wooden escalators specifically sized to fit bicycles.
facts.sourceQuote: They contain two side-by-side tubes for motorised traffic, and, beside those, two vertically stacked tubes, one for cyclists and moped riders and the other for pedestrians. Cyclist and pedestrian access is by escalator, the wooden escalators are sized to fit bicycles.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: They contain two side-by-side tubes for motorised traffic, and, beside those, two vertically stacked tubes, one for cyclists and moped riders and the other for pedestrians. Cyclist and pedestrian access is by escalator, the wooden escalators are sized to fit bicycles.

features.name: Goereesestraat
features.opening: The Goereesestraat is a street in Rotterdam-Charlois in the Carnisse district.

facts.text: Originally split by grassy fields and chestnut trees, the median was removed in 1963 to widen the road.
facts.sourceQuote: Aangelegd als twee straten gescheiden door flinke grasvelden als middenberm met daarin kastanjes aan weerszijden. Naar aanleiding van de toename van het verkeer zijn de grasvelden in 1963 geofferd en zijn de kastanjes van de westzijde verplaatst naar het oosten in een smalle berm.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Designed as two streets separated by large grassy fields as a central median with chestnuts on both sides. Following the increase in traffic, the grass fields were sacrificed in 1963 and the chestnuts on the west side were moved to the east in a narrow verge.

facts.text: The RET W-bus began running through the street in March 1949 before becoming line 49 in 1953.
facts.sourceQuote: Vanaf 8 maart 1949 reed de W-bus van de RET vanuit de Markerstraat door de straat naar het Zuidplein. Per 1 november 1953 wijzigde de lijnletter in lijnnummer 49.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From March 8, 1949, the RET's W-bus ran from Markerstraat through the street to Zuidplein. As of November 1, 1953, the line letter was changed to line number 49.

facts.text: On March 12, 1945, twenty men were executed here by German occupiers.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 12 maart 1945 werden door de Duitse bezetter aan de Goereesestraat twintig mannen, waaronder drie politieagenten geëxecuteerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On March 12, 1945, twenty men, including three police officers, were executed by the German occupiers at Goereesestraat.

facts.text: Research later revealed seven Dutch police officers in German uniforms formed part of the execution squad.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2007 kwam bij onderzoek aan het licht dat in het executiepeloton zeven Nederlandse politieagenten, die Duitse uniformen aan hadden, waren opgenomen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2007, research revealed that seven Dutch police officers, who were wearing German uniforms, had been included in the execution squad.

features.name: Aelbrechtskade
features.opening: The Aelbrechtskade in the Nieuwe Westen district is a street in Rotterdam-West, and runs from Aelbrechtsplein and Abraham van Stolkweg to the Lage Erfbrug,…

facts.text: The De Watergeus brewery once operated here, though only a ceiling light remains to recall this industry.
facts.sourceQuote: Zo ook branderij De Watergeus die aan de Aelbrechtskade zat. Enkel een bovenlicht herinnert nog aan deze kleinschalige nijverheid.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Similarly, the De Watergeus brewery, which was located on the Aelbrechtskade. Only a ceiling light still reminds us of this small-scale industry.

facts.text: Organ builders Valckx & Van Kouteren established their workshop on this street in 1925.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1925 vestigden orgelbouwers Valckx & Van Kouteren zich in deze straat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1925, organ builders Valckx & Van Kouteren settled in this street.
