facts.text: Printing company Romer moved from Aelbrechtskade to the Spanish Polder after outgrowing its premises.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan de Aelbrechtskade zat vroeger ook drukkerij "Romer" die in 1928 is opgericht. Omdat het bedrijfspand te klein werd, verhuisde drukkerij "Romer" naar een grotere bedrijfsruimte in de Spaanse Polder.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Aelbrechtskade used to also house the printing company "Romer" which was founded in 1928. Because the company premises became too small, printing house "Romer" moved to a larger business space in the Spanish Polder.

facts.text: A Mathenesser Bridge spans directly overhead, linking three distinct streets above.
facts.sourceQuote: Over de Aelbrechtskade ligt de Mathenesserbrug die de Mathenesserweg verbindt met Van Cittersstraat en de Vierambachtsstraat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Over the Aelbrechtskade lies the Mathenesser Bridge that connects the Mathenesserweg with Van Cittersstraat and the Vierambachtsstraat.

features.name: Koningin Emmaplein
features.opening: The Koningin Emmaplein is a square in the Shipping Quarter of Rotterdam, bordering the Westzeedijk, directly opposite the Museum Park.

facts.text: Upper-class business figures lived here, earning the area the nickname Rijkeluishofje.
facts.sourceQuote: De herenhuizen werden bewoond door mensen uit de bovenlaag van het Rotterdamse bedrijfsleven. Dit gegeven, in combinatie met de enigszins beschutte ligging, leidde tot de bijnaam Rijkeluishofje.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The townhouses were inhabited by people from the upper class of Rotterdam's business world. This fact, combined with the somewhat sheltered location, led to the nickname Rijkeluishofje.

facts.text: In 2024, Dominican friars moved their monastery into house number 13 on this square.
facts.sourceQuote: 28 augustus 2024 verhuisden de Rotterdamse Dominicanen hun Klooster H. Petrus van Verona van Het Steiger naar het pand met huisnummer 13 aan dit plein.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On August 28, 2024, the Rotterdam Dominican friars moved their Monastery H. Petrus van Verona from Het Steiger to the building with house number 13 on this square.

features.name: Aert van Nesstraat
features.opening: The Aert van Nesstraat is a street in the center of Rotterdam, and runs from the Mauritsweg corner Schouwburgplein to the Coolsingel.

facts.text: Aert van Nesstraat was named in 1873 after Dutch sea hero and fleet commander Aert Jansse van Nes.
facts.sourceQuote: De straat werd in 1873 vernoemd naar de Nederlandse zeeheld en vlootvoogd Aert Jansse van Nes.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The street was named in 1873 after the Dutch sea hero and fleet commander Aert Jansse van Nes.

facts.text: The post-war Rotterdam Schouwburg used 1.7 million chopped stones salvaged from bombed buildings.
facts.sourceQuote: Tussen 1945 en 1947 werd een nieuwe Rotterdamse Schouwburg gebouwd met 1,7 miljoen afgebikte stenen van gebombardeerde gebouwen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Between 1945 and 1947, a new Rotterdam Schouwburg was built with 1.7 million chopped stones from bombed buildings.

facts.text: Painter Willem de Kooning lived at the site of the current parking garage as a twelve-year-old in 1916.
facts.sourceQuote: Op de plaats waar nu de parkeergarage staat, stond voor de Tweede Wereldoorlog een wooncomplex, waar in 1916 de latere schilder Willem de Kooning (1904 - 1997) als 12-jarige woonde.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Where the parking garage is now located, there was a residential complex before World War II, where the later painter Willem de Kooning (1904 - 1997) lived as a 12-year-old in 1916.

facts.text: Residents once baked eggs directly on the asphalt during extreme summer heat.
facts.sourceQuote: In de jaren 1930 werd een volksgebruik van de Aert van Nesstraat beschreven dat bestond uit het bakken van eieren op het asfalt van de straat. Dit geschiedde enkel tijdens zeer hete zomerdagen als het asfalt langdurig door de zon werd beschenen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the 1930s, a folk custom of the Aert van Nesstraat was described that consisted of baking eggs on the asphalt of the street. This only occurred during very hot summer days when the asphalt was exposed to the sun for a long time.

features.name: Leuvehaven
features.opening: The Leuvehaven is a port in Rotterdam located near the center of Rotterdam and the Erasmus Bridge.

facts.text: Construction paused due to lack of funds between 1599 and 1604.
facts.sourceQuote: Wegens geldgebrek werd de bouw in 1599 stilgelegd, maar in 1604 kon het werk worden hervat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Due to lack of funds, construction was stopped in 1599, but in 1604 work could be resumed.

facts.text: Horse-powered rosette mills dredged the harbor by lifting buckets to the surface.
facts.sourceQuote: Het baggeren van de Leuvehaven gebeurde met een rosmolen: een door paarden aangedreven serie emmers die al de bagger boven water haalt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The dredging of the Leuvehaven was done with a rosette mill: a series of horse-powered buckets that already brings all the dredged material to the surface.

facts.text: Jacob Foppensz van der Meyde, son of the mayor, laid the first stone in 1602.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 10 juli 1602 had burgemeesterszoon Jacob Foppensz van der Meyde de eerste steen gelegd van het hoofd ten westen van de nieuwe haven, op 10 juni 1603 werd de eerste steen van het hoofd aan de oostzijde gelegd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On July 10, 1602, Jacob Foppensz van der Meyde, son of the mayor, laid the first stone of the head west of the new harbor, on June 10, 1603, the first stone of the head was laid on the east side.

facts.text: Though called the New Harbor initially, Leuvehaven remained the name for Rotterdam's oldest dredged port.
facts.sourceQuote: In het begin sprak men van de Nieuwe Haven, maar later bleek de Leuvehaven toch de beste naam. Nieuwe havens zijn immers blijven komen, maar de Leuvehaven is de oudste gegraven haven in Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At first, people spoke of the New Harbor, but later it turned out that Leuvehaven was still the best name. After all, new harbors have continued to come, but the Leuvehaven is the oldest dredged harbor in Rotterdam.

facts.text: The harbor serves as an outdoor museum for the Maritime Museum Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuote: De haven is onder andere in gebruik als buitenmuseum voor het Maritiem Museum Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The port is used, among other things, as an outdoor museum for the Maritime Museum Rotterdam.

facts.text: A passage connects the port to the Nieuwe Maas between the Mainland and Boompjes.
facts.sourceQuote: De Leuvehaven heeft een directe verbinding met de Nieuwe Maas via een doorvaart tussen het Vasteland en de Boompjes.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Leuvehaven has a direct connection to the Nieuwe Maas via a passage between the Mainland and the Boompjes.

features.name: Chemiehaven
features.opening: The Chemiehaven is a port in the Botlek area in Rotterdam with an area of 22 hectares.

facts.text: Construction of the port took place between 1954 and 1957.
facts.sourceQuote: De Chemiehaven is aangelegd tussen 1954 en 1957 in het kader van de ontwikkeling van het Botlekgebied.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Chemiehaven was built between 1954 and 1957 as part of the development of the Botlek area.

facts.text: A major cleanup operation restored the area in 2002 and 2003.
facts.sourceQuote: Deze vervuiling is in 2002 en 2003 gesaneerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This pollution was cleaned up in 2002 and 2003.

features.name: Prinses Amaliahaven
features.opening: The Prinses Amaliahaven is a container port on the Rotterdam Second Maasvlakte.

facts.text: The port honors Prinses Catharina-Amalia, the Dutch royal heir apparent.
facts.sourceQuote: De haven is vernoemd naar Prinses Catharina-Amalia.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The port is named after Prinses Catharina-Amalia.

features.name: 6e Petroleumhaven
features.opening: The Zesde Petroleumhaven is a port in Rotterdam's Europoort on the Beerkanaal.

facts.text: Daily processing reaches 63,500 cubic meters or 400,000 barrels of crude oil.
facts.sourceQuote: De BP raffinaderij heeft een verwerkingscapaciteit van 63.500 m³ of 400.000 vaten ruwe olie per dag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The BP refinery has a processing capacity of 63,500 m³ or 400,000 barrels of crude oil per day.

facts.text: Annual throughput exceeds 23 million cubic meters, ranking it among Europe's largest refineries.
facts.sourceQuote: Met een doorzet van ruim 23.000.000 m³ per jaar, is zij een van de grootste raffinaderijen in Europa.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: With a throughput of over 23,000,000 m³ per year, it is one of the largest refineries in Europe.

facts.text: Oil booms here are powerful enough to seal off the entire harbor during a spill emergency.
facts.sourceQuote: Voor het bestrijden van oliemorsingen zijn er oilbooms, waarmee de gehele haven kan worden afgesloten en klein materiaal voor gebruik bij het opruimen van morsingen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There are oil booms available to combat oil spills, which can seal off the entire harbor and provide small materials for use in cleaning up spills.

features.name: Bergsche Voorplas
features.opening: The Bergsche Plassen are two bog ponds located between the northern Rotterdam suburbs of Schiebroek and Hillegersberg.

facts.text: Peat mining in the 17th and 18th centuries created these ponds.
facts.sourceQuote: De plassen ontstonden door turfwinning in de 17e en 18e eeuw.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The ponds were formed by peat mining in the 17th and 18th centuries.

facts.text: Each pond covers roughly 46 hectares of surface area.
facts.sourceQuote: Ze zijn ieder circa 46 hectare groot en vanaf de Rotte per boot te bereiken via het Berg en Broeksche Verlaat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: They are each about 46 hectares in size and can be reached from the Rotte by boat via the Berg and Broeksche Verlaat.

facts.text: Boats can reach the ponds from the Rotte river via Berg and Broeksche Verlaat locks.
facts.sourceQuote: Ze zijn ieder circa 46 hectare groot en vanaf de Rotte per boot te bereiken via het Berg en Broeksche Verlaat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: They are each about 46 hectares in size and can be reached from the Rotte by boat via the Berg and Broeksche Verlaat.

features.name: Brittanniëhaven
features.opening: The Brittanniëhaven is a port in the east of the Europoort area in Rotterdam, at the end of the Caland Canal.

facts.text: A car transfer company has operated at the harbor since 1981.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 1981 is aan de Brittanniëhaven een overslagbedrijf voor auto's gevestigd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 1981, a car transfer company has been located at Brittanniëhaven.

facts.text: A 1750-meter windbreak was built to let tall ships pass in strong winds.
facts.sourceQuote: Omdat deze schepen hoog op het water liggen is bij de Calandbrug een windscherm gebouwd van 1750 meter lang en 25 meter hoog, waardoor de autoschepen de Calandbrug ook boven windkracht 5 kunnen passeren.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Because these ships are high on the water, a windbreak has been built at the Caland Bridge that is 1750 meters long and 25 meters high, allowing the car ferries to pass the Caland Bridge even above wind force 5.

features.name: Wijnhaven
features.opening: The Wijnhaven is a port in the center of Rotterdam.

facts.text: The André van der Louw Bridge spans directly over the water of this central harbor.
facts.sourceQuote: Over de Wijnhaven loopt de André van der Louwbrug.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The André van der Louw Bridge runs over the Wijnhaven.

facts.text: Most historic buildings vanished in the 1940 bombing, leaving only the east side near the White House.
facts.sourceQuote: De historische bebouwing rond de Wijnhaven is verloren gegaan bij het bombardement op Rotterdam van 14 mei 1940. Alleen de oostkant van de Wijnhaven bij het Witte Huis is toen gespaard gebleven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The historic buildings around the Wijnhaven were lost in the bombing of Rotterdam on May 14, 1940. Only the east side of the Wijnhaven near the White House was then spared.

facts.text: The Regentesse Bridge is nicknamed the Four Lions Bridge due to four lions flanking its structure.
facts.sourceQuote: Over de Wijnhaven ligt nog een vooroorlogse brug, de Regentessebrug die in de volksmond Vierleeuwenbrug wordt genoemd, naar de vier leeuwen die de brug flankeren.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Over the Wijnhaven lies another pre-war bridge, the Regentesse Bridge, which is popularly known as the Four Lions Bridge, after the four lions that flank the bridge.

features.name: Slufter
features.opening: The Slufter is a large-scale storage site for contaminated sludge in the southwestern part of the Rotterdam Maasvlakte on the North Sea coast near Voorne.

facts.text: Construction began in the early 1980s after dumping sludge into the North Sea proved unsustainable.
facts.sourceQuote: Daar dit een onhoudbare situatie bleek, is in het begin van de jaren 1980 door het Havenbedrijf en RWS besloten een depot te bouwen waarin dit slib gestort kan worden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since this turned out to be an unsustainable situation, at the beginning of the 1980s, the Port Authority and RWS decided to build a depot where this sludge could be dumped.

facts.text: Management shifted from government authorities to a Boskalis joint venture contract starting in 2011.
facts.sourceQuote: Het dagelijks onderhoud en beheer van de Slufter gebeurde tot en met september 2011 door het Havenbedrijf Rotterdam in samenwerking met de regionale dienst Zuid-Holland van Rijkswaterstaat. Voor de periode daarna werd een contract tot 2016 afgesloten met Boskalis Beheer Slufter vof, een samenwerkingsverband tussen Boskalis Nederland bv en Boskalis Dolman bv.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Until September 2011, the daily maintenance and management of the Slufter was carried out by the Rotterdam Port Authority in cooperation with the regional department of South Holland of Rijkswaterstaat. For the period after that, a contract until 2016 was concluded with Boskalis Beheer Slufter vof, a joint venture between Boskalis Nederland bv and Boskalis Dolman bv.

facts.text: The Port Authority constructed an office and visitor center on the ring road between 2003 and 2004.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2003 en 2004 heeft het Havenbedrijf een kantoorgebouw annex bezoekerscentrum op de ringdijk laten bouwen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2003 and 2004, the Port Authority had an office building annex visitor center built on the ring road.

facts.text: Architect Pros ten Hove designed the facility, which was delivered in January 2005.
facts.sourceQuote: Het ontwerp is getekend door Pros ten Hove, de oplevering vond plaats in januari 2005.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The design was drawn by Pros ten Hove, the delivery took place in January 2005.

features.name: Binnenhaven
features.opening: The Binnenhaven is one of the oldest harbors in Rotterdam in Rotterdam-Zuid, dug between 1874 and 1878.

facts.text: The municipality took over operations in 1882 after shareholders deemed it unprofitable.
facts.sourceQuote: Toen in 1882 de aandeelhouders van de Rotterdamsche Handelsvereeniging (zie aldaar en bij Lodewijk Pincoffs) een rendabele exploitatie van de Handelsinrichtingen, waarvan de Binnenhaven deel uitmaakte, niet meer zagen zitten werden ze overgenomen door de gemeente Rotterdam, die de exploitatie voortzette.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: When in 1882 the shareholders of the Rotterdamsche Handelsvereeniging (see there and at Lodewijk Pincoffs) no longer saw a profitable operation of the Handelsinrichtingen, of which Binnenhaven was part, they were taken over by the municipality of Rotterdam, which continued the operation.

facts.text: Captains actively avoided these ports due to high fees and difficult maneuvering.
facts.sourceQuote: De havens werden destijds vanwege het kadegeld dat door de RHV werd geheven, wat toen verder in Rotterdam nog niet voorkwam, en het lastige in- en uitmanoeuvreren, als het even kon door kapiteins gemeden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The ports were then avoided by captains whenever possible due to the mooring fees charged by the RHV, which was not yet common in Rotterdam at the time, and the difficult maneuvering in and out, if possible.

features.name: Scheurhaven
features.opening: The Scheurhaven is a port in Rotterdam's Europoort on the Caland Canal.

facts.text: A ferry for pedestrians and two-wheelers to Hoek van Holland operated here until the end of 2021.
facts.sourceQuote: Vanaf de Scheurhaven was tot eind 2021 een veerverbinding voor voetgangers en tweewielers met Hoek van Holland en de Tweede Maasvlakte.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From the Scheurhaven, a ferry connection for pedestrians and two-wheelers to Hoek van Holland and the Second Maasvlakte existed until the end of 2021.

features.name: Kralingse Plas
features.opening: The Kralingse Plas is a lake located in the suburb of Kralingen in Rotterdam, the Netherlands.

facts.text: The lake was formed by historical peat extractions rather than natural processes.
facts.sourceQuote: The Kralingse Plas was created due to peat extractions.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Kralingse Plas was created due to peat extractions.

facts.text: Visitors primarily use the waters for sports, fishing and general recreation.
facts.sourceQuote: The water is mainly used for watersport, fishing and recreational activities.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The water is mainly used for watersport, fishing and recreational activities.

features.name: Lekhaven
features.opening: The Lekhaven is a pre-war harbor in Nieuw-Mathenesse in Rotterdam-West.

facts.text: The Lekhaven takes its name from the nearby Lek River.
facts.sourceQuote: De Lekhaven is vernoemd naar de rivier de Lek.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Lekhaven is named after the Lek River.

facts.text: German occupiers destroyed the port facilities in 1944.
facts.sourceQuote: Vervolgens vernielde de Duitse bezetter de haveninstallaties in 1944.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Then, the German occupiers destroyed the port facilities in 1944.

facts.text: Thomsen's Havenbedrijf operated as both a bulk goods transhipment firm and a passenger terminal.
facts.sourceQuote: Het belangrijkste bedrijf dat aan de Lekhaven was gevestigd was Thomsen's Havenbedrijf, een bedrijf dat de overslag van stukgoed combineerde met de functie van passagiersterminal.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The most important company based in Lekhaven was Thomsen's Havenbedrijf, a company that combined the transhipment of bulk goods with the function of passenger terminal.

features.name: 8e Petroleumhaven
features.opening: The Achtste Petroleumhaven is a port on the Maasvlakte in Rotterdam.

facts.text: A container ship collided with a pier in January 2007, requiring a 20 million euro rebuild.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij de storm in januari 2007 is een containerschip tegen een van de steigers aangevaren waarbij deze onbruikbaar werd, deze steiger zal voor 20 miljoen euro herbouwd worden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the storm in January 2007, a container ship collided with one of the piers, rendering it unusable, this pier will be rebuilt for 20 million euros.

facts.text: Two platforms allow the largest mammoth tankers to dock at this terminal.
facts.sourceQuote: In de Achtste Petroleumhaven zijn twee steigers waaraan de grootste mammoettankers kunnen aanleggen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the Achtste Petroleumhaven there are two platforms on which the largest mammoth tankers can dock.

facts.text: Unlike other Petroleum Ports, no oil refinery is located here.
facts.sourceQuote: In tegenstelling tot bij de andere Petroleumhavens is hier geen olieraffinaderij gevestigd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Unlike the other Petroleum Ports, there is no oil refinery located here.

facts.text: Storage tanks hold more than 4 million cubic meters of capacity.
facts.sourceQuote: Er zijn opslagtanks met een capaciteit van ruim 4 miljoen m³.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There are storage tanks with a capacity of more than 4 million m³.

features.name: Middenkous
features.opening: The Middenkous is an old harbor in Rotterdam-Delfshaven.

facts.text: A 1968 closure of the Ruigeplaats lock severed Middenkous from the Nieuwe Maas river.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1968 is de Ruigeplaatsluis gesloten en heeft de Westzeedijk de verbinding tussen de Middenkous en de Nieuwe Maas verbroken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1968, the Ruigeplaats lock was closed and the Westzeedijk severed the connection between the Middenkous and the Nieuwe Maas.

facts.text: The harbor was created in 1875 after damming two navigable ditches.
facts.sourceQuote: De haven is ontstaan in 1875 na het afdammen van de West Kous en de Oost Kous, de bevaarbare geul tussen Delfshaven en de Ruige Plaat, die Delfshaven van de Nieuwe Maas scheidde.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The port was created in 1875 after the damming of the West Kous and the East Kous, the navigable ditch between Delfshaven and the Ruige Plaat, which separated Delfshaven from the Nieuwe Maas.

facts.text: Construction involved sealing the West Kous and East Kous waterways.
facts.sourceQuote: De haven is ontstaan in 1875 na het afdammen van de West Kous en de Oost Kous, de bevaarbare geul tussen Delfshaven en de Ruige Plaat, die Delfshaven van de Nieuwe Maas scheidde.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The port was created in 1875 after the damming of the West Kous and the East Kous, the navigable ditch between Delfshaven and the Ruige Plaat, which separated Delfshaven from the Nieuwe Maas.

features.name: Parkhaven
features.opening: The Parkhaven is a harbor from the period of the turn of the century to the twentieth century, located between the Lloyd Quarter and the Park in Rotterdam.

facts.text: A ferry originally named Prinses Anna was converted into a party ship with its car deck stripped and fitted with a canopy.
facts.sourceQuote: Vanaf het ventilatiegebouw van de Maastunnel waren dat: het Chinese hotel-restaurant New Ocean Paradise, Partyschip De Brandaris (de Berenboot, geïnspireerd door De Bereboot), de Pannenkoekenboot II, de Zwarte Zwaan (aanvankelijk schipperscentrum, later restaurant) en partyschip MPS De Ameland, de in 1967 door Rijkswaterstaat gebouwde veerboot naar Ameland die aanvankelijk Prinses Anna heette. In 1997 is dit schip omgebouwd tot partyschip, waarbij het gehele autodek werd gestript en voorzien werd van een overkapping.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From the ventilation building of the Maas Tunnel, these were: the Chinese hotel-restaurant New Ocean Paradise, the party ship De Brandaris (the Berenboot, inspired by De Bereboot), the Pancake Boat II, the Black Swan (initially skipper's center, later restaurant) and party ship MPS De Ameland, the ferry built by Rijkswaterstaat in 1967 to Ameland that was initially called Prinses Anna. In 1997, this ship was converted into a party ship, with the entire car deck being stripped and equipped with a canopy.

features.name: Old Harbour Rotterdam
features.opening: The Oude Haven, also known as Oudehaven and Oude harbor, is one of the oldest harbors in Rotterdam, in the Dutch province of South Holland.

facts.text: The first pier at this site was constructed around the year 1350.
facts.sourceQuote: De eerste steiger werd hier omstreeks 1350 aangelegd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first pier was built here around 1350.

facts.text: Despite its name, Old Harbour Rotterdam is not the oldest harbor in the city.
facts.sourceQuote: De Oudehaven is niet de oudste haven van Rotterdam; dat was feitelijk een steiger in de gracht ten zuiden van de Middeldam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Oudehaven is not the oldest harbor in Rotterdam; that was actually a pier in the canal south of the Middeldam.

facts.text: The native name Oude Haven translates directly to Old Harbour.
facts.sourceQuote: De Oude Haven, ook Oudehaven en Oude haven, is een van de oudste havens van Rotterdam, in de Nederlandse provincie Zuid-Holland.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Oude Haven, also known as Oudehaven and Oude harbor, is one of the oldest harbors in Rotterdam, in the Dutch province of South Holland.

features.name: Maashaven
features.opening: The Maashaven is one of the ports of Rotterdam.

facts.text: Construction spanned from 1898 to 1905, covering roughly 65 hectares.
facts.sourceQuote: De aanleg van de Maashaven duurde van 1898 tot 1905 en heeft een oppervlakte van circa 65 hectare.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The construction of the Maashaven lasted from 1898 to 1905 and covers an area of approximately 65 hectares.

facts.text: The historic Maassilo building now operates as a popular entertainment venue.
facts.sourceQuote: Voormalige bedrijfsgebouwen hebben nieuwe functies gekregen, zo is de Maassilo tegenwoordig een populaire uitgaansgelegenheid.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Former company buildings have been given new functions, such as the Maassilo, which is now a popular entertainment venue.

facts.text: A residential tower named The Queen of the South has stood at Maashaven since 2004.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 2004 is naast het metrostation Maashaven een woontoren gesitueerd. Deze woontoren, met de naam The Queen of the South bevat het Arthotel, kantoorruimte en elf verdiepingen met elk 8 appartementen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2004, in addition to the Maashaven subway station, a residential tower has been located. This residential tower, named The Queen of the South, contains the Arthotel, office space and eleven floors with each having 8 apartments.

facts.text: The Queen of the South features eleven floors with eight apartments on each level.
facts.sourceQuote: Deze woontoren, met de naam The Queen of the South bevat het Arthotel, kantoorruimte en elf verdiepingen met elk 8 appartementen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This residential tower, named The Queen of the South, contains the Arthotel, office space and eleven floors with each having 8 apartments.

features.name: Delfshavensche Schie
features.opening: The Delfshavense Schie is a canal between the Delft Schie near Overschie and Delfshaven in the municipality of Rotterdam.

facts.text: The port of Delfshaven was founded where the channel crossed the Schielands Hoge Zeedijk.
facts.sourceQuote: Op het punt waar dit kanaal Schielands Hoge Zeedijk kruiste stichtte Delft een eigen haven: Delfshaven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the point where this channel crossed Schielands Hoge Zeedijk, Delft founded its own port: Delfshaven.

facts.text: A new connection to the Nieuwe Maas opened in 1933 via Coolhaven and Parksluis locks.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1933 kwam een nieuwe verbinding tussen de Delfshavense Schie en de Nieuwe Maas tot stand via de Coolhaven en de Parksluizen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1933, a new connection between the Delfshavense Schie and the Nieuwe Maas was established via the Coolhaven and the Parksluis locks.

facts.text: The Rotterdam Schie is largely muted while the Delfshavensche Schie remains a key shipping route.
facts.sourceQuote: De Delfshavense Schie is nu de belangrijkste scheepvaartverbinding tussen de Delftse Schie en de Nieuwe Maas. De Rotterdamse Schie is grotendeels gedempt; de Schiedamse Schie wordt nauwelijks bevaren.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Delfshavense Schie is now the most important shipping connection between the Delft Schie and the Nieuwe Maas. The Rotterdam Schie is largely muted; the Schiedamse Schie is barely affected.

facts.text: A pumping station for the High Council of Delfland operates at the Parksluis lock.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij de Parksluizen staat een gemaal van het hoogheemraadschap Delfland.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the Parksluis there is a pumping station of the High Council of Delfland.

facts.text: Docking facilities were constructed in the Spanish Polder during the 1940s.
facts.sourceQuote: In de Spaanse Polder zijn in de jaren veertig een aantal insteekhavens aangelegd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the Spanish Polder, a number of docking facilities were built in the 1940s.

features.name: 5e Petroleumhaven
features.opening: The Vijfde Petroleumhaven is a port in Rotterdam-Europoort.

facts.text: Construction began in the early 1960s to handle crude oil after the Suez Canal closed in 1956.
facts.sourceQuote: De haven is aan het begin van de jaren zestig gegraven voor de overslag van aardolie. Tijdens de Suezcrisis van 1956 was het Suezkanaal afgesloten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The port was dug at the beginning of the 1960s for the transhipment of crude oil. During the Suez crisis of 1956, the Suez Canal was closed.

features.name: Buitenhaven
features.opening: The Buitenhaven of Vlaardingen is located south of the Delflandse Buitensluis and runs to the Nieuwe Maas, with which the port is in open connection.

facts.text: A lock connecting the harbors existed since 1888 when a railway was built over an embankment.
facts.sourceQuote: De sluis tussen beide havens bestaat sinds 1888, toen de Spoorlijn Schiedam - Hoek van Holland werd aangelegd over een waterkerende dijk, voorzien van een keersluis ter bescherming tegen hoge waterstand.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The lock between the two harbors has existed since 1888, when the Schiedam - Hoek van Holland Railway was built over a watertight embankment, equipped with a turning lock for protection against high water levels.

facts.text: The eastern harbor head features the Speyk lighthouse, now a protected national monument.
facts.sourceQuote: Op het oostelijke havenhoofd bevindt zich de lichtbaak van Speyk, nu een Rijksmonument.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the eastern harbor head is the lighthouse of Speyk, now a Rijksmonument.

features.name: Spuihaven
features.opening: The Spuihaven is a port in Schiedam.

facts.text: The harbor measures 400 meters long, 20 meters wide, and reaches a depth of NAP minus 4 meters.
facts.sourceQuote: De haven is 400 meter lang, 20 meter breed en de diepte is NAP -4 meter.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The harbor is 400 meters long, 20 meters wide and the depth is NAP -4 meters.

facts.text: A floating swimming pool costing 1400 guilders operated here around 1900 before being replaced in 1909.
facts.sourceQuote: Rond 1900 lag er een drijvend zwembad in de haven waarvan de bouw destijds ƒ 1400,- kostte. In 1909 werd het vervangen door een nieuw zwembad elders in Schiedam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Around 1900 there was a floating swimming pool in the harbor whose construction cost ƒ 1400 at the time. In 1909 it was replaced by a new swimming pool elsewhere in Schiedam.

facts.text: Just east of the harbor lies Park Maasboulevard featuring a restaurant built partly over the river.
facts.sourceQuote: Net ten oosten van de haven ligt het Park Maasboulevard met aan de boulevard een karakteristiek restaurant, dat deels over de rivier is gebouwd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Just east of the harbor is the Park Maasboulevard with a characteristic restaurant on the boulevard, which is partly built over the river.

features.name: Pistoolhaven
features.opening: The Pistoolhaven is a port in Rotterdam's Europoort on the Beerkanaal.

facts.text: The Waterway Authority serves as the primary user of this port facility.
facts.sourceQuote: De voornaamste gebruiker is het Loodswezen, maar onder meer het Havenbedrijf Rotterdam maakt er ook gebruik van.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The main user is the Waterway Authority, but the Rotterdam Port Authority also uses it, among others.

facts.text: Heliport Maasvlakte once operated here for the Loodswezen pilot service.
facts.sourceQuote: Hier was of is ook Heliport Maasvlakte gelegen, gebruikt door het Loodswezen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This was or is also where Heliport Maasvlakte was located, used by the Loodswezen.

facts.text: A ferry dock exists here for the RET Fast Ferry service connecting Hoek van Holland to Maasvlakte.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij de Pistoolhaven is een aanlegplaats voor de Fast Ferry RET. Deze veerdienst tussen Hoek van Holland en de Maasvlakte wordt geëxploiteerd door het Rotterdamse vervoerbedrijf RET.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the Pistoolhaven there is a docking point for the Fast Ferry RET. This ferry service between Hoek van Holland and the Maasvlakte is operated by the Rotterdam transport company RET.

facts.text: Ferries operate irregularly from this spot and the nearby Landtong of Rozenburg.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij de Pistoolhaven en de Landtong van Rozenburg zijn veersteigers, maar deze worden onregelmatig gebruikt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There are ferries at the Pistoolhaven and the Landtong of Rozenburg, but these are used irregularly.

features.name: Hartelhaven
features.opening: The Hartelhaven is a inland port on the Rotterdam Maasvlakte, at the end of the Hartel Canal.

facts.text: The port was completed and ready for use in 1973.
facts.sourceQuote: De Hartelhaven is gereed gekomen in 1973.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Hartelhaven was ready in 1973.

facts.text: Dump trucks here are loaded with ores and coal by the European Bulk Transfer Company.
facts.sourceQuote: Het belangrijkste bedrijf aan de Hartelhaven is het Europees Massagoed Overslagbedrijf, waar duwbakken geladen worden met ertsen en kolen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The most important company on the Hartelhaven is the European Bulk Transfer Company, where dump trucks are loaded with ores and coal.

features.name: Noorderkanaal
features.opening: The Bergsluis is a lock in the Noorderkanaal in Rotterdam, in the Dutch province of South Holland.

facts.text: The Bergsluis lock along this waterway was originally constructed in 1938.
facts.sourceQuote: De sluis dateert uit 1938.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The lock dates back to 1938.

features.name: Mississippihaven
features.opening: The Mississippihaven is a seaport on the Rotterdam Maasvlakte, at the end of the Beerkanaal.

facts.text: Bulk carriers can discharge ores and coal at depths reaching 23 meters.
facts.sourceQuote: Het belangrijkste bedrijf aan de Mississippihaven is het Europees Massagoed Overslagbedrijf, waar bulkcarriers geladen met ertsen en kolen met een diepgang tot 23 meter gelost kunnen worden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The most important company on the Mississippihaven is the European Bulk Goods Transfer Company, where bulk carriers loaded with ores and coal can be discharged with a depth of up to 23 meters.

features.name: Dintelhaven
features.opening: The Dintelhaven is an inland port in Rotterdam-Europoort.

facts.text: The port was fully ready for operation in 1970.
facts.sourceQuote: De Dintelhaven is gereed gekomen in 1970.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Dintelhaven was ready in 1970.

facts.text: Ertsoverslagbedrijf Europoort is the main company loading ores and coal there.
facts.sourceQuote: Het belangrijkste bedrijf aan de Dintelhaven is het Ertsoverslagbedrijf Europoort, waar duwbakken geladen worden met ertsen en kolen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The most important company on the Dintelhaven is the Ertsoverslagbedrijf Europoort, where dump trucks are loaded with ores and coal.

facts.text: A combined railway and vehicular bridge spans where the Dintel Canal meets the Hartel Canal.
facts.sourceQuote: Ter hoogte van de plaats waar het Dintelkanaal uitmondt in het Hartelkanaal ligt de Dintelhavenbrug die bestaat uit een spoorbrug en een brug voor autoverkeer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the point where the Dintel Canal discharges into the Hartel Canal lies the Dintelhaven Bridge, which consists of a railway bridge and a bridge for vehicular traffic.

features.name: Boerengat
features.opening: The Boerengat in the east of Rotterdam is a 1591-century inner harbor.

facts.text: Michiel de Ruyter's flagship Zeven Provinciën was built here in 1665.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan het Boerengat werd een scheepstimmerwerf gevestigd, waar in 1665 het admiraalsschip van Michiel de Ruyter, de Zeven Provinciën gebouwd werd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A shipbuilding yard was established at the Boerengat, where in 1665 the admiral's ship of Michiel de Ruyter, the Zeven Provinciën, was built.

facts.text: A railway station named Boerengat served as the line's terminal between 1855 and 1858.
facts.sourceQuote: Tussen 1855 en 1858 was aan het Boerengat het eindpunt van de spoorlijn Utrecht-Rotterdam; dit station was bekend onder de naam halte Boerengat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Between 1855 and 1858, Boerengat was the terminal point of the Utrecht-Rotterdam railway line; this station was known as Boerengat stop.

features.name: Eemhaven
features.opening: The Eemhaven is the central canal of a complex of harbors in Rotterdam located between Pernis and the Waalhaven.

facts.text: Adjacent basins feature a repair quay named Niehuis alongside several princely harbors.
facts.sourceQuote: De aansluitende havenbekkens zijn de 1e Eemhaven, de reparatiewerf van Niehuis, de Prins Johan Frisohaven, de Prinses Beatrixhaven en de Prins Willem Alexanderhaven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The adjacent harbor basins are the 1st Eemhaven, the repair quay of Niehuis, the Prins Johan Frisohaven, the Prinses Beatrixhaven and the Prins Willem Alexanderhaven.

facts.text: The port was renamed Eemhaven in 1946 to avoid using the German river's name after the occupation.
facts.sourceQuote: Eind 1946 werd tevens besloten de naam Eemshaven te veranderen in Eemhaven, dus zonder 's'. Waarschijnlijk omdat handhaving van de vernoeming van deze haven naar de Duitse rivier de Eems na de bezettingstijd niet gepast was.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the end of 1946, it was also decided to change the name Eemshaven to Eemhaven, so without 's'. Probably because enforcement of the naming of this port after the German river Eems after the occupation period was not appropriate.

facts.text: Niehuis & vd Berg's ship repair company became one of the first water-based businesses there in 1955.
facts.sourceQuote: Een van de eerste watergebonden bedrijven die zich in 1955 aan de Eemhaven vestigden, was Niehuis & vd Berg's Scheepsreparatiebedrijf, later een onderdeel van Damen Shiprepair Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: One of the first water-based companies to settle in Eemhaven in 1955 was Niehuis & vd Berg's Scheepsreparatiebedrijf, later a part of Damen Shiprepair Rotterdam.

features.name: Nassauhaven
features.opening: The Nassauhaven is a port in Rotterdam located in the district of Feijenoord.

facts.text: Construction of the basin occurred between 1890 and 1892 to serve factories needing rail access.
facts.sourceQuote: Ze is gegraven tussen 1890 en 1892 en bedoeld voor fabrieken die aan vaarwater gelegen moesten zijn, en een spooraansluiting nodig hadden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was dug between 1890 and 1892 and was intended for factories that had to be located on navigable waters and needed a railway connection.

facts.text: In 2005, Unilever switched margarine transport back to inland tankers after dredging the harbor deeper.
facts.sourceQuote: Moederbedrijf Unilever besloot in 2005 om de aanvoer van grondstoffen voor de margarinefabriek niet meer per tankauto, maar per binnenvaarttanker te doen. Hiervoor is het havenbekken weer uitgediept tot zo'n 4,50m vaardiepte en kreeg het zijn oude functie terug.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Parent company Unilever decided in 2005 not to transport raw materials for the margarine factory by tanker truck anymore, but by inland waterway tanker. For this purpose, the harbor basin was dredged again to a depth of about 4.50m and regained its old function.

features.name: Calandkanaal
features.opening: The Calandkanaal runs from Hoek van Holland parallel to the Nieuwe Waterweg, and provides access to the industrial areas in the Europoort.

facts.text: Access to the Hartel Canal opened via the Rozenburg lock on April 19, 1971.
facts.sourceQuote: De Rozenburgse sluis geeft sinds 19 april 1971 toegang tot het Hartelkanaal.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Rozenburg lock has been providing access to the Hartel Canal since April 19, 1971.

facts.text: A massive wind screen along part of the canal holds the title of the world's largest.
facts.sourceQuote: Langs een deel van het kanaal bevindt zich het grootste windscherm ter wereld: Windscherm Calandkanaal
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Along part of the canal is the largest wind screen in the world: Windscreen Calandkanaal

features.name: Entrepothaven
features.opening: The Entrepothaven is a marina in Rotterdam.

facts.text: The Entrepot building 'De Vijf Werelddelen' opened in 1879 to store coffee, tea, sugar and spices.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Entrepotgebouw 'De Vijf Werelddelen' dateert uit 1879 en huisvestte pakhuizen die werden gebruikt voor de opslag van koffie, thee, suiker en specerijen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Entrepot building 'De Vijf Werelddelen' dates back to 1879 and housed warehouses used for the storage of coffee, tea, sugar and spices.

facts.text: Louis Pincoff's trading company Rotterdamsche Handelsvereeniging realized the harbor alongside its warehouses.
facts.sourceQuote: De Entrepothaven en de Binnenhaven werden samen met het Entrepotgebouw en het Poortgebouw gerealiseerd door de handelmaatschappij van Lodewijk Pincoffs: de Rotterdamsche Handelsvereeniging (RHV).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Entrepothaven and the Binnenhaven were realized together with the Entrepot building and the Gate building by the trading company of Louis Pincoff: the Rotterdamsche Handelsvereeniging (RHV).

features.name: Yangtzehaven
features.opening: The Yangtzekanaal is a waterway in the Rotterdam Maasvlakte, and is a branch of the Beerkanaal.

facts.text: Ships unable to reach the quay directly once used this harbor as a waiting place.
facts.sourceQuote: De Yangtzehaven werd eerst gebruikt als wachtplaats voor schepen die niet direct aan de kade terechtkunnen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Yangtzehaven was first used as a waiting place for ships that cannot reach the quay directly.

facts.text: The calm, deep waters allowed loading of semi-submersible heavy-duty transport ships.
facts.sourceQuote: Omdat het water in de Yangtzehaven 20 meter diep is, het diepste van de hele Rotterdamse haven, werd deze ook gebruikt voor het laden en lossen van half-afzinkbare zwaar-transportschepen en andere verrichtingen die diep en rustig water nodig hadden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Because the water in the Yangtzehaven is 20 meters deep, the deepest in the entire Rotterdam harbor, it was also used for loading and unloading semi-submersible heavy-duty transport ships and other operations that required deep and calm water.

facts.text: The waterway was renamed Yangtzekanaal in October 2012 to reflect its new role as a through channel.
facts.sourceQuote: Met ingang van 24 oktober 2012 is de naam Yangtzehaven veranderd in Yangtzekanaal. Deze verandering van de naamgeving van de vaarweg houdt verband met het gewijzigde karakter van de Yangtzehaven, die door een open verbinding met de havenbekkens op Maasvlakte 2 het karakter van een doorgaande vaarweg heeft gekregen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: As of October 24, 2012, the name Yangtzehaven has been changed to Yangtzekanaal. This change in the naming of the waterway is related to the changed character of the Yangtzehaven, which has acquired the character of a through waterway due to an open connection with the harbor basins on Maasvlakte 2.

facts.text: A planned dyke breach connected the harbor to three Prinses basins in November 2012.
facts.sourceQuote: In november 2012 zorgde aannemer PUMA ervoor dat met een geplande dijkdoorbraak de Yangtzehaven verbonden werd met de Prinses Arianehaven, de Prinses Alexiahaven en de Prinses Amaliahaven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In November 2012, contractor PUMA ensured that the Yangtzehaven was connected to the Prinses Arianehaven, the Prinses Alexiahaven and the Prinses Amaliahaven with a planned dyke breach.

features.name: Persoonshaven
features.opening: The Persoonshaven is a port on Feijenoord in Rotterdam, on the left bank of the Nieuwe Maas.

facts.text: Ships entered freely until the Piekbrug opened in late 1987.
facts.sourceQuote: Schepen konden vrij invaren, tot eind 1987 of begin 1988 de Piekbrug in gebruik werd genomen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Ships could freely enter, until the Piekbrug was put into use at the end of 1987 or beginning of 1988.

facts.text: The harbor lost its industrial role despite still existing today.
facts.sourceQuote: Hoewel de Persoonshaven nog steeds bestaat, heeft ze haar functie van industriehaven verloren.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Although the Persoonshaven still exists, it has lost its function as an industrial port.

facts.text: A lift bridge called Piekbrug marks the entrance to this harbor.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij de ingang ligt de Piekbrug, een ophaalbrug.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the entrance is the Piekbrug, a lift bridge.

facts.text: New quays named Persoonskade and Piketkade were built between the original street and the water in the late twentieth century.
facts.sourceQuote: Aanvankelijk vormde de gelijknamige straat de westelijke kade van de Persoonshaven, maar in het laatste kwart van de twintigste eeuw zijn de Persoonskade en de Piketkade daartussen gekomen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Initially, the street with the same name formed the western quay of the Persoonshaven, but in the last quarter of the twentieth century, the Persoonskade and the Piketkade came between them.

facts.text: Despite its location along a river bend, no crossing has ever existed across this port.
facts.sourceQuote: De haven werd aangelegd in het verlengde van de Nassauhaven in een bocht van de Nieuwe Maas, maar er is nooit een doorsteek geweest: de haven reikte tot aan de Persoonsdam, die nog altijd het eindpunt vormt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The port was built along the extension of the Nassau harbor in a bend of the Nieuwe Maas, but there has never been a crossing: the port extended to the Persoonsdam, which still forms the final point.

features.name: 2e Petroleumhaven
features.opening: The Tweede Petroleumhaven is a port in Rotterdam-Pernis.

facts.text: A single decision simultaneously renamed this harbor Tweede Petroleumhaven while calling its neighbor First Petroleumhaven.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij hetzelfde besluit kreeg de Petroleumhaven de naam Eerste Petroleumhaven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: With the same decision, the Petroleumhaven was given the name First Petroleumhaven.

features.name: Nijlhaven
features.opening: The Nijlhaven is a port on the Maasvlakte in Rotterdam.

facts.text: Excavation of this port occurred in 2011 within the Papegaaienbek area.
facts.sourceQuote: De haven is in 2011 gegraven in de Papegaaienbek aan de noordzijde van de Maasvlakte ten oosten van de Achtste Petroleumhaven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The port was dug in 2011 in the Papegaaienbek on the north side of the Maasvlakte east of the Eighth Petroleum Port.

facts.text: The GATE LNG terminal here reaches a depth of 13.5 meters.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan de haven is een lng-terminal gevestigd, GATE (Gas Access To Europe) en is 13,5 meter diep.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: An LNG terminal, GATE (Gas Access To Europe), is located at the port and is 13.5 meters deep.

features.name: 7e Petroleumhaven
features.opening: The Zevende Petroleumhaven is a port in Rotterdam-Europoort.

facts.text: The harbor sits on the Caland Canal, which reaches a depth of 22.65 meters.
facts.sourceQuote: De Zevende Petroleumhaven ligt aan het 22,65 meter diepe Calandkanaal.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Zevende Petroleumhaven is located on the 22.65 meter deep Caland Canal.

features.name: Botlek
features.opening: Botlek is an industrial port area of Rotterdam, the Netherlands.

facts.text: The strait was first dammed between April 1949 and June 1950 to stop silting.
facts.sourceQuote: Major waterway regulation works were carried out in the Netherlands in the 19th and 20th centuries to improve water management and stop the delta from silting up; the Botlek was first dammed off at its southern end (connecting Rozenburg and Welplaat) between April 1949 and June 1950 and then rebuilt 4,101 ft (1,250 m) to the west in 1956.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Major waterway regulation works were carried out in the Netherlands in the 19th and 20th centuries to improve water management and stop the delta from silting up; the Botlek was first dammed off at its southern end (connecting Rozenburg and Welplaat) between April 1949 and June 1950 and then rebuilt 4,101 ft (1,250 m) to the west in 1956.

facts.text: In 1956, the blocked waterway was rebuilt 1,250 meters further west.
facts.sourceQuote: Major waterway regulation works were carried out in the Netherlands in the 19th and 20th centuries to improve water management and stop the delta from silting up; the Botlek was first dammed off at its southern end (connecting Rozenburg and Welplaat) between April 1949 and June 1950 and then rebuilt 4,101 ft (1,250 m) to the west in 1956.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Major waterway regulation works were carried out in the Netherlands in the 19th and 20th centuries to improve water management and stop the delta from silting up; the Botlek was first dammed off at its southern end (connecting Rozenburg and Welplaat) between April 1949 and June 1950 and then rebuilt 4,101 ft (1,250 m) to the west in 1956.

facts.text: Parts of Rozenburg and Welplaat became an oil port for larger ships than before.
facts.sourceQuote: Parts Rozenburg and Welplaat on either side of the waterway were subsequently developed into an oil port, which could handle larger ships than the old harbor along the Nieuwe Maas.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Parts Rozenburg and Welplaat on either side of the waterway were subsequently developed into an oil port, which could handle larger ships than the old harbor along the Nieuwe Maas.

features.name: Boezem
features.opening: The Boezem is a river in Rotterdam, in the Dutch province of South Holland.

facts.text: A drainage canal named Boezem was authorized on January 14, 1769 to relieve flooding.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 14 januari 1769 werd door de Staten van Holland en West-Friesland een octrooi verleend om, tot ontlasting van de Rotte, een afwateringskanaal te graven in de polder Rubroek, dit kanaal kreeg de algemene naam Boezem.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On January 14, 1769, the States of Holland and West Friesland granted a patent to dig a drainage canal in the Rubroek polder to relieve the Rotte, this canal was given the general name Boezem.

facts.text: Eight mills were built between basins to pump water from the Rotte level to the Maas level.
facts.sourceQuote: Tussen de lage en de hoge boezem werden acht molens gebouwd die het water oppompten van het Rotteniveau naar het Maasniveau.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Between the low and high reservoirs, eight mills were built to pump water from the Rotteniveau to the Maasniveau.

features.name: Koushaven
features.opening: The Koushaven, dug in 1912 in Nieuw-Mathenesse in Rotterdam-West, was the last designed, but the first completed port in the Four Harbors area.

facts.text: Although designed last among the Four Harbors, this facility was actually the first to be completed in 1912.
facts.sourceQuote: De Koushaven, gegraven in 1912 in Nieuw-Mathenesse in Rotterdam-West, was de laatst ontworpen, maar de eerste voltooide haven in het Vierhavensgebied.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Koushaven, dug in 1912 in Nieuw-Mathenesse in Rotterdam-West, was the last designed, but the first completed port in the Four Harbors area.

facts.text: The harbor master rejected the Middle Sleeve for being difficult to navigate and frequently locked.
facts.sourceQuote: De havenmeester vond “een druk bevaren en veelvuldig door sluizen afgesloten water” als de Middenkous daarvoor niet geschikt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The harbor master found "a water that was difficult to navigate and frequently closed by locks" as the Middle Sleeve was not suitable for this purpose.

features.name: Veerhaven
features.opening: The Veerhaven is one of the historic harbors in Rotterdam, located between the Willemskade and the Westerkade in the classic Shipping Quarter of Rotterdam.

facts.text: Veerhaven derives its name from the ferry service to Katendrecht established in the 15th century.
facts.sourceQuote: De Veerhaven ontleent zijn naam aan de veerdienst naar Katendrecht aan de zuidzijde van de Nieuwe Maas, die al in de 15e eeuw werd gevestigd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Veerhaven derives its name from the ferry service to Katendrecht on the south side of the Nieuwe Maas, which was established as early as the 15th century.

facts.text: The Heen en Weer ferry company operated until 1968 when the metro took over the route.
facts.sourceQuote: De veerdienst van de rederij Heen en Weer deed dienst tot 1968 toen de metro de noord-zuidverbinding overnam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The ferry service of the shipping company Heen en Weer operated until 1968 when the metro took over the north-south connection.

facts.text: From 1911 to 1942, a car ferry ran alongside the passenger service before the Maas Tunnel opened.
facts.sourceQuote: Van 1911 tot de opening van de Maastunnel in 1942 was er hier naast een dienst voor personenvervoer ook een veerdienst voor voertuigen, het wagenveer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 1911 until the opening of the Maas Tunnel in 1942, there was also a ferry service for vehicles, the car ferry, in addition to a passenger service.

features.name: Europahaven
features.opening: The Europahaven is a seaport on the Rotterdam Maasvlakte, and is a branch of the Beerkanaal.

facts.text: Construction began in the 1980s when Europe Container Terminals opened a terminal here.
facts.sourceQuote: De Europahaven is aangelegd in de jaren tachtig toen Europe Container Terminals een terminal op de Maasvlakte opende.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Europahaven was built in the 1980s when Europe Container Terminals opened a terminal on the Maasvlakte.

facts.text: The massive Maersk triple-E ship, measuring 400 meters long, is unloaded and loaded here.
facts.sourceQuote: De Maersk triple-E, een van de grootste containerschepen ter wereld (met een lengte van 400 meter) kan hier worden gelost en geladen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Maersk triple-E, one of the largest container ships in the world (with a length of 400 meters), can be unloaded and loaded here.

features.name: Haringvliet
features.opening: The Haringvliet, formerly Harinckvliet, on the east side of the center of Rotterdam is a 1590-year-old inner harbor, named after the fishermen of the herring…

facts.text: The name Haringvliet honors the herring fleet fishermen who once anchored their boats here.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Haringvliet, voorheen Harinckvliet, aan de oostkant van het centrum van Rotterdam is een uit de 1590 stammende binnenhaven, genoemd naar de vissers van de haringvloot die hier aanmonsterden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Haringvliet, formerly Harinckvliet, on the east side of the center of Rotterdam is a 1590-year-old inner harbor, named after the fishermen of the herring fleet who anchored here.

facts.text: Ships of the Rotterdam Admiralty were later moored and resupplied at this historic harbor.
facts.sourceQuote: Later was dit de haven waar de schepen van de Admiraliteit van Rotterdam lagen afgemeerd en werden bevoorraad.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Later this was the port where the ships of the Admiralty of Rotterdam were moored and resupplied.

facts.text: The Havenziekenhospital opened on the east side in 1936 before expanding significantly in the 1960s.
facts.sourceQuote: In de 1936 werd aan de oostkant van de haven het Havenziekenhuis gebouwd, dat hier in de jaren zestig nog werd uitgebreid.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1936, the Havenziekenhuis was built on the east side of the harbor, which was later expanded here in the 1960s.

features.name: Spoorweghaven
features.opening: A rail port, railway port or rail dock is a port with its own railway, which is connected to the national railway network via a railway connection.

facts.text: The name Spoorweghaven combines 'spoorweg' (railway) and 'haven' (harbor).
facts.sourceQuote: Een spoorhaven, spoorweghaven of spoordok is een haven met een eigen spoorweg, die via een spooraansluiting is aangesloten aan het landelijke spoorwegnet. Een spoorhaven is speciaal ingericht voor de overslag van goederen van spoorverkeer naar scheepvaart en andersom, en/of voor het overstappen van personen tussen deze vervoerwijzen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A rail port, railway port or rail dock is a port with its own railway, which is connected to the national railway network via a railway connection. A rail port is specially designed for the transfer of goods from rail traffic to shipping and vice versa, and/or for the transfer of passengers between these modes of transport.

features.name: Tennesseehaven
features.opening: The Tennesseehaven is a port in Rotterdam's Europoort on the Beerkanaal.

facts.text: Tennesseehaven takes its name from the American state of Tennessee, home to Eastman's headquarters.
facts.sourceQuote: De naam is ontleend aan de Amerikaanse staat Tennessee waar het hoofdkantoor van Eastman is gevestigd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name is derived from the American state of Tennessee where Eastman's headquarters is located.

facts.text: The harbor was excavated in 1996 and began operations the following year.
facts.sourceQuote: De haven werd gegraven in 1996 en voor het eerst gebruikt in 1997.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The harbor was dug in 1996 and first used in 1997.

features.name: Keilehaven
features.opening: The Keilehaven is a pre-war industrial port in Nieuw-Mathenesse in Rotterdam-West.

facts.text: Dug between 1912 and 1914, this narrow channel stretches 750 meters long.
facts.sourceQuote: De Keilehaven, ontworpen "in den trant van de Persoons- en Nassauhaven", is gegraven tussen 1912 en 1914 en was 750 meter lang en met 50 meter relatief smal.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Keilehaven, designed "in the style of the Persoons and Nassauhaven", was dug between 1912 and 1914 and was 750 meters long and relatively narrow with 50 meters.

features.name: Court Square Fountain
features.opening: The Hofpleinfontein is a fountain centrally located in the traffic square Hofplein in the Dutch city of Rotterdam, designed by architect J.R.A.

facts.text: A planned twenty-meter structure by George Rickey was abandoned in 1964 due to high foundation costs.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1964 ontwierp beeldhouwer George Rickey een twintig meter hoog bouwwerk dat op de plaats van de fontein zou komen. Door de hoge kosten van de fundering werd dit niet uitgevoerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1964, sculptor George Rickey designed a twenty-meter-high structure that would be built on the site of the fountain. Due to the high costs of the foundation, this was not carried out.

facts.text: Eight sculptures by Cor van Kralingen stand at the corners of the fountain.
facts.sourceQuote: Op de hoeken van de fontein staan acht beeldhouwwerken van de beeldhouwer Cor van Kralingen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Eight sculptures by the sculptor Cor van Kralingen stand at the corners of the fountain.

facts.text: Stylized water lilies in the basin were forged from wrought iron by Karl Joseph Gellings.
facts.sourceQuote: De spuiters van het fonteinbekken zijn gestileerde waterlelies, ze zijn gemaakt van smeedijzer door de kunstsmid Karl Joseph Gellings.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The fountains of the fountain basin are stylized water lilies, they are made of wrought iron by the blacksmith Karl Joseph Gellings.

facts.text: Water animals made of mussel limestone now serve as gutters after originally decorating the square.
facts.sourceQuote: Zijn Waterdieren sierden het Hofplein al voor de plaatsing van de fontein en dienen nu tevens als goot. De waterdieren zijn gemaakt van mosselkalksteen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: His Water Animals adorned the Hofplein even before the installation of the fountain and now also serve as a gutter. The aquatic creatures are made of mussel limestone.

features.name: IJsselhaven
features.opening: The IJselhaven is a pre-war harbor in Nieuw-Mathenesse in Rotterdam-West.

facts.text: Construction of this bulk goods harbor took place between 1912 and 1915.
facts.sourceQuote: De IJselhaven is gegraven tussen 1912 en 1915 en ontworpen voor de overslag van stukgoed.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The IJselhaven was dug between 1912 and 1915 and designed for the transfer of bulk goods.

facts.text: Sixteen stainless steel tanks here store orange concentrate imported from Brazil.
facts.sourceQuote: EJT beschikt over 16 roestvrijstalen tanks van 1000 ton voor sinaasappelconcentraat, dat uit Brazilië wordt aangevoerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: EJT has 16 stainless steel tanks of 1000 tons for orange concentrate, which is imported from Brazil.

features.name: Berghaven
features.opening: The Berghaven is a port in Hoek van Holland on the Nieuwe Waterweg.

facts.text: Construction of the harbor took place between 1883 and 1884.
facts.sourceQuote: De Berghaven is in de jaren 1883 – 1884 gegraven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Berghaven was dug in the years 1883 - 1884.

facts.text: The Crown ordered its creation to house dredging ships and water authority vessels.
facts.sourceQuote: Dit gebeurde in opdracht van het Rijk met als doel te fungeren als berghaven voor schepen van het loodswezen en van Rijkswaterstaat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This was done on behalf of the Crown with the aim of serving as a port for ships of the dredging service and of the Dutch Water Authority.

facts.text: A monument honoring rescue boat crews who died in Hoek van Holland stands here since 1931.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 1931 staat het Reddersmonument, opgericht ter nagedachtenis van de opvarenden van reddingsboten die te Hoek van Holland zijn omgekomen, bij de Berghaven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 1931, the Reddersmonument, established in memory of the crew members of rescue boats who died in Hoek van Holland, has stood at the Berghaven.

features.name: 4e Petroleumhaven
features.opening: The Vierde Petroleumhaven is a port in Rotterdam-Europoort.

facts.text: Construction began in the early 1960s to handle crude oil after the Suez Canal closed.
facts.sourceQuote: De haven is aan het begin van de jaren zestig gegraven voor de overslag van aardolie. Tijdens de Suezcrisis van 1956 was het Suezkanaal afgesloten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The port was dug at the beginning of the 1960s for the transhipment of crude oil. During the Suez crisis of 1956, the Suez Canal was closed.

facts.text: Tankers from the Middle East had to sail around Africa, causing a massive industry boom.
facts.sourceQuote: Olietankers uit het Midden-Oosten moesten om Afrika heen varen. Dit leidde tot een enorme schaalvergroting in de tankvaart.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Oil tankers from the Middle East had to sail around Africa. This led to a huge scale increase in the tanker industry.

features.name: Fokhaven
features.opening: The Fokhaven is a watersport harbor on the Schie-Schie Canal in the north of Rotterdam in the Blijdorpse polder.

facts.text: The harbor was excavated in 1960 to house three displaced water sports associations.
facts.sourceQuote: De haven werd in 1960 gegraven op initiatief van de gemeente Rotterdam. Er werden drie watersportverenigingen ondergebracht die eerder elders waren gevestigd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The port was dug in 1960 at the initiative of the municipality of Rotterdam. Three water sports associations were accommodated that had previously been located elsewhere.

facts.text: Three separate clubs merged into a single entity called Watersportvereniging Blijdorp in 2005.
facts.sourceQuote: Van 1960 tot 2004 was de haven in gebruik bij deze drie watersportverenigingen. Sinds 2005 vormen ze samen 'Watersportvereniging Blijdorp'.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 1960 to 2004, the harbor was in use by these three water sports associations. Since 2005, they have been forming 'Watersportvereniging Blijdorp' together.

features.name: Maasmond
features.opening: The Rijndelta in the Netherlands is the area formed by the various (also former) branches of the Rhine, starting at the border between the Netherlands and…

facts.text: In shipping contexts, the access route to the New Waterway is specifically called Maasmond.
facts.sourceQuote: In de scheepvaart heet de toegang tot de Nieuwe Waterweg Maasmond.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In shipping, access to the New Waterway is called Maasmond.

facts.text: During the Saalian geological period, the Maas river flowed toward the North Sea via the Rhine.
facts.sourceQuote: De stroomgebieden van Maas en Rijn vielen niet alleen samen toen de Maas en de Rijn na de Middeleeuwen via Rotterdam naar de Noordzee stroomden, maar al eerder, in het geologisch tijdvak Saalien, stroomde de Maas via de Rijn naar de Noordzee.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The drainage basins of the Maas and Rhine did not only coincide when the Maas and Rhine flowed to the North Sea via Rotterdam after the Middle Ages, but even earlier, in the geological period Saalian, the Maas flowed via the Rhine to the North Sea.

facts.text: Nero Claudius Drusus built a dam in the Waal river around 10 BC to improve navigation.
facts.sourceQuote: Hoewel de bedijking van de Rijn pas begon aan het einde van de Middeleeuwen, bouwde Nero Claudius Drusus al in 10 v.Chr. een dam in de Waal om de Rijn, die de belangrijkste transportroute was beter bevaarbaar te houden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Although the damming of the Rhine did not begin until the end of the Middle Ages, Nero Claudius Drusus already built a dam in the Waal around the Rhine in 10 BC to make the main transport route more navigable.

facts.text: Roman general Gnaius Domitius Corbulo ordered soldiers to dig a channel connecting the Maas and Rhine mouths.
facts.sourceQuote: De Romeinse generaal Gnaius Domitius Corbulo liet zijn soldaten een verbindingskanaal graven tussen de mondingen van de Maas en Rijn.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Roman general Gnaius Domitius Corbulo had his soldiers dig a connecting channel between the mouths of the Maas and Rhine.

facts.text: Ancient Roman routes linked the Maas to an estuary called Helinium between Naaldwijk and Den Briel.
facts.sourceQuote: Ook de Maas was voor de Romeinen een belangrijke transportroute, vanaf een fort bij Maastricht liep de Romeinse Heirbaan Maastricht-Blerick-Nijmegen, en via Kessel vervolgens naar het brede Estuarium het Helinium gelegen tussen Naaldwijk en Den Briel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Maas was also an important transport route for the Romans, from a fort near Maastricht ran the Roman Heirbaan Maastricht-Blerick-Nijmegen, and via Kessel then to the wide Estuary of the Helinium located between Naaldwijk and Den Briel.

features.name: Sint-Laurenshaven
features.opening: The Sint Laurenshaven is a port in the Botlek area in Rotterdam.

facts.text: Construction began in the 1950s during the Botlek area's expansion.
facts.sourceQuote: De Sint Laurenshaven is aangelegd in de jaren vijftig in het kader van de ontwikkeling van het Botlekgebied.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Sint Laurenshaven was built in the 1950s as part of the development of the Botlek area.

facts.text: Moisture-sensitive goods are stored in tanks featuring conical roofs.
facts.sourceQuote: Behalve opslag in de open lucht vindt ook opslag plaats in tanks met een kegelvormig dak voor die producten die vochtgevoelig zijn.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In addition to storage outdoors, storage also takes place in tanks with a conical roof for those products that are moisture-sensitive.

features.name: Amazonehaven
features.opening: The Amazonehaven is a seaport on the Beerkanaal on the Rotterdam Maasvlakte.

facts.text: A €200 million widening project finished on April 1, 2014.
facts.sourceQuote: Het project vergde een investering van € 200 miljoen en werd op 1 april 2014 opgeleverd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The project required an investment of €200 million and was delivered on April 1, 2014.

facts.text: The harbor is now 310 meters wide after gaining 55 meters of width.
facts.sourceQuote: De haven is hierdoor 55 meter breder geworden en meet nu 310 meter.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The harbor has therefore become 55 meters wider and now measures 310 meters.

facts.text: Excavated soil from this port filled the nearby Prinses Margriethaven.
facts.sourceQuote: De grond die vrijkwam bij het uitgraven van de Amazonehaven is gebruikt bij het dempen van de Prinses Margriethaven voor het vergroten van de home-terminal van ECT.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The soil that was released during the excavation of the Amazonehaven was used to fill in the Prinses Margriethaven to expand the home terminal of ECT.

features.name: Seinehaven
features.opening: The Seinehaven is a port in the east of the Europoort area in Rotterdam on the Hartel Canal.

facts.text: Construction of this port facility was completed in the year 1969.
facts.sourceQuote: De haven is aangelegd in 1969.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The port was built in 1969.

facts.text: The Lyondell Chemical Company operates a factory within these grounds.
facts.sourceQuote: Hier zijn onder meer Districenter Botlek, de Botlekfabriek van Lyondell Chemical Company en de Holland Terminals van PSA-HNN gevestigd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Districenter Botlek, the Botlek factory of Lyondell Chemical Company and the Holland Terminals of PSA-HNN are located here, among other things.

facts.text: PSA-HNN runs its Holland Terminals operations at this specific location.
facts.sourceQuote: Hier zijn onder meer Districenter Botlek, de Botlekfabriek van Lyondell Chemical Company en de Holland Terminals van PSA-HNN gevestigd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Districenter Botlek, the Botlek factory of Lyondell Chemical Company and the Holland Terminals of PSA-HNN are located here, among other things.

features.name: Beergat
features.opening: The Beerdam is a dam that was built in the 1970s to separate the saltwater in the Mississippi River Harbor from the freshwater in the Hartel Canal.

facts.text: Beergat honors De Beer, a former bird island lost during Europoort construction.
facts.sourceQuote: De dam is genoemd naar het vroegere vogeleiland De Beer ter plaatse dat geheel verloren ging bij de aanleg van Europoort.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The dam is named after the former bird island De Beer on site that was completely lost during the construction of Europoort.

features.name: Buizengat
features.opening: The Buizengat in the east of Rotterdam is a 1699-date inner harbor.

facts.text: The name Buizengat honors the herring pipes that once used this spot as their home port.
facts.sourceQuote: De naam verwijst naar de haringbuizen die hier ooit hun thuishaven hadden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name refers to the herring pipes that once had their home port here.

facts.text: Before 1699, the name Buysse Gat referred to the eastern entrance of the Haringvliet instead.
facts.sourceQuote: Vóór 1699 verwees de naam Buysse Gat naar de oostelijke toegang tot het Haringvliet.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Before 1699, the name Buysse Gat referred to the eastern entrance to the Haringvliet.

facts.text: Garbage trucks once dumped waste here into ships bound for a scrap metal plant in Charlois.
facts.sourceQuote: Er zijn twee kleine insteekhavens, waar vroeger de vuilniswagens het vuil stortten in vuilnisscheepjes, die aan de andere kant van de Nieuwe Maas naar de vuilverbranding op Charlois voeren.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There are two small inlet ports, where garbage trucks used to dump the garbage into garbage ships, which sailed across the Nieuwe Maas to the scrap metal smelting plant in Charlois.

features.name: Koningshaven
features.opening: The Koningshaven is a harbor in Rotterdam that separates the Noordereiland from the Feijenoord district.

facts.text: A different harbor named Noorderhaven existed nearby in 1932 before falling silent by 1940.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1932 werd de naam Noorderhaven opnieuw in Rotterdam gebruikt voor een haven aan het Noorderkanaal in de stadswijk Blijdorp. In 1940 werd deze haven weer gedempt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1932, the name Noorderhaven was again used in Rotterdam for a port on the Noorderkanaal in the Blijdorp urban district. In 1940, this harbor was again silenced.

facts.text: The port was renamed Koningshaven in 1874 to honor King William III.
facts.sourceQuote: Ter gelegenheid van het bezoek van Koning Willem III in 1874 kreeg de haven de naam Koningshaven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the occasion of the visit of King William III in 1874, the port was renamed Koningshaven.

facts.text: A free steam towing service launched in 1878 to help sailing ships navigate the harbor.
facts.sourceQuote: Als oplossing stelde de gemeente in 1878 een gratis stoomsleepdienst in voor zeilschepen die door de Koningshaven wilden varen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: As a solution, the municipality established a free steam towing service for sailing ships that wanted to sail through the Koningshaven in 1878.

facts.text: The railway bridge known as de Hef closed permanently after the Willemsspoortunnel opened in 1994.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1994 werd de Willemsspoortunnel geopend, waarna spoorwegbrug "de Hef" buiten gebruik werd gesteld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1994, the Willemsspoortunnel was opened, after which the railway bridge "de Hef" was put out of use.

features.name: 2e Werkhaven
features.opening: The Tweede Werkhaven is a port in the Botlek area in Rotterdam.

facts.text: Dry dock 7 serves as the largest facility within the Keppel Verolme shipyard.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan deze haven is scheepswerf Keppel Verolme gevestigd en ligt droogdok 7, het grootste dok van Keppel Verolme.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This port is home to shipyard Keppel Verolme and dry dock 7, the largest dock of Keppel Verolme.

facts.text: The port hosts the industrial operations of shipyard Keppel Verolme.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan deze haven is scheepswerf Keppel Verolme gevestigd en ligt droogdok 7, het grootste dok van Keppel Verolme.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This port is home to shipyard Keppel Verolme and dry dock 7, the largest dock of Keppel Verolme.

facts.text: Liquin Terminal TTR and Service Terminal Rotterdam occupy the western side.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan de westzijde liggen Liquin Terminal TTR en Service Terminal Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the west side are Liquin Terminal TTR and Service Terminal Rotterdam.

features.name: Rodenrijse Vaart
features.opening: The Rodenrijse Vaart is a watercourse in Berkel and Rodenrijs, in the Dutch province of South Holland.

facts.text: The N471 road crosses the waterway via the Tunnel Rodenrijseweg west of Rodenrijs.
facts.sourceQuote: Ten westen van Rodenrijs kruist de N471 de Rodenrijse Vaart via de Tunnel Rodenrijseweg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: West of Rodenrijs, the N471 crosses the Rodenrijse Vaart via the Tunnel Rodenrijseweg.

features.name: Zevenmanshaven
features.opening: The Zevenmanshaven is a port in Vlaardingen.

facts.text: Gold recovered from the sunken vessel was lost due to inadequate control after wartime salvage efforts ended.
facts.sourceQuote: Een deel hiervan werd tijdens de oorlog geborgen, maar na de oorlog werd nog goud opgebaggerd. De controle op de geborgen goudstaven was gebrekkig en enkele staven zijn verdwenen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Some of this was salvaged during the war, but after the war more gold was dredged up. The control of the recovered gold bars was inadequate and some bars have disappeared.

facts.text: Zevenmanshaven owes its name to the former Zevenmanspolder.
facts.sourceQuote: De Zevenmanshaven ligt aan de westkant van Vlaardingen en dankt haar naam aan de voormalige Zevenmanspolder.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Zevenmanshaven is located on the west side of Vlaardingen and owes its name to the former Zevenmanspolder.

features.name: Beneluxhaven
features.opening: The Beneluxhaven is a port in the west of the Europoort area in Rotterdam, at the beginning of the Caland Canal.

facts.text: Construction of this port took place during the 1960s.
facts.sourceQuote: De Beneluxhaven is in de jaren zestig gegraven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Beneluxhaven was dug in the 1960s.

facts.text: A ferry terminal serving Great Britain and P&O Ferries operates here.
facts.sourceQuote: De haven heeft twee belangrijke functies: hier is de terminal voor veerdiensten op Groot-Brittannië (waaronder een van P&O Ferries) en aan het begin van de haven is een terminal van EBS (de vroegere Graan Elevator Maatschappij) gevestigd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The port has two important functions: here is the terminal for ferry services to Great Britain (including one of P&O Ferries) and at the beginning of the port is a terminal of EBS (the former Graan Elevator Maatschappij) located.

features.name: Coolhaven
features.opening: The Coolhaven is a port in Rotterdam.

facts.text: The waterway was excavated in 1922 to link the Delfshavense Schie with the Nieuwe Maas.
facts.sourceQuote: De Coolhaven werd in 1922 gegraven als nieuwe verbinding tussen de Delfshavense Schie en de Nieuwe Maas.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Coolhaven was dug in 1922 as a new connection between the Delfshavense Schie and the Nieuwe Maas.

facts.text: Sand and gravel vessels frequently travel through here toward Delft and The Hague.
facts.sourceQuote: Door de Coolhaven varen veel zand- en grindschepen uit en naar Delft en Den Haag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Many sand and gravel ships sail out and into Delft and The Hague via the Coolhaven.

features.name: Beerkanaal
features.opening: The Beerkanaal is a canal between the Europoort and the Maasvlakte in the port area of Rotterdam.

facts.text: Construction of the canal occurred in the early 1960s.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Beerkanaal is aangelegd in het begin van de jaren zestig.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Beerkanaal was built in the early 1960s.

facts.text: Building this waterway required destroying the bird reserve De Beer.
facts.sourceQuote: Hiervoor moest het vogelreservaat De Beer verdwijnen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: For this, the bird reserve De Beer had to disappear.

features.name: Waalhaven
features.opening: The Waalhaven is a harbour in Rotterdam, Netherlands.

facts.text: Covering 3.1 square kilometers, this basin ranks among the world's largest excavated harbor basins.
facts.sourceQuote: With an area of 3.1 square kilometers, it is one of the larger dug harbor basins in the world.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: With an area of 3.1 square kilometers, it is one of the larger dug harbor basins in the world.

facts.text: The Koolhoven aircraft factory operated within the Waalhaven airfield grounds.
facts.sourceQuote: Koolhoven aircraft factory was located at this airport.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Koolhoven aircraft factory was located at this airport.

facts.text: Dutch forces destroyed the Waalhaven airport themselves in 1940 to deny it to Germans.
facts.sourceQuote: The factory and airport were destroyed in 1940 by the Dutch army so they could not fall into the hands of the Germans.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The factory and airport were destroyed in 1940 by the Dutch army so they could not fall into the hands of the Germans.

features.name: 1e Petroleumhaven
features.opening: The Eerste Petroleumhaven - until April 21, 1942 called Petroleumhaven - is a pre-war port in Rotterdam-Pernis.

facts.text: Until April 21, 1942, the port was simply known as Petroleumhaven.
facts.sourceQuote: De Eerste Petroleumhaven - tot 21 april 1942 Petroleumhaven genoemd - is een vooroorlogse haven in Rotterdam-Pernis.
