facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Eerste Petroleumhaven - until April 21, 1942 called Petroleumhaven - is a pre-war port in Rotterdam-Pernis.

facts.text: Construction of the harbor took place between 1929 and 1933.
facts.sourceQuote: De Eerste Petroleumhaven is gegraven tussen 1929 en 1933 en ontworpen voor de aanvoer van aardolie voor de raffinaderij van Koninklijke Olie (Shell).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Eerste Petroleumhaven was dug between 1929 and 1933 and designed for the supply of crude oil for the refinery of Koninklijke Olie (Shell).

features.name: Bergsche Achterplas
features.opening: The Bergsche Plassen are two bog ponds located between the northern Rotterdam suburbs of Schiebroek and Hillegersberg.

facts.text: Peat mining in the 17th and 18th centuries created these ponds.
facts.sourceQuote: De plassen ontstonden door turfwinning in de 17e en 18e eeuw.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The ponds were formed by peat mining in the 17th and 18th centuries.

facts.text: Each pond covers roughly 46 hectares of surface area.
facts.sourceQuote: Ze zijn ieder circa 46 hectare groot en vanaf de Rotte per boot te bereiken via het Berg en Broeksche Verlaat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: They are each about 46 hectares in size and can be reached from the Rotte by boat via the Berg and Broeksche Verlaat.

features.name: Koningin Wilhelminahaven
features.opening: The Koningin Wilhelminahaven or 'New Harbor' is a (municipal) commercial and fishing harbor in the Dutch municipality of Vlaardingen that was built along the…

facts.text: A massive oil fire ignited in 1951 after welding sparks hit wind-driven oil stains.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 9 februari 1951 woedde een grote oliebrand in de haven, die begon bij een destijds daar gevestigde scheepswerf. De wind had een olievlek in een hoek van de haven gedreven, waarna een vonk van een lasapparaat de olie deed ontbranden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On February 9, 1951, a large oil fire broke out in the harbor, which began at a shipyard then located there. The wind had driven an oil stain into a corner of the harbor, after which a spark from a welding machine caused the oil to ignite.

facts.text: A dammed connection between two harbors now holds the Grote Visserijplein square.
facts.sourceQuote: Op de plaats van de gedempte verbinding tussen beide havens bevindt zich thans het Grote Visserijplein.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the site of the dammed connection between the two harbors is now the Grote Visserijplein.

features.name: 3e Petroleumhaven
features.opening: The Derde Petroleumhaven is a port in the Botlek area in Rotterdam.

facts.text: Construction of the harbor took place between 1954 and 1957.
facts.sourceQuote: De Derde Petroleumhaven is gegraven tussen 1954 en 1957.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Derde Petroleumhaven was dug between 1954 and 1957.

facts.text: The polder Welplaat north of Spijkenisse was destroyed to make room for this port.
facts.sourceQuote: Hiervoor moesten de boeren van de Welplaat, een polder ten noorden van Spijkenisse, verdwijnen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: For this, the farmers of Welplaat, a polder north of Spijkenisse, had to disappear.

facts.text: Oil transshipment shifted away from Europoort starting in the early 1960s.
facts.sourceQuote: Vanaf het begin van de jaren zestig verschoof het zwaartepunt van de olie-overslag naar de Europoort.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From the beginning of the 1960s, the center of gravity of oil transhipment shifted from the Europoort.

features.name: Maeslant Barrier
features.opening: The Maeslantkering 'Maeslant barrier' is a storm surge barrier on the Nieuwe Waterweg, in South Holland, Netherlands.

facts.text: The world's largest ball-shaped joint measures 10 metres wide and weighs 680 tonnes.
facts.sourceQuote: The ball-shaped joint is the largest in the world, with a diameter of 10 metres, and weighing 680 tonnes.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The ball-shaped joint is the largest in the world, with a diameter of 10 metres, and weighing 680 tonnes.

facts.text: Czech Republic's Škoda Works manufactured the giant ball-shaped joints.
facts.sourceQuote: The joints were made in the Czech Republic at Škoda Works.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The joints were made in the Czech Republic at Škoda Works.

features.name: Sint Jobshaven
features.opening: The Sint Jobshaven is a pre-war port in the Rotterdam municipality of Delfshaven.

facts.text: The harbor takes its name from the Sint Job Chapel, which was demolished to make way for the port.
facts.sourceQuote: De haven is vernoemd naar de bij de aanleg van de haven afgebroken Sint Jobskapel in het voormalige dorp Schoonderloo.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The port is named after the Sint Job Chapel that was demolished during the construction of the port in the former village of Schoonderloo.
